Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Manages kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Estimates daily production needs on a weekly basis and communicates production needs to kitchen personnel daily.
- Assists Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and preparation.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
Leading Kitchen Operations
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Recognizes success performance and produces desired results.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Utilizes the Labor Management System to effectively schedule to business demands and for tracking of employee time and attendance.
- Trains employees in safety procedures.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Brings issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

Position: PLM Support Engineer

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.

Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
Role Summary / Purpose
The Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (ADP WorkForce Software Configuration) supports client workforce management and payroll transformation engagements, with a focus on hands-on configuration of ADP Workforce Software (WFS), including time and attendance, scheduling, leave and workforce-to-payroll interfaces. The role supports requirements, solution configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization while collaborating with client stakeholders, vendors and PwC delivery teams.

Essential Responsibilities
Configure and maintain ADP WorkForce Software modules and settings based on approved business requirements, including time capture, attendance, schedules, pay rules, accruals and absence policies, as applicable to the client deployment.
Translate labor agreements, workforce policies and payroll requirements into configuration specifications for overtime, shifts, premiums, breaks, rounding, holidays and exception handling.
Support requirements workshops and document current-state and future-state processes, configuration workbooks, rule matrices and design decisions.
Set up and validate employee groups, organizational structures, calendars, approval workflows, roles and security permissions within the agreed solution scope.
Support configuration of time collection methods, timesheet approvals, manager self-service, alerts and reporting where enabled.
Work with integration teams to define and test inbound HR master data and outbound approved time/pay data interfaces to payroll and other downstream systems.
Execute unit, system integration, regression and user acceptance testing; prepare scenarios, reconcile results and investigate configuration defects.
Support data conversion, deployment readiness, cutover activities, production validation and hypercare troubleshooting.
Prepare client-facing status updates, defect logs, issue trackers and configuration documentation; escalate design or delivery risks promptly.
Support junior team members through knowledge sharing, review of work products and consistent testing and documentation practices.
Partner with HR, payroll, finance, operations and technology stakeholders to map workforce management processes, policies, controls and integration dependencies.
Assess workforce management and payroll impacts of time capture, attendance exceptions, scheduling, leave, overtime and premium pay rules.
Maintain configuration decisions, requirements traceability, process flows, test evidence and handover documentation in line with project governance.
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes, improve data quality and strengthen workforce-to-payroll controls.

Qualifications / Requirements
Approximately 4-8 years of experience in workforce management, time and attendance, HRIS or payroll implementation and support.
ADP WorkForce Suite Certifications (configuration and integrations required)
WorkForce Time Configuration through Time500
WorkForce Reports
WorkForce Time Integrations
Practical hands-on configuration experience in ADP WorkForce Software (WFS); direct WFS experience required.
Understanding of timekeeping, scheduling, leave/accrual rules, overtime calculations, pay code mapping and payroll interfaces.
Experience across discovery, configuration, test execution, defect resolution, cutover and post-go-live support.
Ability to engage client stakeholders, analyze complex rule scenarios and document clear configuration decisions.
Desired Skills
Experience with ADP WorkForce Software time and attendance and scheduling configuration in multi-site or complex policy environments.
Exposure to API, file-based or middleware integrations with payroll and HR platforms.
Understanding of wage-and-hour, labor agreement and jurisdiction-specific workforce rules as they affect configuration.
Experience with configuration migration, security roles, reporting, reconciliation and production support.
Strong analytical, communication, documentation and stakeholder coordination skills.
Grade / Level
Senior Associate

Job SummaryA senior, customer-facing SRE who owns the reliability of a client's production systems end to end. Embedded as the main technical point of contact, you will design reliable infrastructure, lead incidents, apply AI-assisted operations, and mentor the team.Key Responsibilities
Own the reliability of production systems for one or more enterprise customers on AWS.
Define and manage SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and ensure monitoring provides meaningful insight.
Lead the response to serious (P0/P1) incidents and run blameless post-mortems that lead to fixes.
Lead within the on-call rotation.
Operate and optimise Kubernetes clusters and AWS services as workloads grow.
Introduce AI SRE tooling and AIOps where it speeds up triage and resolution, with appropriate guardrails.
Advise customers on improving their reliability practices, and mentor associate engineers.
Share field learnings with product and engineering teams.
Required Qualifications
Substantial SRE experience with real ownership of production reliability on AWS.
Experience running Kubernetes and AWS services at scale.
A track record of defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
Strong observability practice.
Proven incident leadership and post-mortem facilitation.
Strong automation skills (Python, Go, or Bash).
Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted operations, including introducing AI SRE tooling with sensible guardrails.
AWS certification at Associate level as a minimum.
Preferred Qualifications
Owning CI/CD pipelines and release automation.
Writing and maintaining Terraform modules.
GitOps workflows and Helm.
Designing telemetry collection across services.
Incident-management tooling such as PagerDuty.
Hands-on experience integrating AIOps or AI SRE tooling into production operations.
Familiarity with observability or evaluation of AI systems (e.g., Langfuse).
Experience delivering AI-based work or AI/ML-driven initiatives in production.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional.
Technical Skills & Tools
Cloud (AWS): EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, ELB/ALB, Route 53
Containers & orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm
Observability & monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger (tracing), ELK/Elastic
Reliability practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident command, capacity planning, failure-mode analysis
Incident & on-call: PagerDuty, Opsgenie, blameless post-mortems
Automation & scripting: Python, Go, Bash, Git
AI-assisted operations: AI SRE tooling, AIOps, anomaly detection, automated RCA
DevOps (good to have): CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Terraform modules, GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm

Develop and maintain compliance checklists for individual HCP/HCO engagements to ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements.
Identify missing or incomplete vendor information and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to obtain the necessary documentation.
Collaborate with client stakeholders, compliance and business teams to facilitate seamless project execution and timely delivery.
Support process standardization, continuous improvement initiatives, and the maintenance of process playbooks and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as part of change management activities.
Monitor deliverables against agreed timelines, proactively identify potential risks or delays, and escalate issues to appropriate stakeholders.
Serve as a point of contact (POC) for routine reporting, status updates, and follow-up activities with client stakeholders.

Excellent attention to detail, with a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, completeness, and quality.
Strong English communication skills, including reading comprehension, business writing, documentation, and stakeholder correspondence.

Description:
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
TTT - Senior FIORI/UI5 Developer
EY s GDS Tax Technology team s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY s core Tax practice, you ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EYs GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firms partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking an Senior FIORI/UI5 Developer to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.
The opportunity
We re looking for a Tax Senior with expertise in Senior FIORI/UI5 Developer to join the TTT team in Tax SL. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a pioneer firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable FIORI/UI5 code.
Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
Work closely with the SAP team to implement and deploy SAP FIORI applications.
Collaborate with back-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
Utilize Git for version control and collaboration with team members.
Write clean, maintainable, and documented code with solid test coverage.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends.
Qualifications:
5-8 years of experience in FIORI/UI5 development.
Proficient in SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAPM).
Strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.
Expertise in CSS and JavaScript for creating visually appealing and responsive designs.
Familiarity with Node.js is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growthAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choicesDo you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise-wide technology modernization strategies, target-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end-to-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:

Modernization Strategy Value Agenda: Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes Technology Estate Application Portfolio Assessment: Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio-level priorities Target Architecture Modernization Pathways: Shape target-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation Modernization Roadmap, Business Case Decision Governance: Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade-offs and realize measurable business value

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.

The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.

The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.

The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long-term architecture fit.

Key Responsibilities


Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap


Lead enterprise-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes

Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business-aligned technology modernization priorities

Assess current-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems

Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools

Shape target-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction

Define modernization guiding principles, decision prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices

Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners

Build multi-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness

Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed-to-market


Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture Planning


Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential

Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities

Define application modernization pathways for target applications

Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options

Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies

Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity

Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API-led integration, microservices, event-driven architecture, cloud-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform-based modernization

Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future-ready application architecture

Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


Executive advisory and Growth


Lead CxO-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade-offs and enterprise transformation decisions

Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions

Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership-ready points of view

Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive-ready solution narratives

Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client

Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks

Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


Core Skillsets Tools

Technology Modernization Advisory

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job DescriptionA self-driven target oriented individual role with a mix of both Direct and Channel sourcing, involved in building and setting up a network of Channel partners. Key roles and responsibilities Daily visits to and follow-up with the Educational Institutions falling within the target segment, desirous of seeking a loan.
1. Building a healthy pipeline of logins and sanctions w.r.t the assigned sales target for both Direct and Channel Sourcing.
2. Achieving the target assigned on a month-on-month basis.
3. Understanding the Customers loan requirement and helping them as a SPOC in the end-to-end loan journey from login to disbursement.

8. Active involvement in fulfilment of the required documents by the Credit and Operations team during the login, approval and disbursement / post disbursement process.
9. Scouting and onboarding potential Channel partners to source business for Credila.
10.Maintaining the portfolio quality at all times by sourcing quality logins as per the defined product and credit policy and ensuring customers regularly pay the EMI dues in time.
11. Active involvement in collection of overdue EMIs from the customers.
12.Building a healthy relationship with all the Customers in the mapped portfolio to fulfill their future loan requirements and prevent them from going to the competition i.e. retention.
13. Deliver quality Customer Service and generate referrals from existing customers.
14. Cross-selling of Insurance & other allied products

Description:
Role: Devops and Cloud L3 & Architect
Exp: 7yrs to 18yrs
Location Flex: Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Shift: Rotational
Mode of Working: Hybrid

Mandatory Skill to Apply: Devops + Multi Cloud( Any 2- AWS/Azure/GCP) + CI/CD or Jenkins + Git + IAC (Terraform or Automation or Ansible)

Core / Must-Have Skills:-

Strong CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps
Strong hands-on Terraform
Docker & Kubernetes
At least one managed Kubernetes platform: EKS / AKS / GKE
Helm and/or Argo CD
Python and/or Shell/Bash scripting
Practical experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
DevSecOps pipeline integration
Monitoring/observability experience
Git and modern branching/deployment strategies
Strong troubleshooting skills across application delivery and cloud environments

Detailed JD:

The Multi-Cloud DevOps, DevSecOps & Platform Engineer will design, build, automate and support modern software delivery and cloud platform solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role requires strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud platforms, observability and automation. The engineer will collaborate with application, cloud, security and operations teams to build secure, scalable and reusable deployment solutions while improving release reliability and engineering efficiency.
Candidates should have strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to additional cloud platforms and multi-cloud environments is preferred.
1. CI/CD & DevOps Engineering
Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and/or Jenkins.
Implement Git-based workflows, reusable pipeline templates, artifact management, environment promotion, approvals and rollback mechanisms.
Implement GitOps deployment practices using Argo CD and Helm for Kubernetes workloads.
Integrate automated testing, code-quality checks and security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures and improve build and release efficiency.
Build reusable pipeline components and automation to support consistent software delivery.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Build reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, versions, variables and environment configurations.
Implement IaC validation, testing and configuration/drift-management practices.
Use Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation where required.
Develop Python and Shell/Bash automation for infrastructure provisioning, API integration and Day-2 operational activities.
Automate repeatable infrastructure and platform activities to reduce manual intervention.
3. DevSecOps & Security Automation
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, container/image scanning and secrets detection.
Implement secure artifact, container image and dependency-management practices.
Integrate secrets-management and key-management solutions with pipelines and application deployments.
Apply appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles for pipeline and runtime identities.
Work with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Support automated security and compliance validation within the software delivery lifecycle.
4. Multi-Cloud & PaaS Engineering
Implement DevOps and deployment solutions across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Work with relevant PaaS and serverless services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions.
Support application teams with standardized approaches for build, deployment, configuration, secrets, networking and monitoring.
Leverage cloud-native services while maintaining reusable and consistent DevOps practices.
Support hybrid and multi-cloud deployment requirements where applicable.
5. Containers, Kubernetes & GitOps
Build, deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Implement Kubernetes application packaging and deployments using Helm and Argo CD.
Configure deployments, autoscaling, ingress, secrets, configuration and application upgrade strategies.
Integrate container/image scanning and Kubernetes security controls into CI/CD processes.
Troubleshoot application deployment, container and Kubernetes platform issues across environments.
6. Observability & SRE Practices
Implement monitoring and observability across applications, infrastructure and Kubernetes using Datadog, Dynatrace and/or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Configure and manage metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts.
Support SLI/SLO-based monitoring, incident management and operational runbooks.
Automate common operational, monitoring and remediation activities.
Analyze telemetry to improve application reliability, deployment stability and platform performance.
Participate in incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous reliability improvements.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.

Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

4. Technical Skills: Expertise in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and algorithm development.
5. Education: Typically requires a Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

Drive practice growth through GTM development, solution innovation, proposal leadership, and AI opportunity origination.

Experience defining AI governance, Responsible AI, AI risk, and compliance frameworks.

C-suite advisory experience on operating-model and process change
Working knowledge of AI governance and regulation

Qualifications & Certifications

An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Position Title: Credit Research
Experience Level: 3+ Years
Department: Investment Research
Location: Gurgaon / Bangalore / Pune
Position reports to: Associate Director
Job Summary
We are seeking intelligent, independent, and self-motivated individuals to be part of our Fundamental Credit Research team - one of the fastest growing vertical of the company.
The candidate should have a subject matter expertise in covering the Banking and Insurance sector; an experience in covering sovereign and supranational issuers would be an added advantage. The analyst would be responsible for providing issuer rating/recommendation on the issuers under her/his portfolio. This would be achieved through detailed fundamental review, by initiating and maintaining coverage on issuers through detailed models and preparing the investment summary report. The candidate should demonstrate ability to think on feet, adapt to situation and provide actionable investment commentary and opinion on the issuers.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skill as there will be a daily interaction with the on-shore investment managers.
The individual will be part of the Fixed Income team based out of Bangalore. The team covers a wide variety of fixed income instrument issuers spanning across global, sectors and asset classes.
Responsibilities
Initiating coverage on issuers by building detailed credit specific models and initiation reports
Preparing opinionated research piece on key events, tracking quarterly earnings on companies under coverage
Liaise with investor relations to seek responses and understand key issues
Responsible for client interaction and managing client expectations
Timely updation of sector dashboards
Core Skills / Competencies
Subject matter expertise in Banking and Insurance
Good verbal and written communication skills
Ability to provide actionable commentary and opinion on key events, issuers, rating recommendations
Understanding of the capital structure of bank and instrument tiering
Education: MBA (Finance), CFA and FRM is an added advantage
Job requires extremely high level of attention to detail, meticulousness and accountability
Abide by TAT and improve customer satisfaction over the period

Overview
AtkinsRalis, is one of the world's leading multi-disciplinary consultancies. Our Clean Water Networks team is one of the longest established specialist teams of its kind, providing consultancy and field support services to clients for the operation, performance and management of clean water networks in UK. Due to our continuing expansion we currently have an opportunity for Lead Engineer for offshore executed projects from India.
The successful candidate will join a team of hydraullic modellers and civil engineers and play in its expansion and projects delivery. This is an ideal opportunity for individuals looking to lead the project teams with a world renowned consultant.
Your role
Work as part of AtkinsRealis' Clean Water (CW) team.
Lead the delivery of a range of projects relating to network modelling, water infrastructure design and planning from Bangalore office.
Lead day to day liaison with our UK PMs and engineers to ensure project deliverables are developed in accordance with client scope, budget, timescales and quality requirements.
Drive innovation and digital delivery culture to the next level.
Carryout check and review of the projects, assuring quality delivery right first time.
Support the technical development of Engineers, Technicians and Graduates.
Support the Team Leader with resource and other management duties.
Provide support to business development activates like bid preparations, presentations to potential clients etc.
About you
Bachelor or Master's Degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering from a recognized University.
Professional accreditation from ICE or CIWEM.
Minimum 10 years' experience, preferably based on delivering projects to the UK Water Industry.
Sufficient and appropriate experience of working within a technical environment (Water projects)
Able to independently work on data processing and analysis to a high standard.
The ability to develop innovative solutions to engineering problems.
Working knowledge of software such as InfoWorks, Epanet, SynerGee, Aquis and MapInfo.
Working knowledge of British Standards is desirable.
Computer literacy e.g. Word, Excel and Outlook.
Excellent English spoken and written skills within a business environment.
Working to defined timescales and following an approved methodology will be key features of the role.
Demonstrable track record of technical achievement and client satisfaction within the water industry.
Ability to apply technical knowledge in analysing problems and creating solutions.
Willingness to travel to the UK for short term assignments and training.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments.
Ability to build rapport with customers and colleagues.
Well-motivated and able to work as part of a team or on individual assignments when required.
Able to work and communicate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Flexible approach to work.
Ability to work on your own initiative.
Strong attention to detail and ability to make correct judgment.

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.
Your role
We are looking for a Principal Transport Planner (Strategic Modelling) to join our team. This role will be based at our AtkinsRalis office in Bangalore/Gurgaon, India.
Appropriate academic and professional qualifications (Bachelor's Degree with Master's degree in transport planning / economics).
Working experience (16+ years) in Transport Planning software like VISUM, SATURN, DIADEM, EMME.
Experience and knowledge of Strategic Modelling techniques and guidance.
Knowledge and experience in delivering transport planning/modelling projects for UK/ME/ USA/ Canada/ Australia regions.
Strong Analytical skills with experience in handling and interpreting complex datasets.
Experience in scripting using like Python, Excel-VBA and R.
Strong understanding of ArcGIS/QGIS, PowerBI and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work in a team as part of a wider project with no supervision.
Experience in leading smaller teams as part of a project delivery.
Good written communication skills.
Be able to delegate the tasks.
About you
Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
Be able to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
Experience in the use of analytical and research tools such as GIS and the use of databases.
Appreciation of the transport industry and related policy context.
Professional membership of a relevant institution.
Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue
by onboarding new apartment complexes and societies into NoBrokerHood by meeting with prospective clients in
person and explaining the product.
Job Description:-



Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

Meet prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, and emphasize product features and
benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices
Meet with Committee Members of Apartments and Societies,accounting services partners and builders to
understand the scope of business and their expectations.




Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities
Onboarding new apartments on the NoBrokerHood platform will be a major KRA.
Researching potential leads from the open market, web searches, or digital resources.
Mandatory requirements for this position





Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location
will be a plus).






Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.
Geographical knowledge of the job location is an added advantage.
What we have to offer!

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Uncapped variables based on performance

Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions for the outstanding performers

Overview
Atkinsrealis is one of the largest engineering and design consultancy in the UK, the largest multidisciplinary consultancy in Europe and one of the largest design firms in the world.
This key post will be based out of Bangalore/Mumbai office and will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience and problem-solving skills whilst providing good opportunities.
We are seeking a motivated Landscape Irrigation Design Engineer to support the design and development of irrigation/ wet utility team. To perform this role successfully, the candidate will be responsible for but not limited to the following:


Your role
2-4 years of experience in the Landscape Irrigation.
Experience of working in the Irrigation / water Industry.
Positive Attitude and eagerness to learn and use new irrigation/ water related design software's, tools and processes for automation and digital efficiency as per the project and business requirement.
Familiarity with Middle East / BS or similar international Codes of Practice
Hands on experience of various software's - Revit, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Navisworks and WaterGEMS
Good ability to use Irrigation / water related design software's, tools and processes for automation and digital efficiency.
Good understanding of various design standards and its application in the Landscape and Irrigation industry.
Bachelor's degree/Master's degree in Engineering from an institute of repute.
Clear knowledge of work procedures, and ability to brief project team on them.
Good written and verbal English language communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with colleagues, seniors, team members and clients.
Experience of major Infrastructure projects at feasibility and detailed design stages.
A team player and work in collaboration.


About you
Perform flow calculations and water demand analysis for landscape irrigation systems.
Assist in preparing design reports and technical documentation.
Assist and develop irrigation specifications based on project requirements and standards.
Prepare and maintain valve schedules.
Support the creation and validation of hydraulic models for irrigation networks.
Plan and design irrigation network routing, including pipelines, valves, and control systems.
Coordinate with BIM team for design integration.
Ensure designs comply with local regulations, standards, and sustainability practices.
Develop Concept, Preliminary, Detailed design, related calculations and drawings.
Involve in clash analysis, resolution and work on federated 3Dmodels
Able to perform good self-checks. And support in team development, skill enhancement.
Apply Atkins Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


Rewards benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. We support integration of renewables, digital engineering, and global compliance standards to ensure reliable and sustainable energy delivery.
The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical BIM Designer with 8 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.


Your role
Key Responsibilities
Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.
Develop substation layouts and infrastructure drawings including power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.


About you
Technical Competencies
Essential
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.
Strong understanding of CAD/BIM standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.
Behavioural Competencies
Strong communication and report-writing skills.
Team-oriented with leadership potential.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
Proactive in career development and team contribution.
Assertive and responsive to client requirements.
Able to manage and motivate teams effectively.

Job Description


Overview

We are looking for an experienced Civil, Structures and Pipeline engineers with a strong background in the Water and Wastewater industry to support the delivery of major infrastructure and non-Infrastructure projects and utility frameworks. The role requires experience across the full project lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through detailed design and construction support, where international experience and primarily UK / Ireland experience is preferred.
You will work closely with clients, contractors, Lead office outside India and multidisciplinary engineering teams, taking responsibility for technical delivery, coordination of complex interfaces and high-quality engineering solutions. The role also provides opportunities to lead projects, mentor junior staff and contribute to major UK water infrastructure programmes.
You will be a self-motivated and accountable professional with strong analytical, stakeholder-management, client-facing and communication skills. Chartered Engineer status, or a commitment to achieving Chartership, would be advantageous.



Your Role

Lead the design and delivery of water, wastewater, stormwater, and utility infrastructure projects, including pumping stations, reservoirs, detention tanks, manholes, outfalls, headworks, and storm overflow chambers.
Prepare, review, and approve civil and structural designs, calculations, specifications, reports, drawings, and Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).
Design large-diameter pipelines, trunk mains, rising mains, gravity sewers, valve chambers, flow control structures, and associated buried infrastructure.
Design reinforced concrete and structural steel structures, including liquid-retaining structures, treatment units, retaining walls, and associated facilities.
Develop and coordinate site layouts, drainage systems, earthworks, grading plans, utility diversions, and route selection studies.
Utilize and coordinate within BIM and 3D design environments, conducting clash detection and interdisciplinary coordination using tools such as Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, and Autodesk Robot.
Support hydraulic modelling, network planning, capacity assessments, flood risk studies, and infrastructure improvement programs.
Manage project scope, design risks, schedules, budgets, quality assurance processes, and compliance with relevant standards, including UK Health Safety and CDM requirements.
Provide construction-phase support, including technical query resolution, RFIs, constructability reviews, and site coordination.
Lead multidisciplinary teams and mentor junior engineers while coordinating with Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Process, ICA, Geotechnical, and BIM disciplines.


About You

Bachelor's degree in civil engineering is required, with a Master's degree in Environmental or Structural Engineering considered advantageous.
6+ years of professional experience in the design and delivery of water, wastewater, stormwater, and utility infrastructure projects, preferably including UK/European and Design Build projects.
Strong expertise in water and wastewater infrastructure, including pipelines, pumping stations, reservoirs, water-retaining structures, drainage systems, and utility networks.
Sound knowledge of pipework design, site development, drainage, earthworks, site grading, buried infrastructure, and utility coordination.
Experience in the structural design of reinforced concrete and steel structures, including liquid-retaining and wastewater treatment facilities.
Good working knowledge of Eurocodes, British Standards, industry best practices, and relevant design standards.
Proficient in preparing and reviewing engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, design reports, reinforcement detailing, and BBS.
Experience with hydraulic modelling, GIS applications, BIM/3D coordination, clash detection, and engineering software such as Autodesk Robot or equivalent tools.
Strong multidisciplinary coordination and design management skills, with experience managing design changes, QA processes, constructability reviews, and construction support.
Knowledge of pipeline hydraulics, route optimization, trenchless construction methods (HDD, pipe jacking, micro-tunnelling), and utility asset management would be advantageous.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.

Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
