Description:
The Educator, Art Labs will lead and facilitate impactful, art-based learning sessions in classrooms, promoting creative expression and social-emotional development among children. This role will involve regular observation and documentation of classroom dynamics and student engagement. This role will shape the holistic growth of the children by driving a community-building movement in our model school, thereby creating strong evidence on art and SEL in classrooms.


Roles and Responsibilities

1. School Scouting and Art Lab Development
Identify and visit potential schools where Art Labs can be set up.
Assess schools based on available space, infrastructure, student strength, school leadership, and readiness to support an Art Lab.
Meet principals and teachers to understand the schools needs and assess the feasibility of setting up and sustaining an Art Lab.
Document school visits and share findings to support school selection and planning for Art Lab setup.
Coordinate with selected schools to support the setup of Art Labs and their integration into regular school activities.


2. Government Engagement and Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain relationships with relevant state and district government officials, including the Education Department, SCERT, DIET, and other relevant institutions.
Share SArCs approach and work with government stakeholders and explore opportunities to establish and strengthen Art Labs in schools.
Coordinate with government officials, funders, and school leadership to facilitate school visits, address implementation needs, and support program delivery.
Work with artists, volunteers, and creative professionals to bring additional art experiences to children.


3. Art Facilitation and Classroom Engagement
Facilitate joyful and inclusive art sessions for children from Grades 1 to 8 throughout the academic year.
Adapt existing art lesson plans to suit childrens needs, interests, and classroom contexts while keeping the intended learning outcomes in mind.
Create a classroom environment where children feel comfortable expressing themselves, sharing ideas and exploring their creativity.
Guide children through reflection and discussion to help them express their thoughts, listen to others, and develop self-awareness.
Design visual teaching aids and lead school-wide art projects, exhibitions and installations that give children opportunities to explore relevant social and community themes through art.


4. Field Observations and Research
Conduct school visits and structured classroom observations to understand how art education is practised, and the challenges schools and teachers face.
Collect information through classroom observations, interviews with teachers and school leaders, and other research tools as required.
Support research studies on art education, teaching practices, student engagement and the implementation of Art Labs.
Prepare field visit reports, case studies and summaries of findings, highlighting challenges, patterns and practices that can inform program decisions.
Work with the Research and Impact team to plan school visits, collect data and maintain accurate records.


5. Curriculum and Monitoring and Evaluation (ME)
Work closely with the Curriculum and ME teams to share feedback from classrooms and schools on the relevance, suitability, and implementation of art activities.
Identify gaps in lesson plans, teaching resources and facilitation approaches based on classroom experiences, teacher feedback and student participation.
Share specific recommendations on what needs to change in the curriculum, activities or teaching resources to meet childrens needs better and address classroom realities.
Support the Curriculum team in reviewing and testing revised activities and resources, and share feedback on their effectiveness.
Work with the ME team to document classroom observations, track student progress, and assess whether sessions are meeting their intended outcomes.
Maintain relevant program records, including classroom dashboards, field notes, and documentation of childrens work, to support program review and improvement.


Qualifications and Experience
A graduate degree in Education, Arts, Child Development, or a related field is required. A postgraduate degree is an added advantage.
3-4 years of experience in teaching and classroom facilitation, preferably in creative learning or arts-integrated settings.
Experience working with low-income or underserved school communities will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of child-centred pedagogy, experiential learning and childrens social-emotional development.
Experience in classroom observation, documentation and using feedback or data to improve teaching and learning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work with children, teachers, school leaders, government stakeholders and internal teams.
Alignment with Saturday Art Classs vision of making arts education an integral part of public school education.
Skills and Mindset
Facilitation and empathy: Creates inclusive spaces where children feel safe to express themselves and explore their creativity.
Curriculum adaptation: Can work with art-based curricula and adapt activities and lesson plans to suit childrens needs, abilities and classroom contexts while keeping learning objectives in mind.
Ownership and organisation: Takes responsibility for tasks and outcomes, manages multiple priorities and meets deadlines with minimal supervision.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.

Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.

Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.

Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.

Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.

100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.

About theTeam
Our Salesteam is at the forefront of driving business growth by building strongrelationships with retailers and expanding Redington's market presence. Theteam works closely with channel partners and customers to deliver technologysolutions while ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfactionacross assigned territories.
Who WereLooking For
We're lookingfor a results-driven sales professional with a passion for building customerrelationships and achieving ambitious business targets. The ideal candidatethrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong ownership, and iscommitted to driving growth through effective territory management.
Your Role
As aTerritory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-endDirect-to-Retail business within your assigned territory. You will identify andonboard key retail partners, drive sales and collections, strengthen customerrelationships, and ensure consistent market coverage to achieve businessobjectives.

Drive end-to-end Direct-to-Retail business for the assigned territory.
Identify, onboard, and develop business with high-potential retail partners.
Achieve assigned sales, revenue, and collection targets while ensuring adherence to approved credit limits.
Execute regular daily and weekly market coverage plans to maximize business opportunities.
Travel extensively within the assigned territory to engage with retailers and expand market reach.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships by understanding business needs and providing timely resolutions to concerns.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to identify growth opportunities.
Ensure effective execution of sales initiatives, promotions, and business development programs.
Youre theRight Fit If
You are a graduate from a recognized institution.
You have proven experience in territory sales, preferably in a Direct-to-Retail environment.
You possess a strong understanding of the retail market and channel ecosystem.
You have a consistent track record of achieving sales and collection targets.
You are comfortable working in a dynamic, target-driven environment with frequent travel.
You demonstrate excellent analytical, communication, and customer relationship management skills.
You have a continuous learning mindset and are eager to adapt to evolving business needs.

Description:
The position assists with the soliciting and handling of sales opportunities.
Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives.
Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include participating on sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Assists with managing and developing relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Assists in closing the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Cluster Manager - JD
About Company Cult.fit is a mobile app that takes a holistic approach towards health and fitness by bringing together all aspects of a healthy lifestyle on a single platform. Cult.fit offers both online and offline experiences across fitness, nutrition and mental wellbeing all across India and now are present in 130+ locations across Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad. We are now standing at 600+ and many more to come!

Gym - Sales and Operations Sales/Revenue:

Drive offline sales at centers to deliver revenue targets on a regular basis
Work with the central offline sales team to plan and execute initiatives at the center
Represent data on excel, and use data to report and review performance
Regular governance at business unit and execute interventions
Work on conversion and lead generation activities at the center through center managers Operations:
Implement and drive adherence to the prescribed SOPs
Ensure uniformity in experience across company and franchise operated Cult Gym setups
Handle conflicts and escalations (Internal and External) within specified timelines to ensure seamless operations
Conducting audits and spend time on-ground to ensure that the facilities are always new and always functional
ensure high center & equipment maintenance standards by working with on ground and facilities teams
Seamlessly roll out new operations processes by being the bridge between central and on ground teams People:
Responsible for ensuring that the resourcing/hiring is in line with the design number (CMs and Trainers)
Regular Performance management, mentoring and coaching of the team
Constantly share feedback received from members and trainers with central teams
Liaise with stakeholders (internal and external) to unblock and problem solve for issues wherever necessary
Lead by example and champion a positive work environment at the ground level.
AboutCompany: About Cult -  Curefit Healthcare Pvt Ltd, founded in 2016, is India's largest fitness company and wellness platform. Cult, from the house of Curefit, was established with a mission to make fitness easy, fun and accessible to everyone, and has emerged as a community celebrating the joy of fitness. The brand today offers a range of fitness services ranging from group workouts, gyms and personalized fitness solutions, as well as an expansive selection of quality fitness products for the everyday athlete. The companys vision is to empower everyone towards an active and healthier lifestyle through innovative fitness solutions, enabled by technology.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-driven Assistant Manager – Key Accounts (Inside Sales) to lead a high-performing team of 15-20 associates and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and own end-to-end account management
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Retention, and Account Management, with a proven track record of achieving challenging business and growth targets. You should have a strong understanding of the sales funnel and complete sales lifecycle, along with the ability to coach and develop large sales teams that become trusted advisors for our client partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage, and motivate a team of 15-20 Inside Sales/Key Account associates.
Own and deliver revenue, sales, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the team.
Develop and execute strategies to drive account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention - own the sales retention funnel to drive SoW gain and increase order frequency 
Drive performance across the entire sales lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
Analyze sales metrics, team productivity, revenue performance, conversion ratios, retention, and other key KPIs. Identify performance gaps and implement structured sales training, coaching, and improvement plans.
Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles to improve individual and team performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Build forecasting mechanisms and ensure accurate tracking of pipeline, revenue, and growth targets.
Establish a strong performance-oriented culture focused on customer retention, revenue growth, productivity, and conversion.
Have a pulse on the voice of the customer that could help build critical product/experience improvements to build client stickiness on the platform 
What We’re Looking For
3+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Inside Sales / Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Retention.
Prior experience managing a large sales team of 30+ members is highly preferred.
Proven experience of managing and delivering revenue and growth targets.
Strong understanding of the inside sales process, sales funnel, and end-to-end sales lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience in customer retention, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to sales and team management.
Excellent people-management, coaching, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
Strong understanding of sales metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per associate, productivity, pipeline, retention, churn, and achievement against target.
Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.

Position Title: Area HR Partner- Upper North (Third Party Contractual)

Reports to: Lead HR Retail (North and East)

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

Job Description: The Client Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Key Responsibilities:

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring
Analyzeandsupport with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts

Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs

Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular
PTL freight movement needs.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Vendor Acquisition & Onboarding: Identify, evaluate, and onboard fleet vendors to support business expansion and operational efficiency.
Scaling & Network Expansion: Develop strategies to scale vendor partnerships across multiple regions, ensuring adequate fleet availability.
Community Engagement: Organize and lead community meetups in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities to educate and encourage drivers to transition into fleet ownership.
Government Coordination: Work closely with government agencies and employment programs to source and hire blue-collar drivers efficiently.
Performance Management: Track vendor performance metrics (SLAs, compliance, cost efficiency) and implement improvement initiatives.
Process Optimization: Streamline vendor onboarding, contract management, and operational workflows to reduce inefficiencies.
Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all fleet vendors adhere to regulatory requirements, safety standards, and company policies.
Stakeholder Coordination: Work closely with internal teams (Operations, Finance, Compliance) to align vendor strategies with business goals

Person Specifications- Skillsets/Education:
Functional Skills Operations Management, Data Analysis, Stakeholder Management
Experience - Relevant experience in Logistics/ Manufacturing industry.
Behavioral Skills - Good communication and people management, analytical skills, task prioritization and follow-up, Hustler, Go-Getter attitude
Exposure to work in /Ability to work well in a team environment. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders for business purposes/in order to gain credibility with senior management.

*Should be open for extensive travel.

Description:
Commissioning Engineer (Project Engineer/ Sr. Project Engineer/ Team Lead- New Installation)
Your main responsibilities
The Project Engineer creates operational added value through the implementation of the installation process to meet the business targets.
Key responsibilities include:
Plan and execute the installation and commissioning of elevators and escalators in accordance with the defined budget, timelines, Schindler Safety & Quality standards and Company procedures.
Plan the jobs and provide supervision to FTs and sub-contractor workers for timely completion of the project.
Co-ordinate with the Sales representative, Logistics team for material, engineering team for troubleshooting and service team for smooth handover.
Manage tasks to achieve the objectives and ensure high customer satisfaction throughout the entire duration of the works.
Comply with Fulfillment Plus documentation.
What you bring
Desired experience in installations in elevator andescalator industry for at least three to five years.
Desired Organization and Planning skills, elevatorand escalator industry knowledge in product, fieldexperience, safety & quality procedures knowledge,English Speaking and Basic IT skills.
Bachelors degree or Diploma in Technical,Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
Whats in it for you
Join our purpose-driven organization. Help shape an industry in which two billion people rely on our products and services every day.
Your development matters to us. We help you grow by offering the support you need to develop your skills and access a rewarding and fulfilling career.
Thrive in a diverse and supportive culture. Through local and global initiatives, we promote a culture of inclusion which celebrates diversity and ensures that everyone feels valued.

About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the role:
To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.
Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area (Rural) of operations.
2. Visibility and Accountability through sale of the financial products.
3. Identify and recruit the sales team (FSE) to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.
11. Sale of cross sales product to existing and new merchants like Merchant Loan, Personal Loan, GOLD SIP etc along with Upgrades for the merchant
12. Good understanding of lending products
13. Able to train and groom the manpower allocated to him
Education :
Graduate or above / Post Graduation preferred.

Why join us:
1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
2. Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3. A solid 360-degree feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story.

Pathologist-Full Time
Patna
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL & other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Description:
Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development.
Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process
- Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
- Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
- Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
- Networks with local organizations (eg, Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
- Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.
- Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.
Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits
- Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
- Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.
- Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.
Assisting in Managing Employee Development
- Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
- Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
- Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations
- Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (eg, develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
- Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
- Utilizes an open door policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
- Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
- Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices
- Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
- Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
- Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
- Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
- Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
- Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (eg, property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc
- Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
- Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Position: Field Officer / Centre Manager
Industry: Microfinance / Financial Services
Location: Bihar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 0–3 years (Freshers can also apply for Field Officer roles)
Job Description
We are looking for Field Officers / Centre Managers to join our microfinance operations in Bihar. The candidate will be responsible for managing customers/groups, conducting field visits, ensuring timely loan repayments, and supporting business growth while maintaining high service and compliance standards.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct regular field visits and customer meetings.
Identify and onboard new customers and form JLG/SHG groups.
Explain loan products, repayment schedules and company policies to customers.
Conduct customer verification and ensure proper KYC/documentation.
Manage centre meetings and maintain customer relationships.
Ensure timely collection of loan instalments.
Follow up on overdue accounts and maintain portfolio quality.
Monitor customer repayment behaviour and identify potential risks.
Resolve customer queries and complaints professionally.
Maintain accurate records and submit daily/weekly reports.
Achieve assigned business and collection targets.
Follow company policies, ethical collection practices and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Candidate Profile
Minimum 12th pass / Graduate preferred.
Experience in microfinance, banking, NBFC, sales or field collection will be an advantage.
Freshers with good communication skills may apply for Field Officer positions.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Basic knowledge of smartphones and mobile applications.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.
Knowledge of Hindi and local language/dialect preferred.
Candidates should be target-oriented, responsible and comfortable working in rural/semi-urban areas.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sit at the PMJAY help desk and welcome patients and attendants, explaining the scheme, its benefits, and the cashless treatment process in simple Hindi and the local language.
2. Verify beneficiary eligibility through the Beneficiary Identification System (BIS) using Aadhaar, ration card, PMJAY e-card, or other approved documents.
3. Help eligible patients obtain or generate their Ayushman card through the approved process, or guide them to the nearest enrolment centre.
4. Register patients on the Transaction Management System (TMS) and carry out pre-authorization requests for packages that need it.
5. Coordinate with treating doctors and clinical staff to select the correct package and collect required documents, investigation reports, and clinical notes.
6. Upload treatment records, photographs, and discharge summaries, and follow up on claim submission, queries, and approvals within the stipulated timelines.
7. Make sure eligible patients receive cashless treatment, and report any case of illegal charging or denial of service to the hospital management.
8. Counsel patients and families on treatment coverage, the documents they need, expected stay, and what to do at discharge.
9. Support the hospital's PMJAY nodal officer and billing team in tracking claim status, rejections, and recovery of pending claims.
10. Keep daily records of patients counselled, registered, and discharged under the scheme, and submit MIS reports as required.
11. Take part in health awareness and enrolment drives, and refer patients to other government schemes where relevant.
12. Handle patient grievances politely and escalate them to the hospital management or the State Health Agency (SHA), Bihar helpline when needed.
13. Protect patient confidentiality and follow all National Health Authority (NHA) guidelines, SOPs, and data security rules.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Social Work, Public Health, Hospital Administration, Nursing, or Health Sciences is preferred.
Experience of at least 2-5 years in a hospital help desk, insurance desk, TPA, or health scheme setting (freshers with training may be considered).
Preferably certified or trained as a Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM) / Ayushman Mitra by the NHA or State Health Agency.

Description:
To provide high-quality psychological assessment, short-term counselling, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions to outpatients and inpatients. The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.

Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist

with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.

rates.

metrics.

Mentor and support quality professionals where applicable.

Analyze customer complaints, feedback, and quality concerns.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction.
Translate customer expectations into manufacturing process improvements.

Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.
Conduct process audits and compliance assessments.
Ensure adherence to quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Train manufacturing teams on quality management practices and risk mitigation methods.

Conduct Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
Identify manufacturing and assembly process risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation plans.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to eliminate potential quality failures.
Monitor effectiveness of risk controls and preventive actions.
Maintain and update risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle.
Manage change control activities related to:
Product features
Manufacturing processes
Materials
Suppliers
Design modifications

Implement quality control plans and inspection requirements.
Conduct process audits, inspections, and verification activities.
Analyze test results, measurements, and statistical quality data.
Identify trends and improvement opportunities through data analysis.
Recommend and implement corrective actions to improve quality performance.

Monitor key process performance indicators.
Analyze manufacturing performance data and trends.
Support implementation of Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques.
Maintain process performance documentation.
Drive corrective and preventive actions to improve process capability and efficiency.
Train operators and manufacturing teams on performance monitoring methods.

Investigate process and product non-conformities.
Lead root cause analyses using structured problem-solving methodologies such as:
8D
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Statistical Analysis Tools
Implement and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Process capability
Product quality
Productivity
Cost efficiency
Operational performance

Facilitate waste reduction and process optimization activities.
Prioritize and execute improvement projects based on business impact.

Quality risk identification and mitigation.
PFMEA development and maintenance.
Manufacturing quality assurance activities.
Process audit execution.
Quality performance monitoring.
Continuous improvement project execution.
Supporting customer quality requirements and compliance.

Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).

Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Associate Consultant - Risk - Internal Audit
Job Summary
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract.
You will be responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of governance, risk compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance.
Responsibilities
Execution on client engagement - Ensure quality delivery as per client requirements.
Review of working papers and client folders. Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Understand business industry issues / trends. Identify areas requiring improvement in the clients business processes to enable preparation of recommendations.
Handling data analytics - Access, ACL etc.
Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.
Develop strong working relationships with client (process owner/functional heads).
Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Brief the engagement team on the client's IA environment and industry IA trends.
Maintain relationships with client management to manage expectations of service, including work products, timing, and deliverables.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of compliance, financial, and operational risks along with performing internal control testing, develop internal audit plans, and provide internal audit services on an outsourcing basis.
Assess internal controls and SOX framework in order to mitigate risk and apply it to client situations.
Bring and utilize extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business.
Skills and Competencies
Data analytics
Internal audit
GRC
SOX
Process improvement
Stakeholder relationship management
Knowledge management
Methodology development
Budget management

Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP

Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Procurement Compliance & Governance Own and enforce compliance with sourcing policies, approval thresholds, controls, and governance frameworks. Ensure correct usage of procurement tools, approved workflows, and standardized processes, including SAP Ariba and ServiceNow. Act as an escalation point for contract compliance and ensure contracts accurately reflect approved commercial and legal positions. Perform compliance checks across SOW, CR, Purchase Request, and Sourcing Request processes and maintain audit-ready documentation. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Security, IT, and Audit teams to protect governance integrity and mitigate risk. Page 2 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions 4. Supplier & Contract Management Lead supplier evaluation, selection, onboarding, and performance management based on category strategy and defined criteria. Drive supplier consolidation, innovation, performance improvement, cost efficiency, and long-term value creation. Manage supplier risks using structured governance, KPIs, scorecards, and quarterly business reviews. Build strategic partnerships with global suppliers across North America, Europe, and other relevant geographies. 5. Value Creation & Continuous Improvement Identify and implement improvements across sourcing and procurement operations. Drive demand optimization, supplier rationalization, AI-enabled sourcing, RFx optimization, and intake workflow automation. Develop reusable sourcing frameworks, templates, playbooks, and best practices. Support procurement transformation and maturity-building initiatives within the GCC. 6. Stakeholder Management Advise and influence global stakeholders and category leads to shape sourcing strategies and optimize outcomes. Collaborate with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, IT Directors and VPs, Information Security, and business teams across geographies. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Mentorship & Team Support Act as a senior mentor and knowledge leader within the Buying Desk. Guide junior team members on complex sourcing events, negotiations, contracting challenges, and problem-solving. Drive knowledge sharing, capability development, and procurement upskilling initiatives. POSITION SUMMARY
Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: Driver s License

market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.

building skills.

extensive field travel.

structure.

institution.
