Description:
Role & responsibilities

To ensure that all loose grocery staples (rice, wheat, pulses, spices, sugar, flour, etc.) are
processed and packed in the factory to meet FSSAI and regulatory standards and company
quality standards before reaching customers.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Raw Material Quality Checks
• Inspect incoming loose staples for quality parameters (moisture, infestation, purity,
grain size, colour, odour, foreign matter).
• Verify supplier quality certificates and conduct sampling/testing.
2. In-Process Quality Control
• Monitor packing lines to ensure correct weight, sealing, labelling, batch coding, and
hygiene.
• Ensure FEFO/FIFO practices in usage of raw materials and packaging materials.
• Conduct line clearance checks before production runs.
3. Finished Goods Quality
• Inspect packed products for compliance with defined standards (net weight,
labelling, shelf life, seal integrity).
• Retain samples for shelf-life studies.
4. Food Safety & Compliance
• Ensure the factory follows FSSAI, HACCP, GMP, and hygiene norms.
• Monitor pest control, sanitation, and staff hygiene.
• Support internal/external quality audits.
5. Documentation & Reporting
• Maintain inspection logs, QC reports, and non-conformance records.
• Raise corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with production & purchase teams.

Job Description Factory / Plant Manager:
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Factory / Plant Manager to lead the overall operations of our manufacturing plant. The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient production, quality, safety, regulatory compliance, cost control, and effective people management.
The incumbent will work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Supply Chain, HR and other functions to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations while maintaining statutory and company standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Plant & Production Management
Lead end-to-end plant operations and ensure achievement of production targets.
Plan and monitor production schedules, capacity utilization and operational efficiency.
Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, materials and other resources.
Monitor production losses, downtime, wastage and overall plant productivity.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.
2. Quality, Food Safety & Compliance
Ensure adherence to applicable quality, food safety, statutory and regulatory requirements.
Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality systems, safety standards and audit requirements.
Coordinate with Quality teams to maintain product quality and hygiene standards.
Ensure timely closure of observations arising from internal, external and regulatory audits.
Maintain necessary plant documentation, records and compliance requirements.
3. Maintenance & Engineering Coordination
Coordinate with Engineering/Maintenance teams to ensure maximum machine availability.
Monitor preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
Identify recurring equipment issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure proper planning of maintenance activities without impacting production.
4. People Management
Lead, develop and manage plant employees across functions and shifts.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective manpower deployment.
Set clear performance expectations and monitor team performance.
Develop a culture of discipline, accountability, safety and continuous improvement.
Identify training and capability-building requirements for plant employees.
Handle employee-related operational issues in coordination with HR.
5. Stakeholder Management
Act as the key point of coordination between the plant and corporate functions.
Work closely with Quality, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales and other stakeholders.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, contractors and relevant authorities as required.
Ensure effective communication and timely resolution of operational issues.
6. Safety & Hygiene
Ensure strict adherence to plant safety, hygiene and housekeeping standards.
Drive awareness and compliance with safety procedures across the plant.
Identify potential safety risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions.
Promote a strong safety culture among employees and contractors.
7. Cost & Resource Management
Monitor plant operating costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Ensure efficient utilization of raw materials, packaging materials, utilities and manpower.
Monitor wastage, energy consumption and other key operating expenses.
Support budgeting and operational planning for the plant.

Non-Financial Size

Business/ Financials

Schedule occasional review meeting with Regional Head / Cluster Head Retail Institutions and Government Banking, CBHs, Cluster Heads, BMs, RMs and other stake holders.

Establish personal networks across all circles.


Customer (Both Internal and External)

Ensuring best in class TAT and processing standards.
Ensuring that any service complaints are resolved in a timely manner.
Dipstick surveys with customers to understand the product needs and suggest changes.
Competitor watch and give relevant suggestion sand feedback to constantly improvise products in-tune with the market.
Joint calls / sales support and training to branches.


Internal Process
Build a strong Retail Institutions and Government Banking sales pipeline and mindshare.
Working towards eliminating bottlenecks in the process and rejuvenating the customer journey with Ujjivan Small Finance Bank.
Timely training to branch staff so as to ensure product knowledge, change in processes are communicated in a timely manner downwards


Innovation and Learning
Supporting branch level outbound resources including Branch Managers / BSMs to perform their role of Retail Institutions acquisition adequately.
Ensure adherence to training man-days/ mandatory training programs etc.

Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). Core Responsibilities:

Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.

Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Job Summary
Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Technical Instructional Designer to support our 12,000+ global employees in the High Voltage Business Unit.
In alignment with Hitachi Energy High Voltage's learning vision and growth strategy, this role will help architect our inaugural training center of expertise and knowledge community. This will include creating engaging technical content and courses, utilizing micro-, people-centric, role- skill- and level-based learning methodologies.
If you're ready to transform our onboarding and learning journey, then we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities
Working closely with the Global Learning Manager, you will collaborate with cross-cultural and functional leaders, technical subject matter experts, knowledge owners, and learning experts to determine and create content to fulfill critical knowledge needs. This role will help architect our inaugural Global HV Learning Center of Expertise.
You will create skill- and role-based learning objectives, assessments, certifications, stories, scenarios, knowledge checks, case studies, interactive activities, scripts, content, and videos adhering to all branded standards, processes, and style-guides.
You will interpret skill matrixes to determine critical knowledge gaps and develop training content. You will create step-by-step guides, best practice and troubleshooting documents, infographics, animations, videos, interactive elements, learning activities, assessments, gamification, and courses while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, compliance, and operational excellence.
Interpret content analytics for success and continuous improvement by implementing a plan of improvement to address poor review comments, low ratings and completions.
Support the acceleration of our employees' learning by creating content that onboards, assesses, and advances skill acquisition and proficiency.
Lead and track projects that align with goals to ensure on-time and quality completion.
Develop, edit, and maintain content and other documentation that enhance the effectiveness of on-the-job training and inquiry-based (hands on) learning.
A bachelor's degree is required, with a master's degree preferred in Technology, Science, Technical Writing, or Instructional Design.


Your Background
Advanced knowledge and in-depth experience in adult micro-learning, skill- and role-based training design, skill mapping, learning levels and learning paths, people-centric, scenario-based, and adaptive learning methodologies.
Experience in development and maintenance of high-stakes internal examinations.
Advanced experience using: Camtasia, Articulate 360 (Storyline, Review, and Rise), Screen Capture, Vyond, Synthesia, Adobe Creative Suite, and a Learning Management System.
A minimum of 10 years of experience in andragogy learning, training, and/or knowledge content management in manufacturing, engineering, higher education, and/or technology industries is required.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working with employees across the organization.
Demonstrated flexibility to adjust training approaches to meet evolving employee needs.

The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines

9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics

13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Manufacturing Quality Assurance work includes: Defining and specifying activities, processes, and standards to fulfill the quality requirements for a manufactured material, component, or product. Building and maintaining the infrastructure and systems necessary to consistently ensure the timely delivery of quality products. Auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and/or outputs against defined internal and regulatory standards. Reporting and troubleshooting manufacturing process deviations and defects in finished goods An Entry Professional (P1) applies broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education. How you'll make an Impact:

1. Quality Strategy & Leadership
Develop and implement manufacturing quality assurance strategies and improvement plans.
Establish manufacturing process quality standards, specifications, and controls.
Utilize data-driven decision-making to enhance quality performance.
Provide quality performance reporting to management and stakeholders.
Mentor and support quality professionals where applicable.
Deliver quality awareness training and coaching to manufacturing personnel.
2. Customer Quality Focus
Support fulfillment of customer-specific quality requirements.
Analyze customer complaints, feedback, and quality concerns.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction.
Translate customer expectations into manufacturing process improvements.
3. Quality Management System (QMS)
Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.
Conduct process audits and compliance assessments.
Ensure adherence to quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Train manufacturing teams on quality management practices and risk mitigation methods.
4. Manufacturing Quality Assurance
Conduct Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
Identify manufacturing and assembly process risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation plans.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to eliminate potential quality failures.
Monitor effectiveness of risk controls and preventive actions.
Maintain and update risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle.
Manage change control activities related to:
Product features
Manufacturing processes
Materials
Suppliers
Design modifications
5. Quality Control
Implement quality control plans and inspection requirements.
Conduct process audits, inspections, and verification activities.
Analyze test results, measurements, and statistical quality data.
Identify trends and improvement opportunities through data analysis.
Recommend and implement corrective actions to improve quality performance.
6. Process Performance Management
Monitor key process performance indicators.
Analyze manufacturing performance data and trends.
Support implementation of Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques.
Maintain process performance documentation.
Drive corrective and preventive actions to improve process capability and efficiency.
Train operators and manufacturing teams on performance monitoring methods.
7. Non-Conformance Management
Investigate process and product non-conformities.
Lead root cause analyses using structured problem-solving methodologies such as:
8D
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Statistical Analysis Tools
Implement and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
8. Continuous Improvement
Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
Identify opportunities to improve:
Process capability
Product quality
Productivity
Cost efficiency
Operational performance
Participate in Lean and Six Sigma projects.
Facilitate waste reduction and process optimization activities.
Prioritize and execute improvement projects based on business impact.
Authority & Accountability
The position is accountable for:
Quality risk identification and mitigation.
PFMEA development and maintenance.
Manufacturing quality assurance activities.
Process audit execution.
Quality performance monitoring.
Continuous improvement project execution.
Supporting customer quality requirements and compliance

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Project Manager for the High Voltage Business unit covering Gas Insulated Switchgear, Hybrid Gas Insulated Switchgear and Dead Tank Breaker product portfolio in Savli, Vadodara. The Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of GIS Projects, HGIS & DTB orders execution throughout the entire project lifecycle. This role ensures that all project activities are executed in compliance with contractual requirements, company policies, quality standards, HSE regulations, financial objectives, and delivery commitments.
How you'll make an impact:
Establish the overall project execution strategy and lead projects from handover through successful completion, customer acceptance, and project closure.
Manage and execute domestic and export customer projects, ensuring full compliance with contractual, commercial, logistics, global trade compliance, export control, customs, documentation, taxation, and customer-specific requirements while delivering project objectives related to schedule, quality, cost, cash flow, and customer satisfaction.
Drive project performance by effectively managing schedules, milestones, resource utilization, quality, and delivery commitments.
Monitor and control project financials, including revenue recognition, invoicing, cash collection, cost management, profitability, and cash flow.
Identify, assess, and proactively manage project risks, opportunities, claims, variations, and change orders throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and site execution activities to ensure seamless project delivery.
Act as the primary customer interface and escalation point for all project-related matters, ensuring timely resolution of issues and effective stakeholder communication.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and key internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with project objectives and business priorities.
Ensure successful completion of project close-out activities, including contractual closure, final documentation, lessons learned, and customer acceptance.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships to enhance customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term growth opportunities.
Coach and support project team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project execution effectiveness, efficiency, and customer experience.
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your background:
Degree in Electrical Engineering.
12 to 16 years of experience in Project Management of Turnkey EPC, GIS or AIS Substation projects.
High Voltage Switchgear industry experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of project management life cycle, PMBOK and PMP practices.
PMP certification or formal PM training preferred
Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, MS Office, MS Project.
Knowledge of substations, Gas Insulated Switchgear and power system projects.
Good understanding of taxation, invoicing processes and export documentation.
Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
Strong analytical ability, problem-solving skills and execution focus.
Self-motivated, collaborative and capable of working across multicultural teams.
Fluent in written and spoken English.

1-3 years

Description:
Offer Engineering - Gas Insulated SwitchgearThe opportunity
For our GIS - PASS Factory in Savli - Vadodara, India, we are looking for Electrical Engineer with expertise in the field of HV or MV Engineering.
You will join a dynamic, motivated, and creative team with a variety of experience and competencies.
You will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to the sales team for the GIS/PASS switchgear for different voltage levels (145 KV GIS / 245 KV GIS / 420 KV GIS).
How you'll make an impact
Read through the customer specifications and compliance reports as per the customer requirements.
Define the milestone deliverables (Base Design / BOM ) as per the project requirement.
Preparation of Electrical and Gas SLD, Plan and Section drawings based on various offer / tender and customer specifications.
Preparation of 3D modelling of high voltage GIS for various substation configuration
Preparation of Guaranteed technical particulars of GIS and HV equipment such as Breakers, disconnectors, GIB etc. for submission to customer.
Execute DtV Process during the Base design phase.
Preparation of bill of materials (SD BOMs) and support to Sales team as per the Milestone database. Preparation of technical documents.
Participate in customer meetings as required. Active participation in project review meeting
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with 2-5 years of experience in primary design, preferably GIS Engineering.
Knowledge on IEC/IEEE/IS standards.
Hand on experience in 3D tools like ProE / CREO, AUTOCAD-3D, MS Office.
Familiar with international standards (IEC, EN, ANSI).
Knowledge of SAP system (MM module) .
Expertise in GIS Project execution process knowledge.MV/HV Substation Design knowledge.
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language.

Description:
The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy is currently looking for a Testing Engineer to join their team in Savli, Vadodara, India. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual. The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible to accommodate business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & delivers within timelines is essential.
How you'll make an impact
Should possess adequate knowledge and understanding of relevant national & international standards like IEC.
Must be able to understand different kinds of electrical schematic drawings.
Should be capable of tracing the fault & solving it (both electrical as well as mechanical) by referring the documents.
Must have worked in the testing field and should have the knowhow of the testing equipment.
Should have the experience of high voltage testing, partial discharge testing and routine testing of switchgear product.
Candidate should have the basic knowledge of the switchgear's product.
Candidate should be able to do the electrical wiring independently in Local control cubical and able to verify basic interlocks.
Capable to work independently and handle the day-to-day workload.
Should supervise the team members and ability to deliver the output in targeted timeline.
Should be familiar with practices such as 5S, KAIZEN, etc.
Experience of co-ordination with various cross functions like production, stores, packing and marketing/planning
Should be able to handle the customer inspection independently
Should have the knowledge of the equipment calibration and its certification.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
A Diploma / bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with first class (above 60%)
Minimum 4 to 6 years of professional work experience in Procurement.
Sound interpersonal skills. Working knowledge of SAP MM.
Well versed with MS Office. Basic knowledge of engineering drawing.
Skilled in High voltage testing, partial discharge testing, Mechanical endurance test of Switchgear product. Experience in GIS & DTB testing will be an added advantage.
Should have adequate knowledge of functional and interlock verification in low voltage or local control cubicle.
Quick learner with interest in and ability to master new technologies. Knowledge of basic SAP
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required

RoleOverview
A CustomerCare Executive (CCE) at IIFLFinance (Gold Loan division) is responsible for handlingcustomers at the branch, supporting loan processing, and ensuringsmooth service experience .
Insimple terms:
Youare the first point of contact for customers and the support systemfor the branch team.




CoreResponsibilities

1. Customer Handling Service
Welcome and assist walk-in customers
Understand customer requirements (loan, renewal, closure)
Explain:
Gold loan process
Interest rates
Repayment options
Ensure excellent customer experience and quick service




2. Documentation KYC Processing
Collect and verify:
Aadhaar / PAN
Address proof
Photographs
Ensure proper KYC compliance as per RBI norms
Fill and process loan application forms
Maintain accurate customer records




3. Loan Processing Support
Coordinate with:
Gold Appraiser
Branch Manager
Assist in:
Loan entry in system
Documentation completion
Ensure fast turnaround time (TAT) for disbursement




4. Customer Follow-ups Telecalling
Call customers for:
Loan renewals
Interest payments
Overdue reminders
Handle inbound customer queries
Maintain relationship with existing customers




5. Data Entry MIS Management
Enter customer and loan details into company systems
Maintain:
Daily transaction records
Customer database
Generate basic reports for branch operations




6. Cash Handling Support (in some branches)
Assist in:
Cash collection (interest/repayment)
Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day




7. Branch Coordination
Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff
Help manage:
Customer queue
Branch workflow




8. Compliance Process Adherence
Follow:
Company policies
RBI guidelines
Ensure error-free documentation
Support audits and verification processes




KeySkills Required

FunctionalSkills
Basic knowledge of:
Banking/NBFC processes
Documentation KYC
Computer skills (MS Excel, data entry systems)


BehavioralSkills
Good communication (Hindi/English + local language)
Customer handling patience
Attention to detail
Multitasking ability




EligibilityCriteria
Graduate (preferred) or 12th pass
03 years of experience in:
Customer service
Banking/NBFC
Retail or telecalling
Freshers are often hired




KPIs(Performance Metrics)
Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation
Turnaround time (TAT)
Number of customer interactions handled
Follow-up conversion (renewals, payments)




RealisticNature of the Role
Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records




CareerPath
Growthopportunities in **IIFL Finance Gold Loan:
Customer Care Executive
Senior CCE / Operations Executive
Assistant Branch Manager
Branch Manager
Territory Manager

Tata Consulting Engineers Limited (TCE) is the largest Indian private sector engineering and project consultancy and an emerging global leader in integrated engineering solutions. A part of Tata Group - India’s most respected group, TCE is a 100 percent subsidiary of Tata Sons Limited Design your Future with us At TCE, you will experience a supportive environment that empowers you to excel, whether you are based in our offices or at a client site. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering a workplace where every individual can thrive by contributing their unique skills and perspectives to deliver exceptional results for our clients. Our comprehensive compensation and benefits packages are designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families, complemented by a robust global well-being program. As a leading global infrastructure firm, we are committed to your growth and success, offering access to cutting-edge technology and impactful projects that offer flexibility and significant professional opportunities. Join us and become part of a global company that values your potential and supports your career development.
Purpose & Scope of Position
Working Engineer (WE) will be part of an engineering team providing engineering services to large and small projects. WE is responsible for engineering in a 3D environment and production of 3D models and 2D drawings in accordance with project requirements under the supervision of the Project Engineer (PE). WE is required to apply specialized and/or advanced engineering principles at conceptual and detailed level. The WE participates in a wide range of projects and the activities include modeling and drafting for detailed engineering phase for multi-disciplinary projects.
Experience
• 1-4 years of experience in relevant design discipline • Experience in engineering packages
Qualification
• Postgraduate or graduate in an engineering discipline
Key Responsibilities
1. Assist the PE with the delivery of project requirements as they relate to scope, quantities, quality, cost and schedule 2. Responsible to work in an integrated 3D environment and produce design calculations, reports, specifications, evaluation reports, technical recommendations and, 3D models and 2D drawings as per project requirements 3. Produce and maintain technical and engineering deliverables using 2D and 3D engineering software as required 4. Facilitate the sharing of technical expertise across projects including archival of project documents. 5. Provide and/or participate in training for resources assigned to the project 6. Perform conceptual layout work 7. Develop design details, prepare / extract drawings and check the deliverables prior to release 8. Ensure coordination with engineers within the discipline and with other disciplines 9. Co-ordinate and review clash detection in an integrated model with other discipline engineers and resolve issues if any 10. Participate in formal engineering review processes 11. Review vendor drawings and documents including archival and inputs to other disciplines 12. Represents the discipline during site visit / client meetings as felt necessary by PE/PM. 13. Support technology team/ Project team for development and automation works as required.
Competencies
Manages Complexity
Being Resilient

Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR

Description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, youll dive deep into ground-breaking technologieslike machine learning and AIto craft novel software solutions that solve our customers high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
About Applied
Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.
Responsibilities:

As a seasoned Software Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, reliable and maintainable software solutions for our organization.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and translate them into architectural/software designs that meet business needs.
You will be coding and developing quick prototypes to establish your design with real code and data.
You will be a subject Matter expert to unblock software engineers.
Conduct technical reviews and provide guidance to software engineers during the development process.
Identify and mitigate technical risks and issues throughout the software development lifecycle.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements.
Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems.
Mentor and coach Tech Leads & s/w engineers.

Qualifications & Requirements:

12-18 yrs of experience with BTech / MTech in Computer Science.
Proven experience as a Software Architect or similar role with experience of 10+ yrs in product development.
Minimum experience of 10+ years in core Java & advanced features. E.g., streams, functional programming, virtual threads.
Minimum experience of 5+ years in Spring Boot & associated Spring features.
Minimum experience of 4+ years of driving/contributing towards HLD & LLD, contribution towards code reviews & coding practices (like clean code & SOLID principles)
Minimum experience of 4+ years in building and driving microservices based architecture or large-scale systems.
Strong algorithms & data-structures.
Experience in workflow frameworks. Examples - Temporal, Apache Airflow etc.
Experience in reactive programming.

Good to have:

Good knowledge of Semiconductor domain.
Design, prototype, implement and test software and computer vision machine learning algorithms in Python.
Experience with scikit-image, Tensor Flow, PyTorch.

Applied Materials is committed to diversity in its workforce including Equal Employment Opportunity for Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.
Additional Information
Time Type:
Full time
Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular
Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time
Relocation Eligible:
Yes

Description:
About Us:
Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.

Our Leaders:
Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.

Working Days : 6 days a week
Working Hours : 11:00 AM 8:00 PM
Location : Bangalore & Chennai

Summary of the Role:
We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.

Responsibilities:
Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp.
Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.
End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.
Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets.
Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals


Required Skills and Qualifications:
Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage.
Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru / Tamil for Chennai) is highly desirable to build a local connection.
Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.
Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)


Whats in it for You?
Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures. Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months.
Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 R&D engineers, specialists, and experts focused on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products, and technology. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore. As a Project Manager/Owner to lead and coordinate R&D projects, this role involves managing projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Foster innovation in Grid control technologies by leading R&D projects with structured gate processes and leveraging tools like MS Project, Primavera, and Azure DevOps. Deliver impactful solutions efficiently through agile practices, strong cross-functional teamwork, and technical excellence within the R&D environment.
How you'll make an impact
You will be responsible for leading R&D projects from concept to validation, applying structured gate process frameworks.
To define project objectives and deliverables in alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements and develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, timelines, resource and budget allocations.
To Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to all relevant stakeholders, executive leadership and facilitate timely decision by presenting facts and figure.
To Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, simulation, testing, and product development.
Managing third-party vendors and consultants involved in projects and ensure all project activities comply with industry standards, codes, and safety regulations.
To Identify potential risks and challenges in project execution and develop and implement mitigation strategies to minimize disruptions and ensure project success.
To foster a collaborative and results-driven work environment and inspire and motivate R&D teams and collaborate with resources from functions across the company. Need to work with teams spread across globally.
You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Required bachelor's degree in electrical engineering master's or higher degree is a plus, with minimum 8+ years of experience in Power industry.
Knowledge on Project Management experience related to Power system testing, control and Protection in R&D Environment is required.
Experience in Power generation/FACTS/HVDC/ Substation automation or Renewable sources integration is an added advantage.
Proven experience with gate process methodologies and project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Azure DevOps), with a strong track record of managing Agile workflows and DevOps practices in a technical R&D environment.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to think strategically, understand the big picture and adjust available solutions to diverse audiences.
Experience in working in a multi-cultural team will be valued.
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

Understand and apply project documentation and execution practices in accordance with internal project control standard procedures/instructions in system.

Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Non-Engineering - A diploma or bachelor's/master's degree.
5 to 8 years of experience as a document controller.
Proficiency in MS-Office Applications (Word, PPT and Excel).
Strong communication skills in written and verbal (English).
Capability to work with multi-cultural and multilingual users.
Quick learner, Proactive, Self-Motivated, and Flexible.

Description:
Business Information:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3600+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energys units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement:
Service Sales & Tendering Team Manager is responsible for leading the Service Sales and Tendering team to deliver high-quality, timely and competitive offers for service business opportunities. The role includes managing team operations, resource allocation, competence development, stakeholder collaboration and people development. This position drives standardization, best-practice sharing, continuous improvement and team capability development while supporting business growth, customer satisfaction and operational excellence across global and local service sales requirements.
Your Responsibilities:
Team Leadership and People Development
Lead, coach and mentor the Service Sales and Tendering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
Conduct regular performance and development discussions, define individual goals, identify competency gaps and support career growth.
Build team capability through structured onboarding, training, knowledge sharing and development of behavioral and functional competencies.
Drive recruitment, onboarding and resource readiness to support business expansion and future scope growth.
Promote diversity, inclusion, positive team dynamics and a healthy work environment.
Service Sales and Tendering Operations
Manage end-to-end service sales and tendering activities, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, timelines, quality standards and business expectations.
Oversee RFQ review, scope clarification, technical-commercial alignment, offer preparation, risk assessment, bid submission and post-offer support.
Provide guidance on tendering process flow, commercial governance, risk identification and quality of offer submissions.
Support scope addition, team scaling and long-term capability building to match evolving business needs.
Stakeholder and Business Collaboration
Collaborate with global stakeholders, sales units, factories, HUBs, customers and cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide updates and ensure customer satisfaction.
Maintain regular engagement with business counterparts to align priorities, review performance and address operational challenges.
Performance Management and Operational Excellence
Drive and monitor key performance indicators such as On-Time Delivery, Hit rate, efficiency, utilization, NPS/customer satisfaction and quality of deliverables.
Ensure effective workload planning, prioritization of critical cases and visibility of long-pending offers or execution gaps.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, best-practice deployment and quality management system adherence.
Develop and maintain a roadmap for team growth, productivity improvement, competency development and future technology/tool adoption.
Administrative and Financial Responsibilities
Manage team administration, including resource planning, leave planning, onboarding support, infrastructure coordination and HR-related operational support.
Support business-related financial coordination such as offer submission tracking, purchase order follow-up, invoicing coordination and payment collection follow-up where applicable.
Ensure accurate reporting, timely updates and effective governance of team deliverables and business support activities.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
Education
Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
Electrical Engineering or power/energy sector background will be an added advantage.
Experience
10+ years of experience in Sales, Tendering, Front-End Sales, EPC or related functions.
Prior experience in managing teams, working with global stakeholders and supporting multi-location or global business environments will be preferred.
Experience in HV switchgear, Transformer, substations or service business.
Functional Skills
Strong knowledge of service sales, tendering process flow, commercial review, risk assessment and offer management.
Ability to manage sales processes, stakeholder requirements, timelines, quality standards and business priorities.
Working knowledge of CRM/Salesforce and Power BI will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical, organizational and risk management skills.
Leadership and Behavioral Skills
Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management and team-building abilities.
Strong interpersonal skills to manage team dynamics, resolve conflicts and maintain a positive work environment.
Strategic thinking with a proactive approach to business growth, scalability and capability development.

Meshing
Connections

Assembly

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Hitachi Energy is a world leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure, and we collaborate with customers and partners to enable a sustainable energy future - for today's generations and those to come.
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy. To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) and HVDC Light are highly efficient alternatives for transmitting bulk power and for special purpose applications. The classic HVDC technology is used to transmit electric power over long distances by overhead transmission lines or submarine cables. It is also used to interconnect separate power systems, where traditional alternating current (AC) connections cannot be used. HVDC Light is a power transmission technology developed by Hitachi Energy that offers additional benefits compared to HVDC Classic. You will work mainly with electrical design of main circuit equipment in projects with medium to high complexity.
Responsibilities
Supporting projects and tenders for HVDC System Design - managing the scope, budget and schedule while ensuring quality requirements are met
Be ready to be proactive and apply your project management and analytical skills.
Interface with other departments in HVDC organization, representing your System Design team in project and tender meetings and discussions, also representing System Design in customer meetings
Participate in technical design reviews and in technical problem solving
Responsible for the technical coordination of System Design deliveries as well as managing the risks and identifying opportunities to reduce time and cost while ensuring quality requirements are met
When you feel comfortable in the role you get the opportunity to manage complex projects on your own. In other words, your ambition is the foundation for your development opportunities!
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your Background
Educational qualification: Master's or bachelor's degree in Electric Power Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Candidate should have 7 + years of project management experience from working in engineering and are familiar with managing system delivery projects or tenders.
HVDC system design knowledge is considered an asset.
You enjoy working in diverse and multicultural teams and are interested to share your experiences and knowledge with your colleagues as well as learn from them.
You are a flexible leader that enjoy problem solving and work in a structured way.
Fluency in English, additional languages are considered an asset.

Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.

Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.

Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.
Oracle Cloud Knowledge (Good to have, not mandatory): Exposure to Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules — Supply Planning, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, Manufacturing, Product Hub/PLM — will be viewed favourably but is not a prerequisite.
Consulting Experience: Prior experience with a Big 4, global systems integrator, or automotive-industry consulting/coordination role; comfortable working in client-facing delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field; any ERP or Oracle Cloud certification is a bonus, not expected.
Willingness to travel to client sites (India and potentially Japan) as required by programme milestones.

Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.
Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).
Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Job Description: Java Developer

Job Title: Java Developer

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Java Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Core Java, object-oriented programming, database technologies, and web application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain Java-based applications and services.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable, and secure applications.
Create and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with external systems.
Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, and Product Owners.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Core Java (Java 8/11/17).
Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs) concepts and Design Patterns.
Experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with Hibernate/JPA.
Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Collections Framework, Multithreading, Exception Handling, and Java Streams.
Familiarity with Maven/Gradle build tools.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Understanding of Agile development methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Microservices Architecture.
Knowledge of Spring Security, JWT, and OAuth.
Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or messaging systems.
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Nice to Have
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
Knowledge of performance tuning and application monitoring.
Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Domain experience in Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, or Telecom.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

. Understand and document the existing BizTalk Server architecture and integration landscape, including applications, orchestrations, ports, pipelines, maps, schemas, adapters and workflows.
. Analyze end to end interfaces to identify source/target systems, data flows, dependencies, triggers, schedules, SLAs and operational requirements.
. Assess existing integrations for complexity, business criticality, transaction volumes, performance, technical debt and migration risks.
. Develop As Is architecture diagrams, interface inventories and dependency matrices for the existing integration landscape.
. Define the To Be Integration Architecture using Informatica IICS, including CDI and CAI components.
. Develop High Level Designs (HLDs) covering integration flows, connectivity, transformations, orchestration, error handling, security, monitoring and operational requirements.
. Define the BizTalk to Informatica migration strategy and roadmap, including migration waves, prioritization, effort, risks and dependencies.
. Determine the appropriate migration approach for each interface rehost, redesign, consolidate, modernize or retire.
. Guide the conversion of BizTalk orchestrations, maps, pipelines, ports, schemas and adapters into appropriate Informatica IDMC patterns.
. Define reusable integration patterns and standards for API, file, batch, event driven, application to application, synchronous and asynchronous integrations.
. Design and review integrations using REST/SOAP, SFTP, AS2, HTTP/HTTPS, APIs, databases, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files and EDI.
. Define standards for transformations, validations, routing, filtering, enrichment, batching/debatching, acknowledgements and business rules.
. Define integration security architecture, including authentication, authorization, encryption, PGP, certificates, credentials and secrets management.
. Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, audit and compliance requirements.
. Review and approve LLDs, technical solutions, estimates and development deliverables, ensuring alignment with architecture standards.
. Provide technical leadership and guidance to Informatica developers, testing, infrastructure, security, support and external partner teams.
. Define and support SIT, UAT, performance testing, parallel/dual run validation, production cutover, rollback and hypercare activities.
. Act as the Integration Architecture SME, working with business and IT stakeholders to resolve technical risks, define integration roadmaps, drive modernization and support BizTalk decommissioning.
Your future duties and responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design, including current-state assessment and target-state architecture.
• Define and drive the BizTalk-to-Informatica IDMC migration strategy, roadmap, migration waves and technical approach.
• Develop and review HLDs/LLDs, integration patterns, interfaces, security, performance and operational standards.
• Provide technical leadership and guidance to Informatica developers and collaborate with business, IT, testing, infrastructure and security teams.
• Support development, testing, deployment, cutover, hypercare and BizTalk decommissioning, ensuring successful delivery and SLA compliance.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Pathologist-Full Time
Raipur
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL & other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.

Direct responsibility of managing sales in Store-in-Store/Experience Centres

Share feedback with Charging Solutions & Customer Experience teams

Onboard and manage product specialists across relevant sales channels

Sales Planning

Zonal Retail Marketing
Align on EV specific offers

Customer Experience
Communicating product/service feedback received on-ground to charging/customer experience team
PVBU TSM
Interface with TSMs to seek dealer support and ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets

Channel Partners
Direct Feedback/ daily assistance to them to sort issues.
Financial Institutions

Experience in Value Selling concept of Sales.
Ability to lead and manage teams and achieve targets; drive product specialists and dealerships to achieve retail targets
Strong Oral & written communication with good fluency in English language and local language of relevant city/region
Ability to guide teams in prioritizing and managing customer pipeline without losing sales
Strong planning & problem solving skills to create city specific market activation plans, tie-ups and customer schemes
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Ability to influence colleagues/ other BU manpower without direct reporting relationship
Strong sales team leadership experience/ skills, evidenced through track record or references
Strong experience in Retail customer management, handling escalations and working with multiple internal stakeholders etc.
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Good technical knowledge of EV/PV products along with product features

Effective Communication and Influencing Skills
Ability to drive teams to meet targets
Result Oriented approach
Accountability & Ownership
Ability to change user behaviour
Data Driven

About the Role : Dainik Bhaskar is looking for a highly driven sales professional to lead and grow advertisement revenue across key business categories. The role requires a blend of sales leadership, client relationship management, category understanding, and revenue generation capabilities. The incumbent will be responsible for managing a sales team, acquiring new advertisers, retaining existing clients, and achieving assigned revenue targets.


Key Responsibilities:
1.Sales Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage a team of Field Sales Executives (FSEs) and sales professionals.
Set monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the team. Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and coaching sessions.
Drive accountability through daily activity tracking and sales monitoring. Develop team capabilities through mentoring and field accompaniment.

2.Revenue Generation & Business Development
Achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets.
Build and manage a robust 90-day sales pipeline.
Identify and acquire new advertisers across categories.
Drive client retention, renewal, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure strong conversion rates from prospecting to closure.


3. Client Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with business owners, CXOs, marketing heads, and decision-makers.
Understand client business objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Conduct effective sales presentations and proposal discussions. Handle negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract closures professionally.
Maintain long-term advertiser relationships and enhance client satisfaction.


4. Category Development & Market Intelligence
Develop strong understanding of key categories such as: Education / Real Estate / Automobile / Retail / FMCG / BFSI
Track market trends, competitor activities, launches, and promotional opportunities.
Identify category-wise revenue opportunities and develop growth strategies, Prepare category acquisition and retention plans.

5. Media Sales & Advertising Solutions
Promote print advertising solutions and integrated media offerings. Understand ad inventory, pricing structures, packages, and campaign planning.
Guide clients on campaign execution, visibility, reach, and impact. Coordinate with internal stakeholders for seamless campaign delivery.

6. Communication & Presentation
Prepare client-specific proposals and sales presentations.
Conduct effective client meetings, pitches, and business reviews. Communicate professionally in Hindi and English, both written and verbal.
Deliver regular sales updates and business reports.

7. Planning & Business Analytics
Track sales performance using Excel, CRM, and reporting tools.
Analyse category trends, revenue performance, client retention, and market opportunities.
Prepare monthly and quarterly business plans. Develop action plans to improve productivity and revenue realization.

8. Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline / MBA in Marketing / Sales / Business Development preferred.

9. Preferred Additional Skills:Exposure to print advertisement sales, Experience handling multiple categories or markets, understanding of digital advertising platforms, Ability to design integrated advertising solutions combining print and digital media.

• Must be target-focused, hardworking and able to manage regular follow-ups.

• Field-based role with regular local travel and visits.
• Weekly off and other benefits as per company policy.

Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.

Detect any deviations in quality standards and promptly escalate significant findings to management.
Assist in scheduled quality audits and ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal activities.

Have between 0.6 to 3 years of professional experience in quality control, production, manufacturing, or conducting plant and vendor audits.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.
Be willing and able to work at external vendor or plant locations and utilize mobile applications for reporting tasks.

0.6 3 years of experience in Quality Control, Production, Manufacturing or Plant/Vendor Audits.
