Job Summary
The Deputy Relationship Manager for Fast Track Loan within the South Business department at Ujjivan Small Finance Bank plays a pivotal role in driving the growth and management of the bank's fast track loan portfolio. This position requires a strategic and customer-centric professional who can effectively manage client relationships, assess creditworthiness, and ensure timely disbursal of loans while adhering to regulatory and internal compliance standards. The role demands collaboration with cross-functional teams to optimize loan processing, mitigate risks, and enhance customer satisfaction in a competitive banking environment focused on financial inclusion and rapid service delivery.
Job Type: Full-time


Key Duties and Responsibilities
Manage and nurture relationships with existing and prospective clients to promote fast track loan products tailored to their financial needs.
Conduct thorough credit appraisals and risk assessments to ensure the quality and profitability of the loan portfolio.
Coordinate with credit, legal, and compliance teams to ensure all loan disbursals meet regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
Drive the end-to-end loan processing cycle, ensuring timely documentation, verification, and disbursal to meet customer expectations.
Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling additional banking products to enhance customer value and bank revenue.
Monitor loan repayments and proactively manage delinquency by engaging with customers to resolve issues and minimize non-performing assets.
Prepare detailed reports on loan portfolio performance, market trends, and customer feedback for senior management review.
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to develop and implement strategies that increase loan penetration in the South Business region.
Train and mentor junior relationship managers and field staff to improve team effectiveness and customer engagement.
Stay updated with industry developments, regulatory changes, and competitive landscape to adapt strategies accordingly.


Minimum Requirements of Knowledge and Skills

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
Minimum of 4-6 years of experience in retail banking or microfinance, with a focus on loan portfolio management and customer relationship management.


Functional Skills
Credit Risk Assessment
Loan Portfolio Management
Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
Regulatory Compliance in Banking
Financial Analysis and Reporting
Cross-selling and Upselling Techniques
Negotiation and Conflict Resolution
Team Leadership and Mentoring
Documentation and Loan Processing


Behavioural Skills
Market Research and Competitive Analysis

Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

About the company
Treebo Hospitality Ventures is Indias most loved brand and one of the largest chains in the budget segment of hospitality. With a network of 850+ hotels across 120+ cities, Treebo offers travellers the unprecedented value proposition of high-quality stays at affordable prices wherever they go. We are proud of putting dignity back into budget travel where earlier the traveller was forced to contend with poor quality and hygiene. Treebo Hospitality Ventures masterfully combines engineering prowess with deep hospitality expertise. Our operational ethos is clear and focused from Treebo Club, an innovative distribution platform and extremely rewarding loyalty programme to Hotel Superhero, a cutting-edge SaaS solution and a comprehensive hotel management software. With a strong technological foundation and a passion for hospitality, THV aims to deliver exceptional experiences across our diverse portfolio. Our range of brandsItsy Hotels, Treebo,
Treebo Premium and Medalioprovides a symphony of choices that blend quality, comfort and affordability. Treebo is a Great Places to Work certified organisation. We take immense pride in our culture which is built on a strong foundation of 7 values. Some of these values include - Exhibit Owner Mindset and Have the humility and hunger to learn and help learn, amongst others. We strongly believe in offering our people - “Treebs”, as they are called - unmatched opportunities to learn and grow. If you’re looking to work at a place that is built on strong fundamentals of
business and professional conduct, Treebo is the place for you.
About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling
sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a
business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association
What Are We Looking For -
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability.

Job description: The FSE will be responsible for acquiring new clients, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and drive revenue growth for advertising space in print media. The role involves field visits, client meetings, proposal pitching, post sales support, and internal coordination. This is an Individual Contributor role.


Roles and Responsibilities:
Sales & Revenue Growth:
Achieve sales targets as defined by the organization.
Motivate clients to choose bigger ads and run them more often to increase revenue.

• Client Acquisition & Relationship Management:
Identify and visit prospective clients through internal database or internal references.
Offer print advertisement solutions that match the clients business goals.
Build and maintain strong long-term client relationships.
Win repeat business from Clients by giving steady, reliable service.


Solution-Oriented Pitching:
Understand the clients business needs and develop customized marketing proposal.
Use data insights, wherever possible, to help clients reach more customers in new areas.
Encourage client participation in Special Initiatives (festive editions, theme-based ads, etc.).
Support in field marketing activities related to SIs

Campaign Execution, Collections & Coordination:
Act as the point of contact for clients on all post-sale support (creatives, deadlines, placements).
Collect advertisement materials/creatives and ensure timely submission for publishing.
Coordinate with internal departments (Billing, RO Generation, Scheduling) to ensure smooth ad execution.
Follow up for payments and ensure timely collections.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.

Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals

Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Job Description HR Recruiter
Experience: 1 Year
Location: Raipur, Chhattisgarh

Job Summary
We are looking for an HR Recruiter with 1 year of experience to manage end-to-end recruitment, candidate sourcing, interview coordination, and onboarding activities.

Key Responsibilities
Source candidates through Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other job portals.
Screen resumes and shortlist candidates as per job requirements.
Coordinate telephonic, virtual, and face-to-face interviews.
Communicate with candidates regarding interview schedules and feedback.
Manage recruitment for multiple positions across departments and locations.
Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring reports.
Coordinate salary discussions, offer letters, and joining formalities.
Follow up with selected candidates to ensure timely joining.
Required Skills
Minimum 1 year of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic knowledge of recruitment processes and job portals.
Proficiency in MS Excel, email, and documentation.
Ability to manage multiple vacancies and meet hiring deadlines.
Qualification: Graduate in any discipline, preferably in HR or Business Administration.

Description:
F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Achieves personal and team related revenue goals.
Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience.
Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities & Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .

- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.

- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (eg, , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.

- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Job Title: Showroom Manager
Department: Retail Sales
Company: TBZ LTD.
Type: Permanent
Location: Raipur

Job Description:
Assist in the planning process
Adhere to the budget guidelines for store.
Implement short-term operating plans and adhere to budgets provided.
Ensure control over operating expenses in the store.
Achieve the store sales and operating expenses targets while maintaining focus on quality of customer service in stores.
Coordinate with merchandizing team to ensure the supply of merchandise to store as per the demand.
Deliver store sales and operating expenses targets on a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual basis.
Ensure high level of customer service and customer delight.
Ensure the creation of right shopping ambience in the stores.
Adhere to reverse logistics (for old gold) guidelines as per the defined SOPs.
Support in execution of any activities aimed at increasing sales.
Provide inputs for the merchandize requirements at the store based on store specific sales patterns and consumer preferences and provide proactive feedback on aspects of inventory levels, pricing, promotions, shelf space utilization.
Responsible for conducting daily security checks in the store.
Oversee the forecasting of demand basis the sales each day and transfer the knowledge around the fast moving designs and latest trends.
Implement the loss prevention activities in the store as per the guidelines.
Monitor processes to minimize losses due to shop lifting or pilferage.
Generate all the required reports (Daily sales and collections, monthly and quarterly MIS, market intelligence reports etc.).
Support business process re-engineering team in conducting audits in the store and take corrective actions for the processes which come out as improvement areas in audit results.
Provide inputs for support and execution of facility management activities.
Support Regional Marketing Manager in executing all the marketing related activities.
Execute the advertisement and promotions plans in the store.
Support marketing team for executing visual merchandising activities in the store.
Ensure adherence to the stores standard operating procedures to drive efficiency and utilize communication channels to provide upward feedback from time to time.
Follow all store operations SOPs and work towards continuous improvement of the same.
Conduct self audits in the store on regular basis.
Oversee all point of sales activities in the store which includes - sales transactions, tracking customer orders and payments, registering sale and maintaining inventory updates, providing service, handling old gold and after sales service, gathering consumer data for feedback.
Oversee the inventory management process in the store.
Oversee that the store staff is presentable and well groomed.
Guide the staff to increase sales as well as profitability.
Monitor the overall training and development needs of staff in the store.
Impart training regarding product knowledge, promotion offers and schemes etc.
Support Regional Retail Operations Manager in identifying processes and trainings on aspects which will facilitate maximizing the conversion ratio in the stores.
Nominate staff at regular intervals for the relevant training programs.
Perform the role of a people manager.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, customer focus, entrepreneurship and team work for all the employees in the store.
Manage and support recruitment, set KRA's for direct reports, monitor overall store KRA's, conduct performance appraisal.

Description:
Job Description: Maintenance Technician

About the Role:
We are hiring Maintenance Technicians to handle on-ground service and repair of our different types of robots. This is a field-intensive role requiring strong hands-on capability in electronics and mechanical systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently. The role involves extensive travel within the assigned zone and direct interaction with customers.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Field Service & Repairs
Perform installation, servicing, and repair different kind of robots
Diagnose issues across:
Electrical/electronic components
Mechanical assemblies
Ensure effective and timely resolution during field visits.

2. Fault Diagnosis & Troubleshooting
Identify root causes of failures using structured troubleshooting.
Differentiate between:
Electrical faults
Mechanical wear and tear
Usage-related issues
Minimize repeat visits through accurate diagnosis.

3. Preventive & Routine Maintenance
Conduct periodic maintenance checks to prevent breakdowns.
Ensure appliances operate efficiently post-service.
Follow defined service checklists and SOPs.

4. Customer Interaction
Interact directly with customers at site:
Explain issues and repairs clearly
Provide basic usage guidance to avoid recurring problems
Maintain professional conduct and service quality.

5. Spare Parts & Tools Management
Identify required spare parts for repairs.
Ensure proper usage and handling of tools and equipment.
Coordinate for parts replacement where required.

6. Service Reporting & Documentation
Update service details after each visit:
Issue identified
Action taken
Parts replaced
Maintain accurate service records for tracking and analysis.
Preserve the replaced partes and compile a document and send it to head quarters for further Analysys

7. Travel & Field Coordination
Travel extensively within assigned zone (city clusters).
Coordinate with supervisors for scheduling and escalation.

Zone-wise Deployment
Central India: Bhopal, Indore, Raipur

Required Skills & Qualifications:
2-5 years of experience in servicing FMCG appliances (washing machines, mixers, fans preferred)

Strong understanding of:
Basic electronics (wiring, PCB-level basics, motor circuits)
Mechanical systems (motors, bearings, moving parts)

ITI / Diploma / Certification in Mechatronics preferred

Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues independently

Willingness to travel extensively within assigned region

Preferred Attributes:
Hands-on, problem-solving mindset

Ability to work independently in field conditions

Good communication and customer-handling skills

Quick learner with adaptability to different appliance models

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.

Role Overview
The Senior Resident General Surgery is a full-time, post-MS/DNB clinical and academic position in the Department of General Surgery of a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university. The role combines hands-on operative surgery, round-the-clock emergency and trauma care, ward and outpatient management, and structured teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of Department and works under the supervision of Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors, while supervising Junior Residents, interns and the unit's clinical team. The position bridges postgraduate training and an independent teaching-faculty career, building the Senior Residency experience recognised under National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations.

Work Mode
Work from hospital (on-site at the teaching hospital), duty days per NMC norms, including rostered on-call, night and emergency duties; no regular travel is expected.

Key Responsibilities
Perform elective general surgical procedures as primary surgeon or first assistant, including hernia repair, appendicectomy, cholecystectomy, and breast, thyroid and soft-tissue surgery, with consultant supervision as appropriate.
Manage acute surgical emergencies and polytrauma, including resuscitation, primary and secondary survey, emergency laparotomy and timely escalation to consultants.
Conduct surgical outpatient clinics, evaluating new and follow-up patients and planning investigations, conservative treatment or surgery.
Lead daily ward rounds, preoperative assessment and optimisation, and postoperative care, with early recognition and management of complications.
Obtain valid, documented informed consent and counsel patients and families on diagnosis, procedure, risks and expected outcomes.
Perform and assist in laparoscopic procedures, such as diagnostic laparoscopy, laparoscopic appendicectomy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy, progressively building minimal access skills.
Carry out bedside and minor procedures, including incision and drainage, biopsies, chest tube insertion, central venous access and suprapubic catheterisation.
Teach and assess MBBS students and postgraduate residents through bedside clinics, lectures, case presentations, skills-lab sessions and competency-based medical education (CBME) activities.
Supervise and mentor Junior Residents and interns, overseeing clinical decisions, handovers, duty rosters and logbook entries.
Maintain accurate and timely case records, operative notes, discharge summaries and medico-legal documentation in the hospital information system.
Apply and promote patient safety, infection prevention and control, the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, antimicrobial stewardship and accreditation standards.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology and other specialities for multidisciplinary care of complex surgical patients.
Contribute to clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings, journal clubs, research projects and publications of the department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MS (General Surgery) from an NMC-recognised institution, or DNB (General Surgery) awarded by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), recognised as per prevailing NMC regulations.
Permanent registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and eligibility to register with the Sikkim Medical Council.
Age within the NMC upper limit for Senior Residents in broad specialities, currently 45 years.

Required Experience
Experience range: 03 years of post-MS/DNB experience in General Surgery; freshly qualified MS/DNB General Surgery graduates are eligible. Preferred: 1–3 years as Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist in General Surgery at an NMC-recognised medical college or a tertiary-care multispeciality hospital. Relevant experience includes a documented operative logbook with procedures performed as primary surgeon, independent first-line management of surgical emergencies and trauma, and exposure to undergraduate teaching. Experience in high-volume emergency surgical services is valued.

Technical and Functional Skills
Open general surgery: inguinal and ventral hernia repair, appendicectomy, breast and thyroid surgery, excision of soft-tissue swellings and wound management.
Emergency surgery: laparotomy for perforation, obstruction and abdominal trauma, bowel resection and anastomosis, and stoma creation.
Minimal access surgery at basic to intermediate level: safe port placement, diagnostic laparoscopy, and laparoscopic appendicectomy and cholecystectomy.
Trauma care aligned with ATLS principles, including primary and secondary survey and bedside FAST interpretation.
Perioperative care: fluid and electrolyte balance, surgical nutrition, sepsis management, thromboprophylaxis and pain control.
Interpretation of ultrasound, CT, MRI and laboratory investigations for surgical decision-making.
Working knowledge of infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medico-legal procedures and hospital information systems.
CBME-based teaching, logbook supervision and formative assessment of students and residents.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Sound clinical judgement and composure under pressure; clear, empathetic communication with patients and families, including breaking difficult news; teamwork and leadership within the surgical unit; commitment to teaching and mentoring; ethical, professional conduct with medico-legal awareness; disciplined time management across clinical, academic and on-call duties; resilience during demanding rosters; and respect for a culturally diverse patient population.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
ATLS or an equivalent trauma course, and current BLS/ACLS certification; FMAS, FIAGES or other structured laparoscopic training; completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME); MRCS or FRCS examination progress; membership of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI); thesis-based or indexed-journal publications and conference presentations; prior teaching experience in a medical college; and the ability to communicate in Hindi, with working knowledge of Nepali an advantage.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate trained at an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited teaching hospital with substantial elective and emergency surgical volumes, and shows a consistent academic record through MBBS and MS/DNB. Prior Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist tenure at a reputed government or private medical college or a tertiary-care hospital strengthens the application. The career trajectory should point towards academic surgery or a teaching-faculty role, with stable tenures and verifiable references.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualifications, experience and institutional norms for Senior Residents. The role offers broad elective, emergency and teaching exposure in an academic setting. Leave, academic support and any other benefits follow institutional policy and NMC norms, and will be detailed at the offer stage.

Application Instructions
Send your updated resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – General Surgery", by email to careers@execvera.com, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include your MBBS and MS/DNB details, medical council registration number, a summary of your operative logbook, current employer and notice period in days, current and expected annual CTC in , and any certifications or publications. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and document verification.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Forensic & Clinical Skills
Forensic sample collection & handling
Toxicology sample preservation & dispatch
Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety
Post-mortem assistance & documentation
Medico-legal record keeping

Academic & Technical
UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Practical demonstration skills
NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting
Forensic laboratory procedures
Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills
Composure in forensic environments

GROWTH MANAGER
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Growth Manager plays a pivotal dual role at the intersection of new customer acquisition and long-term partner success. This role is responsible for driving expansion through data-driven sales and marketing strategies, while ensuring the deep engagement, retention, and growth of existing school partners. By combining the outreach excellence of an Area Manager with the relationship depth of a Customer Success Manager, the Growth Manager ensures that LEAD's mission of excellent education for every child is delivered - from the very first demo to sustained, on-ground academic impact.
ROLES RESPONSIBILITIES
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline; deliver compelling demos and close high-value school partnerships.
Align LEAD solutions to school owner needs; negotiate contracts and ensure seamless onboarding.
Collaborate with marketing for lead generation and stay updated on competitor and industry trends.
Manage and nurture existing partner schools to ensure strong, long-term relationships and satisfaction.
Grow base business revenue through targeted upsell and cross-sell initiatives across the school portfolio.
Identify opportunities to improve school NPS; drive timely renewals and support admissions growth.
Support the Academic team in implementing academic processes effectively at partner schools.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding dues from partner schools.
Conduct training for teachers and staff; track implementation quality in coordination with Academic and Sales teams.
Maintain accurate CRM records, execute BTL campaigns, and share periodic progress reports.

Strong ability in sales pipeline management, lead generation, contract negotiation, and client onboarding.
5+ years in customer-facing roles in EdTech (field sales, account management, or key accounts).
Experience in collections, upselling, and school relationship management.
Fluent in local language and open to travel to partnered schools.
Graduate; MBA/BTech or math background preferred.
COMPETENCIES REQUIRED
Proficient in CRM tools, product pitching, stakeholder management, and academic solution selling.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; strong customer orientation and training ability.
High ownership, solutions-driven, and collaborative with strong interpersonal skills.
Curious, resilient, and tech-savvy; thrives in fast-paced environments with a proactive approach.

Description:
Role Overview

Position Details: Associate Professor - Paediatrics; 2 positions; Department of Paediatrics; reports to the Professor / Head of Unit; work location: Gangtok, Sikkim.

This mid-senior academic-clinical role combines undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervised clinical service, assessment, research guidance, and assigned unit administration. The incumbent will help MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students build safe, evidence-informed paediatric knowledge and practical competence. The role supports high-quality outpatient, inpatient, emergency, NICU, and PICU care while contributing to patient satisfaction and continuous improvement. The Associate Professor works under the Professor / Head of Unit and may lead unit activities when authorised.

Employer Profile: A confidential tertiary-care academic teaching hospital integrating paediatric care, medical education, clinical training, and research.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver competency-based lectures, tutorials, bedside teaching, demonstrations, and clinical discussions for MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students.
Formulate the rotational undergraduate teaching schedule and coordinate faculty inputs to maintain complete, timely academic coverage.
Plan, conduct, and document internal examinations and periodic assessments using approved standards, blueprints, records, and constructive learner feedback.
Supervise seminars, case presentations, journal clubs, clinical postings, procedural learning, and academic mentoring across paediatric services.
Provide outpatient and inpatient paediatric care with the unit team and support evidence-informed diagnosis, treatment, discharge, and follow-up decisions.
Serve as first on call for paediatric emergencies on assigned duty days and escalate difficult or unstable cases promptly.
Supervise or perform appropriate procedures in the NICU, PICU, outpatient department, wards, and emergency settings within authorised privileges.
Report complex, high-risk, and emergency cases to the Unit In-charge or Head of Department and document decisions accurately.
Cover assigned consultant responsibilities during approved leave or service gaps to maintain continuity of teaching and patient care.
Lead assigned unit administration, including duty rosters, work allocation, coordination, and staff guidance, when delegated.
Support need assessment, specification development, procurement inputs, and responsible utilisation of paediatric medical equipment.
Guide learner and departmental research through question development, protocol review, ethical practice, analysis, writing, and dissemination.
Advance patient satisfaction, safety, quality indicators, infection prevention, audit, and continual clinical-service improvement.
Maintain academic, clinical, research, and statutory records while completing other duties assigned by the Head of Department.

Required Qualifications
The candidate must hold an MBBS degree and an NMC-recognised MD or DNB in Paediatrics, or another qualification formally accepted as equivalent under the regulations in force. A valid NMC or State Medical Council registration is mandatory. The candidate must satisfy the applicable Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, including prescribed research-publication, biomedical-research, and medical-education training requirements, as verified at appointment.

Required Experience
The standard academic pathway requires 4+ years as Assistant Professor in Paediatrics at an NMC-recognised medical institution; 5+ years is required where the candidate's applicable NMC route prescribes the longer threshold. Any alternative statutory pathway must be fully documented and independently verified. Relevant experience must include formal undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, learner assessment, clinical supervision, and paediatric patient care. Demonstrated exposure to NICU, PICU, outpatient, inpatient, and emergency services in a teaching-hospital environment is essential.

Technical and Functional Skills
Paediatric clinical assessment, decision-making, documentation, referral, discharge planning, and escalation across OPD, wards, NICU, PICU, and emergencies.
Competency-based medical education, lesson planning, teaching schedules, internal assessment, question setting, evaluation, feedback, and academic recordkeeping.
Clinical supervision of learners and safe oversight of authorised paediatric and neonatal procedures within institutional protocols.
Research methods, ethics, literature appraisal, protocol development, data interpretation, manuscript guidance, and NMC-compliant publication evidence.
Quality improvement, patient safety, infection prevention, audit, duty-roster planning, equipment inputs, and multidisciplinary coordination.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear academic communication, structured feedback, learner mentorship, and respectful collaboration with students, faculty, nurses, and allied teams.
Compassionate family communication, ethical judgement, cultural sensitivity, confidentiality, and calm leadership during paediatric emergencies.
Accountability, dependability, adaptability, prioritisation, conflict resolution, and commitment to continuous professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference will be given to candidates with a strong teaching portfolio; completed NMC-recognised faculty-development courses; eligible research publications; demonstrable academic or clinical quality-improvement work; experience guiding postgraduate research; and additional documented competence in neonatology, paediatric intensive care, medical education, or clinical research. These preferences do not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Professional Tenure and Background
Expected progression includes recognised postgraduate training, Senior Residency or an accepted equivalent pathway, and an Assistant Professor appointment meeting the applicable 4+ years or 5+ years NMC threshold. Candidates should show sustained paediatric service, measurable teaching contributions, documented research, and ethical conduct in recognised teaching institutions.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive a competitive, role-aligned compensation package and institutional benefits based on verified qualifications, experience, responsibilities, and internal policy. Exact figures and salary ranges are intentionally not disclosed in this document.

Application Instructions
Submit an updated resume identifying the role, together with MBBS and postgraduate qualification records, medical-registration details, complete teaching-experience certificates, research-publication evidence, and applicable faculty-development certificates. Shortlisting and appointment remain subject to credential, experience, publication, registration, and NMC-eligibility verification.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Assistant Professor

Department Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super

Speciality Teaching Hospital,

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Assistant Professor in the Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy will serve as a key teaching and clinical faculty member at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The role requires a committed medical professional capable of delivering quality undergraduate medical education while managing a robust clinical workload across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings. The incumbent will also contribute to research and publication activities as mandated by the National Medical Commission (NMC). This is an entry-level faculty appointment with strong scope for academic growth within the institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and clinical classes in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy as per university curriculum.
Conduct bedside clinical demonstrations, practical sessions, and case-based discussions for MBBS students and interns.
Participate in departmental seminars, journal clubs, and academic activities to foster a learning environment.
Assist in evaluation and assessment of undergraduate students including internal and university examinations.
Cover duties of other Assistant Professors when required to ensure continuity of academic programmes.

B. Clinical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots, ensuring evidence-based clinical care.
Provide comprehensive inpatient (IPD) dermatology care manage cases admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments.
Diagnose and manage common skin diseases, sexually transmitted infections, and leprosy cases.
Attend to emergency dermatology patients during assigned on-call duties.
Participate in scheduled Operation Theatre duties perform and oversee procedures and assist postgraduate trainees.
Maintain accurate clinical documentation and comply with hospital protocols, NABH standards, and patient safety requirements.

C. Research & Publications
Publish research articles in indexed journals as per current NMC requirements.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media on a regular basis.
Assist senior faculty and postgraduate students in ongoing research projects, data collection, and analysis.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe if not already completed.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in routine departmental administrative tasks and planning.
Participate in hospital quality improvement initiatives and NABH accreditation activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes and professional development activities.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) will hold a senior academic and clinical faculty role at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will lead undergraduate and postgraduate medical teaching in forensic pathology, forensic toxicology, medical jurisprudence, and forensic evidence, while overseeing mortuary operations, toxicology laboratory supervision, and medico-legal case management. This is a faculty leadership role requiring a highly experienced academic with strong publication credentials, deep NMC compliance, and demonstrated expertise in forensic medicine in a teaching hospital setting.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, practical sessions, clinical classes, and demonstrations in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as per university curriculum.
Conduct postgraduate (MD/DNB) classes, seminars, and case-based learning sessions in forensic pathology, toxicology, and medico-legal aspects.
Lead and supervise autopsy teaching sessions for MBBS students and PG trainees ensuring pedagogical clarity and adherence to safety and ethical standards.
Mentor postgraduate students in thesis formulation, research methodology, and case study documentation.
Participate in curriculum planning, academic assessment, and examination processes for UG and PG programmes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required, ensuring academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Supervise and oversee toxicology laboratory investigations, ensuring accuracy, chain of custody, and medico-legal compliance of specimens and reports.
Ensure proper mortuary management, including adherence to safety protocols, infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling of remains.
Conduct and supervise medico-legal autopsies, post-mortem examinations, and forensic evidence collection in accordance with legal and institutional standards.
Prepare medico-legal reports and expert opinions for courts, law enforcement agencies, and institutional authorities as required.
Liaise with judicial, police, and government agencies on medico-legal matters affecting the institution and the community.
Ensure compliance with NABH standards in all forensic and mortuary operations.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC criteria, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit medical articles and forensic science commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead and contribute to departmental research initiatives in forensic toxicology, forensic pathology, and medico-legal sciences.
Guide postgraduate students in original research and thesis work.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and quality improvement initiatives.
Participate actively in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality reviews, and institutional committees.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national conferences, and forensic medicine professional bodies.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a recognized institution.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in FMT, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for becoming Associate Professor.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).
Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education (where FMT is covered under UG training).
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.

Description:
Role: Consultant Nephrologist

Organization Overview
This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.

The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.
Dialysis Services: Oversee and manage the Dialysis Unit, which is equipped with modern hemodialysis machines (currently 8 units, including isolation facilities) and expertise in Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD).
Critical Care Nephrology: Collaborate with the intensive care team to manage complex cases requiring renal replacement therapy (CRRT, SLED) in the 46-bed ICU setup.
Patient Consultation: Conduct regular outpatient consultations, providing holistic treatment plans that include lifestyle modification and dietary guidance in coordination with nutritionists.
Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with General Medicine, Cardiology, Urology, and other specialities to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, particularly for diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy.
Procedures: Perform necessary nephrological procedures such as renal biopsies and placement of temporary vascular access for dialysis.
Quality Assurance: Adhere to national accreditation standards (NABH protocols) and hospital policies to ensure the highest quality of patient safety and care delivery.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Post-Graduate Qualification: M.D. or DNB in General Medicine or Paediatrics from a recognized institution.
Required Super Speciality Qualification: D.M. in Nephrology (Recognized by the National Medical Commission) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience Preference: Crucially, priority will be given to candidates who have gained their experience in recognized university or teaching hospital settings.
Note: Experience is strictly counted only after the completion of the super specialization.

Compensation
Salary Range: INR 3.5 Lakhs to INR 4.5 Lakhs per month.
Determination: Final offer will be commensurate with the candidate's specific post-DM / M.Ch experience and expertise.

Additional Information
Nature of Role: This is a full-time Clinical Practitioner position.
Academic Profile: While an academic profile (publications, research) is not mandatory, the clinical expertise gained in an academic environment is highly valued.
Facility Highlights: The selected candidate will practice in a facility that acts as a tertiary care referral centre for the entire state and neighbouring regions, backed by comprehensive support services including a 24-hour central laboratory and blood bank.
