Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges\ and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Description


Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements. Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantage
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and enterprise integrations. The candidate will be responsible for building robust APIs, integrating business applications such as Salesforce and Microsoft 365, and developing secure, event-driven backend workflows using Python and Azure services.
The role requires strong backend engineering fundamentals, experience with cloud-based application development, API integrations, authentication mechanisms and distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Build and manage REST APIs for integrating enterprise applications and business systems.
Develop integrations with Salesforce, SharePoint, Outlook and Microsoft Teams using REST APIs and Microsoft Graph API.
Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs and event-driven workflows.
Work with Azure services including Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, App Service, API Management and Service Bus/Event Grid.
Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 and managed identities.
Design and manage application state, data persistence and long-running workflows using Cosmos DB.
Implement error handling, retries, idempotency, timeouts and fault-tolerant mechanisms.
Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues and maintain structured logging and audit trails.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable backend solutions.

Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management
Support the Cluster Lead in overseeing daily facility management operations across assigned communities.
Ensure implementation and adherence to FM guidelines, SOPs, statutory requirements, and work instructions.
Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management
Guide, mentor, and supervise Site Managers, Community Executives, and operational teams.
Ensure manpower deployment, attendance management, roster adherence, and workforce productivity.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of site teams.
Drive a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management
Review operational expenses and support budget control across assigned sites.
Monitor monthly budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate with Finance for billing, collections, vendor payments, and financial reconciliations.
Assist in achieving revenue and profitability targets for assigned communities.

Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Management Committees, and Developer Representatives.
Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience
Drive resident satisfaction by ensuring timely resolution of complaints and service requests.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Vendor Management
Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
Conduct periodic vendor reviews and service quality audits.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and operational standards.
Support onboarding and governance of service partners.

Compliance & Governance
Ensure adherence to EHS guidelines, statutory compliances, and internal audit requirements.
Monitor documentation, licenses, certifications, and compliance trackers.
Support implementation of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.

Review & Reporting
Prepare and review Monthly Management Reports (MMR), operational dashboards, and business review presentations.
Track key operational, financial, and customer experience metrics.
Share periodic updates with stakeholders and management on site performance.

Educational Qualification
Any Graduate / BE/ B.Tech/ MBA/ Hospitality courses/ BHM (Any)

Experience
8-17 years of experience in Facility Management, Property Management, Community Management, or Operations.
Experience managing residential townships, premium housing societies, or mixed-use developments preferred.
Prior experience leading multiple sites and vendor management is desirable.

Overview

Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle-from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. Your Role

Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.

Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices methodologies in BIM implementation.

Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers' calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.

Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.

Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Description:
About Darwinbox
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

What this role is
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, andemployee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer aboutconfiguration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helpingorganizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes,adoption, and decision-making.
This role sits at the intersection of:
Enterprise consulting
Product thinking
Customer transformation
Large-scale SaaS delivery
You will act as:
A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
The Voice of Customer internally across Product and Engineering
An owner responsible for customer outcomes not just go-live milestones
What the work looks like
You wont just inherit a project plan. Youll inherit ambiguity.
A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesnt.
A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.
Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirementand drive the transformation end-to-end.
That means:
Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operateseparately.
Who thrives here
People who think in systems.
People who naturally ask: Will this scale / What breaks after go-live / Are we solving the actual customer problem
People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.
What we explicitly dont optimize for
Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
Delivery managers who only track timelines
Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
Governance without ownership
Implementation thinking without business context
What were looking for
612 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving
Lastly, what we are not looking for , were not looking fortraditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely notpeople who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

Description:
Job Summary
The Chief Client Office engages customers and key stakeholders to drive commercial growth and create measurable value for S&P Global, strengthening client relationships and the overall client experience across the enterprise. The Chief Client Officer also serves as Co Head of Market Intelligence, with a mandate spanning Client Coverage, Enterprise Marketing, Commercial Strategy & Partnerships, Kensho Data & Platforms, and functions including Legal, COO, and Client Experience (CX) with alignment across enterprise Technology.
The Impact: The Business Execution Lead keeps the Office's recurring work moving - gathering inputs and packaging the Weekly Briefing Pack and Analytics packs for the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence, coordinating executive readiness for meetings and events, and responding to ad hoc requests and priority initiatives. This hands-on role gives the Chief of Staff reliable, high-quality execution support and helps the Office run smoothly in a fast-paced, complex environment.
Key Responsibilities
Own the Weekly Briefing Pack and the Chief Client Office and Market Intelligence Weekly Analytics packs end-to-end - gathering inputs, compiling and quality controlling materials, and driving continuous improvement.
Build a clear, forward-looking view of the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence's week - meetings, objectives, context, and preparation needs.
Translate priorities into clear work plans, milestones, and timelines, driving multiple workstreams simultaneously and building trusted working relationships across the Chief Client Office, Market Intelligence, Kensho Data & Platforms, and other stakeholders - setting clear expectations for quality, timing, and follow-through, and escalating early with clear context, options, and a recommended path forward on matters requiring strategic judgment or sensitive stakeholder management.
Coordinate readiness for client meetings, speaking engagements, conferences, and leadership events wherever the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is working or traveling - including London, New York, and other locations - partnering with local offices, the Executive Assistant, and relevant business and functional teams to ensure briefing materials clearly set out context, objectives, stakeholders, decisions required, and expected outcomes.
Own the Office Stakeholder Matrix and maintain Office calendars, action trackers, and decision logs, giving stakeholders clear visibility into priorities, status, and outstanding requirements.
Support Chief of Staff-led OpCo meetings, leadership forums, and offsites as requested - including readiness, materials, and action tracking - with increasing ownership as experience grows.
Continuously improve recurring deliverables and office workflows, building repeatable processes and templates that reduce manual effort and improve consistency and scalability.
Use AI and automation tools approved by S&P Global to support information gathering, summarization, content development, and quality checking, maintaining sound judgment, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable S&P Global requirements.
Respond to ad hoc executive requests and support selected cross-functional priority initiatives.
What We're Looking For
Experience in financial services is strongly preferred, ideally in a client-facing role involving significant interaction with institutional clients and senior stakeholders.
Proven experience driving execution in an executive office, Chief of Staff organization, PMO, business operations team, or similarly complex environment, with a demonstrated ability to navigate across functions, businesses, geographies, and levels of seniority to build alignment and get things done.
Demonstrated ability to own recurring executive deliverables end-to-end and produce complete, accurate, executive-ready materials.
Strong ability to assimilate information, synthesize key themes, identify gaps, and translate fragmented inputs into clear materials.
Excellent project coordination, organization, written communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work through ambiguity, meet tight timelines, and maintain attention to detail.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and executive level matters.
Comfortable navigating sensitive or difficult topics with stakeholders at all levels, exercising tact, diplomacy, and sound judgment while maintaining trust and confidentiality.
Experience with Microsoft 365 and AI productivity and workflow automation tools.
A continuous-improvement mindset, strong personal accountability, and a commitment to proactive communication and follow-through.
Expected to be in the office whenever the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is in the office and to comply with the applicable S&P Global in-office attendance policy.
What Success Looks Like
Executive deliverables are complete, accurate, timely, forward-looking, and ready for use.
Stakeholders are engaged, routine issues are resolved promptly, and strategic matters are escalated early with clear recommendations.
Executive engagements and events are consistently well prepared across London, New York, and other locations where the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is working or traveling.
Commitments, deadlines, dependencies, decisions, and risks remain visible and are followed through to completion.
Approved technology and AI tools reduce manual effort and improve consistency without compromising judgment, confidentiality, or accuracy.

Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking a CANDU Quality Specialist to support the delivery of world-class nuclear projects across the global CANDU portfolio.
Reporting to Quality function, you will provide independent quality assurance oversight to ensure engineering and project activities are delivered in compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, customer commitments, and the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
You will play a key role in strengthening quality culture, driving compliance, managing quality risks, and ensuring the objective evidence, traceability, and governance required to support safe, reliable, and Right First-Time delivery within a highly regulated nuclear environment.
Your Role
Nuclear Quality Assurance
Support the implementation and continual improvement of the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, project, and management system requirements.
Support the development and execution of project Quality Assurance Plans and quality oversight strategies.
Provide independent quality assurance support across engineering and project delivery activities.
Promote a strong Nuclear Safety Culture and Quality Culture across project teams.
Engineering Quality
Provide quality assurance oversight of design and engineering processes.
Verify compliance with design control, verification, validation, and configuration management requirements.
Support quality reviews and assessments of engineering deliverables and records.
Identify quality risks and drive timely resolution of quality concerns.
Ensure objective evidence is maintained to demonstrate compliance with project and regulatory requirements.
Audit, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Conduct audits, surveillances, and compliance assessments.
Support customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections.
Manage quality findings, non-conformances, and corrective actions through to effective closure.
Facilitate root cause analysis and lessons learned activities.
Analyse quality trends and identify opportunities to improve performance and reduce risk.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide quality guidance and coaching to project teams and stakeholders.
Communicate quality performance, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to management.
About You
The successful candidate will demonstrate uncompromising integrity, a strong commitment to Nuclear Safety Culture, and the confidence to provide objective and independent quality assurance oversight, even when faced with challenging project pressures.
They will possess exceptional attention to detail, a questioning attitude, and the professional judgement required to identify quality risks, challenge assumptions, and ensure compliance with nuclear quality requirements.
The individual will be highly analytical, disciplined, and evidence-driven, with a passion for delivering quality outcomes through rigorous verification, traceability, and continual improvement.
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills are essential, enabling them to build trusted relationships with engineering, project, supply chain, and quality teams while promoting accountability, learning, and Right First-Time delivery.
Above all, they will be recognised as a dependable quality professional who upholds the highest standards of safety, compliance, and technical excellence in support of global CANDU nuclear projects.
Essential Qualifications and Experience
Degree in Engineering and Quality Management
Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Nuclear Quality, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience implementing and maintaining Quality Management Systems and Quality Assurance Programs.
Experience conducting audits, assessments, supplier oversight, or compliance activities.
Experience managing non-conformances, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Essential Technical Knowledge
Working knowledge of
CSA N299 Series
CSA N286
ASME NQA-1

Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.
The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.
The position is Full-time with the opportunity for hybrid home/office working.
The Role:
The role will include:
Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.

Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.

Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.

Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team supporting Middle East projects based out of India
The role will provide economic, demographic and real estate market analysis to support development advisory, urban planning, master planning and infrastructure planning assignments. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including:
Land-use and development demand; Real estate asset mix and scale; Housing and employment requirements; Social infrastructure needs; Development capacity and absorption; Development and infrastructure phasing; and Investment priorities.
The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors.
The role is based in India and support projects in Dubai and across the UAE, KSA and the wider Middle East.
Your Role
Roles Responsibilities
Urban and Spatial Economics
Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes.
Prepare population, household, employment and economic forecasts at regional, city, district and development levels.
Translate growth forecasts into spatial requirements for residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and community development.
Assess relationships between economic activity, population distribution, employment, accessibility, land use and infrastructure provision.
Develop and test alternative growth and development scenarios and assess their spatial implications.
Prepare socio-economic baselines, city and regional benchmarks, economic impact assessments and wider-benefits analysis.
Translate demographic forecasts into requirements for housing and social infrastructure, including education, healthcare, recreation and community facilities.
Work with planning and GIS teams to spatially represent population, employment, economic activity and development demand.
Real Estate Economics
Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes.
Analyse market drivers, existing and planned supply, occupancy, take-up, pricing, absorption and competing developments.
Prepare development demand forecasts for residential, office, retail, hospitality, industrial and other real estate uses.
Provide economic and market inputs into development positioning, land-use mix, scale, density and phasing.
Assess the market supportability and absorption of proposed development programmes.
Support highest-and-best-use studies, development strategies, land strategies and master plans.
Test development scenarios against economic, demographic and real estate market conditions.
Work with financial advisors to align market assumptions, development programmes and financial feasibility.
Provide evidence to support development, land-use and investment decisions.
Development and Infrastructure Planning
Translate population, employment and real estate forecasts into high-level infrastructure and service-demand assumptions.
Support infrastructure planners in understanding how development growth affects transport, utilities, municipal services and social infrastructure.
Identify development dependencies and infrastructure triggers affecting land release, development sequencing and phasing.
Support the alignment of real estate absorption, development delivery and infrastructure investment.
Provide economic and demand inputs into infrastructure strategies, investment plans and business cases.
Project Delivery
Lead defined urban and real estate economics workstreams within multidisciplinary advisory assignments.
Develop clear methodologies, analytical frameworks, forecast models and evidence bases.
Gather and analyse quantitative and qualitative information from government, commercial and client sources.
Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, working papers and executive summaries.
Translate complex analysis into clear findings and practical recommendations for planning, development and investment decisions.
Present analysis and recommendations to clients and project stakeholders.
Business and Practice Development
Contribute to technical and commercial proposals across development advisory, urban planning, real estate and infrastructure planning.
Support client engagement and the identification of new business opportunities.
Develop reusable datasets, forecasting tools, analytical methodologies and templates.
Contribute to market insights and thought leadership on urban growth, real estate development and regional economic trends.
Share knowledge and good practice across Advisory and the wider AtkinsRalis business.
Support the professional development of junior economists and analysts.
Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery.
About You
Qualifications Skills
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Real Estate Economics, Urban Economics, Economic Geography, Regional Science, Urban Planning or a related discipline.
Master's degree in Urban Economics, Real Estate, Economics, Development Economics, Economic Geography, Urban Planning or a related field is preferred.
Professional Experience / Qualifications
Typically +8 years of relevant experience;
Experience in urban economics, real estate economics, development advisory, socio-economics or a related consulting discipline.
Demonstrable ability to translate economic and demographic forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements.
Experience supporting master plans, development strategies, regional plans, regeneration programmes or major real estate developments.
Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes.
Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure.
Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability.
Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable.
Experience in the UAE, KSA or wider GCC is strongly preferred.
Experience within a consultancy, development authority, planning agency, real estate advisor or government organisation is advantageous.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to move from data and evidence to practical recommendations.
Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions.
Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Associate Consultant - Risk - Internal Audit
The opportunity
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract.

Associate Consultant - Risk - Internal Audit
Job Summary
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract.
You will be responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of governance, risk & compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance.
Responsibilities
Execution on client engagements; ensure quality delivery as per client requirements.
Review of working papers and client folders; suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Understand business and industry issues/trends; identify areas requiring improvement in the client's business processes to enable preparation of recommendations.
Handling data analytics - Access, ACL etc.
Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality & risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application & solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.
Develop strong working relationships with client (process owner/functional heads).
Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Bring and utilize extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business.


Skills and Attributes for Success
Determine that the work delivered is of high quality.
Anticipate and identify engagement related risks and escalate issues as appropriate.
Actively establish client (process owner/functional heads) and internal relationships.
Assist and share knowledge with team members, Seniors and Managers in developing new methodologies and internal initiatives and participate in performing procedures especially focusing on complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues.
Work with the team and the client to create plans for accomplishing engagement objectives and a strategy that complies with professional standards and advise clients to understand and manage their business risks and verify the validity of their business information.
Brief the engagement team on the client's IA environment and industry IA trends. Maintain relationships with client management to manage expectations of service, including work products, timing, and deliverables.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of compliance, financial, and operational risks along with performing internal control testing, develop internal audit plans, and provide internal audit services on an outsourcing basis. Assess internal controls and SOX framework in order to mitigate risk and apply it to client situations.

What drives us
A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. "
What drives us
A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. Thats the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive
Assist in the development and execution of strategic programs for the CoE.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure program milestones are met.
Participate in program reviews and contribute to reporting processes.
Support the planning, scheduling, and tracking of various projects within the CoE.
Assist in preparing presentations, reports, and updates for management.
Manage documentation and maintain records of all program activities
Support continuous improvement initiatives by collecting feedback and providing analysis
Assist in gathering, analyzing, and presenting program-related data.
Develop insights and recommendations based on data analysis to improve program outcomes.

Who are we looking for
Currently pursuing a Bachelor s/Master s in Business, Project Management, or related fields.
Strong organizational and communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; knowledge of project management tools is a plus.
Analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.

Gear up and join our winning and exciting team at Cars24, where every day is a drive towards success!

Description:
Job Summary
What drives us
A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. Thats the future we are building at CaOur mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.
Responsibilities
SB Partner Automation: Build automated workflows for live reconciliation, partner communication, franchise lead visibility, channel-wise lead tracking, conversions, calling metrics, and inventory lead movement.
Access Management Automation: Create an end-to-end workflow for RA allocation, store and email ID creation, access provisioning, approvals, removals, and audit tracking.
Elite Incentive Tracker: Develop a live tracker to automate incentive calculations, monitor payout readiness, and provide real-time stakeholder visibility.
GS Pricing Engine: Build an AI- and data-led pricing engine for luxury and non-luxury procurement to enable faster, consistent, and governed pricing decisions.
Recon Master - FRS: Automate monthly reconciliation up to the pre-approval stage, covering pending actions, exceptions, partner communication, and closure tracking.
Partner with Product, Technology, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Category teams to drive implementation and adoption.
Define project milestones, success metrics, governance mechanisms, and process documentation.
Requirements
Experience in program management, business operations, automation, analytics, or digital transformation.
Strong ability to translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions.
Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, SQL, and BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Exposure to workflow automation, APIs, low-code platforms, AI, or pricing models is preferred.
Strong analytical, project-management, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
An ownership-driven professional with excellent problem-solving, communication, and execution skills.
Gear up and join our winning and exciting team at Cawhere every day is a drive towards success!

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled GCP Cloud Engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and automation. Compute Engine (GCE)

Cloud Storage (GCS)
BigQuery
Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
Cloud SQL

Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good to Have
Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification.
Knowledge of Python or Shell scripting.
Exposure to DevOps practices and automation.
Understanding of AWS or Azure cloud platforms.
Candidate Expectations
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Here is a professional Job Description for an Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo, suitable for recruitment portals, LinkedIn, and internal hiring.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo
Department: Operations
Designation: Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)
Industry: Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) / Food & Beverage
Reports To: Restaurant Manager / Area Operations Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: As per business requirement
About WOW! momo
WOW! momo is one of India’s leading homegrown QSR brands, known for its innovative food offerings, customer-centric approach, and fast-growing restaurant network. We are looking for energetic, customer-focused, and result-oriented professionals to join our restaurant operations team.
Job Purpose
To support the Restaurant Manager in managing day-to-day restaurant operations, ensuring excellent customer experience, maintaining food quality and safety standards, driving sales and profitability, and developing a motivated team that consistently delivers WOW! service.
Key Responsibilities
1. Restaurant Operations
Manage daily restaurant operations and ensure smooth functioning across all shifts.
Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational checklists, and company policies.
Monitor opening and closing activities, equipment functionality, cleanliness, and overall restaurant readiness.
Ensure timely order preparation, accurate billing, and efficient order delivery.
2. Sales & Business Performance
Drive daily sales and achieve assigned sales targets.
Monitor key performance indicators such as average order value, customer footfall, order accuracy, and sales growth.
Identify opportunities to improve upselling, cross-selling, and customer conversions.
Support cost control initiatives and improve restaurant profitability.
3. People Management & Development
Lead, coach, and motivate Team Members and Shift Managers.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective shift scheduling.
Drive employee engagement, attendance, discipline, and retention.
Train team members on product knowledge, customer service, food preparation, and operational standards.
Identify high-potential employees and support their career growth through on-the-job training and development.
4. Customer Experience
Ensure exceptional customer service and a positive dining experience.
Handle customer complaints and resolve service issues promptly.
Maintain service speed, product consistency, and order accuracy.
Build customer loyalty through friendly, efficient, and professional service.
5. Food Safety & Quality
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and food handling standards.
Monitor product quality, portion control, freshness, and adherence to recipes.
Ensure proper storage, stock rotation, and expiry-date monitoring.
Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic restaurant environment.
6. Inventory & Cost Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely stock replenishment.
Minimize food wastage, pilferage, and operational losses.
Conduct stock counts and support inventory reconciliation.
Monitor consumption, food cost, packaging cost, and other controllable expenses.
7. Cash Management & Compliance
Ensure accurate cash handling, billing, POS operations, and end-of-day reconciliation.
Maintain operational records, registers, and reports as required.
Follow company policies and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper handling of cash, inventory, and other company assets.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate preferred; candidates with relevant qualifications and QSR experience may also be considered.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in restaurant operations, preferably in QSR, food service, or retail operations.
Prior experience in team handling, shift management, customer service, and sales performance is preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Customer-first attitude and problem-solving ability.
Sales orientation and business acumen.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
Knowledge of inventory management, cash handling, and food safety.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays as per business requirements.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of restaurant sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
Food cost, wastage, and controllable expense management.
Employee attendance, retention, and manpower availability.
Food safety, hygiene, and audit compliance scores.
Order accuracy and service speed.
Team productivity, training completion, and internal promotions.
Career Growth
At WOW! momo, high-performing Assistant Restaurant Managers can develop their leadership capabilities and progress toward Restaurant Manager and higher operations leadership roles, based on performance and business requirements.
Why Join WOW! momo?
Opportunity to work with a growing Indian QSR brand.
Performance-driven work culture.
Hands-on operational and leadership development.
Career growth opportunities within the organization.
Join WOW! momo and be part of a team that delivers great food, great service, and a WOW! customer experience every day.
AboutCompany:
Wow! Momo's FMCG Business Overview
Wow! Momo, while primarily known for its QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) chain, is also making significant strides in the FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) sector. Here's a breakdown of the FMCG business:
Key Aspects:
Product Range:
Frozen Momos: This is a core offering, allowing customers to enjoy Wow! Momo's products at home.
Wow! Noodles: A recent addition, featuring a range of "Desi-Asian" flavored instant noodles.
Other Products: Includes items like Wow! Smiley, with plans to expand into categories like kulfi, Beverages called coco charge
Growth and Strategy:
Aggressive expansion in the FMCG segment is underway.
The company aims to establish the FMCG division as a substantial revenue contributor.
Focus on both online (e-commerce, especially quick commerce) and offline (general trade stores, modern trade outlets) distribution channels.
Financials:
The FMCG segment is currently smaller than the QSR business but exhibits rapid growth.
Ambitious revenue targets have been set for the FMCG division.
Overall: Wow! Momo is leveraging its brand to diversify into the FMCG sector, offering convenient food products to a broader consumer base.

Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
