Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:

Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

Role & responsibilities

Location: Assam
Position: EHS Officer
Industry: Construction / Infrastructure

Job Purpose
The EHS Officer will be responsible for implementing and monitoring Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) practices at the construction site, ensuring compliance with safety standards, occupational health requirements and environmental management plans.

Educational Qualification & Experience
- Graduate in Civil Engineering with a minimum of 5 years of on-site experience, OR

- Experience working as an EHS Officer in the construction of multi-storied buildings is mandatory.

- Implement and monitor site safety procedures and EHS policies.
- Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety standards.
- Conduct regular site safety inspections and identify potential hazards.
- Monitor implementation of Environment Management Plans (EMP).
- Ensure workers follow safety guidelines and use appropriate PPE.
- Conduct safety inductions, toolbox talks and awareness sessions.
- Investigate site accidents, incidents and near misses.
- Maintain safety documentation, inspection reports and compliance records.
- Coordinate with project teams and contractors to ensure a safe working environment.

Mandatory Requirements
1. Civil Engineering Graduate/Diploma qualification.
2. Relevant on-site EHS experience.
3. Mandatory experience in multi-storied building construction.
4. Hands-on experience in site safety and occupational health & safety.
5. Experience implementing Environmental Management Plans.

Products Segment - Vascular, Aneasthesia, Neonates, Vascular, Hemodynamics , Critical Care,
Role Overview:
The Territory Executive will be responsible for driving sales growth within the assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and promoting the company's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities -
Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers, including hospitals, nursing homes, healthcare institutions, and distributors.
Promote and demonstrate company products to healthcare professionals and key decision-makers.
Generate product demand through regular field visits and customer engagement activities.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to territory revenue growth.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, surgeons, nursing staff, purchase managers, biomedical teams, OT technicians, and other key stakeholders.
Provide product-related training, demonstrations, and support to customers.
Ensure consistent follow-up with existing customers to strengthen business
Ensure timely secondary sales generation and coordinate with internal teams for efficient order processing and product delivery.
Monitor inventory availability and support demand forecasting activities.
Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collections in line with company policies.
Maintain accurate sales records and submit periodic sales and market reports as required.

Preferred candidate profile -
Minimum 4 years experience in sales of Medical Devices / Pharma industry.
Experience working with specialists such as Anesthesiologists, Pediatricians, Neonatologists, Oncologists, and Surgeons will be preferred.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.

Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights
Data Interpretation and Business Performance Management
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.)
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Role & responsibilities
Collect overdue payments from customers through calls, visits, and follow-ups.

Description:
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects is inviting applications for the position of Graduate Engineer (Civil) at our Jorhat office.
We are a professional architectural and engineering firm based in Jorhat, Assam, working in the fields of architectural design, civil engineering, structural planning, interior design, building permission drawings, and turnkey construction projects . Our project portfolio includes residential buildings, commercial buildings, interior projects, institutional buildings, hotels, resorts, and other architectural works across Assam.
We are looking for a sincere, disciplined, and technically sound Civil Engineering graduate who is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with our design and construction team.
Position
Graduate Engineer (Civil)
Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects 2nd Floor, Above Naffy Restaurant, Baruah Chariali, Opposite Westside Shopping Mall, Jorhat, Assam
Eligibility
The candidate should have:
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Basic knowledge of building construction, RCC works, finishing works, and site execution
Basic understanding of drawings, plans, sections, elevations, and structural details
Knowledge of AutoCAD will be preferred
Basic knowledge of estimation, quantity calculation, and BOQ preparation will be an added advantage
Good communication skills and willingness to work in a team
Freshers may apply
Job Responsibilities
The selected candidate will be involved in:
Reading and understanding architectural and structural drawings
Preparing basic quantity calculations and material estimates
Assisting in site supervision and construction monitoring
Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and site workers
Checking site work as per approved drawings and specifications
Preparing site reports, measurement sheets, and work progress updates
Supporting the team in building permission drawings, BOQ preparation, and project documentation
Maintaining proper technical records and project files
Learning office standards, construction detailing, and professional project workflow
Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who is:
Serious about building a career in civil engineering and construction
Ready to learn both office-based technical work and site execution work
Punctual, honest, and responsible
Able to follow instructions and maintain professional discipline
Interested in residential, commercial, interior, and turnkey building projects
Comfortable working in a structured office environment
Experience
Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0 to 1 year of experience will be preferred.
Interview Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects Jorhat Head Office

Description:
APM Terminals
The Warehouse Manager is responsible for overseeing daily operations of a warehouse handling direct-to-consumer distribution. This role ensures seamless order fulfillment, inventory accuracy, and efficient warehouse operations while meeting customer satisfaction goals and adhering to safety and compliance standards. The role also ensures timely sorting, grading, transformation, and distribution of products to dark stores while maintaining quality, cold chain integrity, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities Operations Management
Oversee all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order picking, packing, and shipping.
Implement and optimize processes to meet daily order fulfillment goals.
Ensure timely sorting, grading, transformation, and delivery while maintaining stock availability for all dark stores.
Handle complete day-to-day warehouse operations, including cold chain management, within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP adherence.
Inventory Control
Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and audits.
Manage inventory accuracy and share daily stock audit reports.
Collaborate with procurement and sales teams to forecast and manage stock levels.
Ensure timely inventory liquidation (damaged and expired) as per SOP and customer SLA.
Team Leadership
Supervise, train, and motivate warehouse staff, including pickers, packers, and inventory personnel.
Manage shift schedules to ensure adequate staffing during peak periods.
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of resources such as contract associates, security staff, and transportation.
Technology Utilization
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS) to track inventory and orders efficiently.
Ensure staff are properly trained on WMS and other operational technology tools.
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP.
Customer Experience Vendor Management
Ensure all orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time to maintain high customer satisfaction.
Address and resolve any order discrepancies or operational issues promptly.
Manage relationships with third-party vendors and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently met.
Review vendor invoices thoroughly to ensure accuracy in calculations, rates, and supporting documentation, verifying alignment with contracts, SLAs, or purchase orders.
Safety Compliance
Enforce adherence to safety standards and operational regulations within the warehouse.
Ensure compliance with labor laws, health standards, and cold chain handling requirements.
Reporting KPIs
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as order accuracy, delivery timelines, inventory turnover, and productivity.
Ensure daily KPIs agreed with the customer are achieved and presented during daily operational reviews.
Track productivity across warehouse processes and minimize process waste to control variable costs.
Use operational data and insights to identify improvement opportunities.
Required Experience Skills
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
Proven experience of 10+ years managing grocery or FMCG warehouse operations, preferably involving fresh produce or cold chain logistics.
Strong experience in warehouse management systems (WMS), SAP, and inventory control processes.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendor relationships and SLA-driven operations.
Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational abilities.

Description:
Operations Executive Job Summary
As an Operations Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operational processes to ensure efficient report production, delivery, and client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including research, editorial, and sales, to streamline workflows, manage project timelines, and maintain high-quality standards. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. If you are a proactive problem-solver with a passion for operational excellence, we invite you to join our dynamic team.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee and optimize the end-to-end operational processes related to report production, including data collection, analysis, report writing, and quality assurance.
Ensure smooth coordination and communication across teams involved in the report production process, including research, editorial, design, and sales.
Manage project timelines and deadlines, identifying and resolving potential bottlenecks to ensure timely delivery of reports to clients.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline operations and maintain consistency and quality across report production.
Conduct regular quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established standards and guidelines.
Optimize operational workflows and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness.
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to operational processes in the market research industry.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or masters degree in business, operations management, or a related field.
Proven experience in operations management, preferably within the market research or publishing industry.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail, with a focus on maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement effective solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Proactive mindset with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and propose innovative solutions.
Knowledge of market research methodologies and report production processes is preferred.
If you are a detail-oriented operations professional with a passion for optimizing processes and ensuring operational excellence, we invite you to join our team as an Operations Executive. Together, we will streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and deliver high-quality market research reports to our clients, contributing to their business success in a competitive marketplace.

Description:
Research Associate Job Summary
As a Research Associate at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in conducting extensive market research and analysis to support the development and publication of syndicated market reports. You will collaborate closely with our research team to gather and analyze data, identify market trends, and provide valuable insights to our clients. This position requires strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for staying updated on market developments.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive research on various industries and markets to gather relevant data and information.
Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to provide insights that contribute to the development of high-quality reports.
Collect and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from diverse sources, including industry databases, research reports, company websites, and government publications.
Collaborate with the research team to define research objectives, methodologies, and timelines for each project.
Conduct primary and secondary research, including interviews, surveys, and data mining, to gather accurate and up-to-date information.
Evaluate and validate data quality, ensuring its reliability and relevance to the research objectives.
Analyze research findings using statistical techniques and data visualization tools to create insightful and visually appealing reports.
Prepare well-structured, concise, and informative written reports that effectively communicate research findings and recommendations to clients.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance the quality and relevance of research reports.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and editorial, to ensure timely delivery and effective promotion of syndicate reports.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, marketing, market research, science and technology or a related field.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to research, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends.
If you are a highly motivated individual with a keen interest in market analysis, we invite you to join our dynamic team as a Research Associate. Together, we will contribute to the production of insightful syndicate market reports that enable our clients to make informed business decisions in a rapidly evolving market landscape.

Digital Marketing Executive Job Summary
As a Digital Marketing Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in driving digital marketing strategies to promote our reports, expand our online presence, and engage our target audience. You will be responsible for developing and executing digital marketing campaigns, managing social media platforms, optimizing website content, and analyzing campaign performance. This position requires a strong understanding of digital marketing channels, excellent communication skills, and a passion for leveraging digital platforms to reach and influence potential customers.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to promote market research reports and increase brand visibility and engagement.
Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across various channels, including search engines, social media, email, and display advertising.
Manage and maintain social media platforms, creating compelling content and engaging with the audience to drive brand awareness and foster community engagement.
Monitor and analyze key performance metrics, such as website traffic, conversion rates, and engagement levels, to identify areas for improvement and optimize marketing efforts.
Conduct keyword research and optimize website content to improve search engine visibility and drive organic traffic.
Collaborate with internal teams to create persuasive marketing materials, including landing pages, blog posts, email newsletters, and promotional videos, to align digital marketing efforts with overall business goals.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging digital marketing technologies to implement innovative strategies and techniques.
Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and competitive positioning.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in marketing, digital marketing, communications, or a related field.
Solid understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and display advertising.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging content and effectively communicate with the target audience.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and metrics to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance.
Creative mindset with a keen eye for design aesthetics and the ability to create visually appealing digital assets.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
If you are a results-oriented individual with a passion for digital marketing and the ability to drive impactful marketing campaigns, we invite you to join our team as a Digital Marketing Executive. Together, we will leverage digital platforms and strategies to promote our market research reports, engage our audience, and drive business growth in a competitive market landscape.

Description:
Sales Executive Job Summary
As a Sales Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a pivotal role in driving sales growth and expanding our client base. You will be responsible for generating new business leads, nurturing client relationships, and closing sales deals. This position requires strong sales acumen, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the market research industry. If you are a self-motivated and results-driven individual with a passion for sales and a knack for building strong client relationships, we invite you to join our dynamic team
Key Responsibilities
Identify and pursue new business opportunities by proactively generating leads and establishing connections with potential clients.
Conduct market research and analysis to identify target industries and sectors for sales prospecting.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to foster loyalty and secure repeat business.
Deliver persuasive sales presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients, showcasing the value and benefits of our syndicated market research reports.
Understand client needs, provide customized solutions, and effectively communicate the unique value propositions of our reports to drive sales conversions.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement effective sales strategies, campaigns, and promotional materials.
Utilize CRM systems and sales tools to track sales activities, manage leads, and monitor the sales pipeline.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.
Attend industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events to expand professional networks and generate new sales leads.
Collaborate with internal teams, including research, marketing, and customer support, to ensure client satisfaction and seamless execution of sales processes.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
Proven experience in sales, preferably within the market research industry or a related field.
Strong sales acumen with a track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate the value propositions of our syndicated market research reports.

Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.
OR

Administering Employee Training Programs

- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision.
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Managing Training Budgets
- Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.
- Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.
- Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

Job description

Roles and Responsibilities
The organization does fuelling and defueling of aircrafts at various airports throughout the country. The new recruits will be thoroughly trained in all operations and procedures which they will be required to perform in the course of their job and in all actions that are to be taken in the event of an emergency.
Since the activity of fueling & de-fueling is done with the aid of Mobilized machinery/ equipment the person concerned should be able to drive an LMV/HTV vehicle comfortably.

Carry out into plane service including refueling and defueling (Receive refueling instructions from Shift Manager)
Conduct Quality Control checks on the fuel on mobile facilities and necessary documentation
Issue and sign fuel delivery receipts with respect to fuel supplies
Conduct in-situ field tests
Carry Sampling of Jet A-1 and forward the same to laboratories
Perform verification of in-use pressure gauges, hydrometers, etc.
Conduct periodic preventive maintenance on all equipment
Conduct minor maintenance and operations checks/works on the equipment
Coordination with customers/ DGCA Officials/ BSSPL officials in conducting Audits & inspections
Give timely, safe, and courteous into plane services to the airline customers
Sales/ stock accounting to be made at the end of each shift
Tank Lorry/ pipeline receipts of product and related stock accounting
Other Admin/ operations related works

Desired Candidate Profile
Candidates who have completed their B.E. / B. Tech./Diploma may only apply.
Candidates should mandatorily have a Light Motor(LMV), minimum 3 years old driving license.
Candidates with Heavy Vehicle License and/or experience in Service/ Automobile Industry/ ground handling agencies at the airport will be preferred.
Candidate should be a team player and should have the ability to handle a team cordially.
Candidates Should be ready to work in round the clock Shift pattern
Candidates should have good command over English Language
Candidate should have good working knowledge of MS Office
Candidate should be ready to work at PAN India location.

Description:
As the original house of luxury, St.
Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service.
At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury.
It is high-touch, personalized, creative and original.
It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
The Senior Butler oversees the functioning and delivery of butler services.
You verify that there is a seamless approach to the pre-arrival, guest stay and at departure through St.
Regis brand standards.
You supervise the work of the Butler team - comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets - and drive strong coordination with other departments.
Responsibilities also include people management tasks including interviewing and hiring Butler team members and creating schedules to ensure optimal staffing levels.
While the St.
Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service.
The Senior Butler s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, the ability to anticipate needs and impeccable interpersonal skills.
You will also be expected to create a safe workplace, follow company policies and procedures, uphold quality standards, and ensure your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Butler team members will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Butler team members - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
REQUIRE QUALIFICATIONS
Related Work Experience: 1 year related work experience required.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales.

Description:
Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
Role : Counterparty Onboarding Relationship Manager - Supply Chain Finance

Department: Supply Chain Finance Counter-party Team.

Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Hyderabad.


Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.
Drive activation: ensure counterparties utilize limits and monitor your portfolio growth and quality.
Monitor counterparty-level ageing/overdue, flag early warning indicators, follow-up for payments, support Collections on early bucket resolution, and ensure anchor alignment on disputes.
Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.
Maintain MIS, funnel trackers and adherence to onboarding TATs.
Support Anchor Relationship Managers with utilization, reactivation and earlycycle portfolio hygiene.

Key KPIs

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)
Documentation quality / monitor deferrals.
Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Candidate Profile

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.

Description:
Job Summary
The Builder - Logistics is a high-agency, 0-to-1 role embedded within Ca's GS Retail Logistics function in the South. Based out of Bengaluru and working closely with the Regional Head - South, you will build new programs, ship new tools, and run controlled experiments across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala. This is not a steady-state ops role - you'll spend most of your time defining problems, prototyping solutions, and turning what works into repeatable playbooks that city teams can run at scale. You'll operate at the intersection of ops, data, product, and AI.
Key Responsibilities
New Program Design - Identify gaps across pilot supply, CSP adherence, auto-allocation, and fulfilment. Design new programs from scratch, run pilots, and hand off winning plays to city teams.
Ops Diagnostics Deep Dives - Own regional data - cut it by city, cohort, and process step to surface what's broken and where the fastest wins sit. Convert findings into structured action plans.
Product Specs Tool Building - Write clear specs for internal tools and dashboards. Partner with Product and Tech to ship what the region needs; use no-code and AI where full builds are overkill.
Automation of Manual Workflows - Map the region's sheet-heavy workflows and lead their transition to automated systems. Ship quick wins with Apps Script, Zapier, or AI copilots before scoping full products.
City-Level Experimentation - Run controlled A/B tests across cities to validate whether a new process, script, or intervention actually moves the KPI. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does.
Cross-functional Execution - Work directly with city heads, Category Managers, Product, and Tech to unblock progress. Translate ground-team pain-points into shipped fixes fast.
Qualifications Experience
2-4 years in high-agency roles - startup ops, strategy consulting, category management, or founders office.
Track record of shipping something end-to-end - a program, a tool, a dashboard, a new city launch - that survived after you moved on.
Comfortable in ambiguity - can walk into a messy problem and leave with a structured plan.
Strong first-principles thinking; happy to visit yards and talk to pilots before writing a single line of a proposal.
Bengaluru-based or willing to relocate; comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala.
Data AI Skills
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - pivots, lookups, and formula-based analysis at scale.
SQL fluency for querying large operational datasets; Python or R for deeper analysis is a strong plus.
Comfort building dashboards (Looker, Data Studio, Tableau) that drive city-level decisions.
Hands-on with AI copilots (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate analysis, drafting, and prototyping.
Familiar with no-code automation (Apps Script, Zapier, Retool) to ship quick wins without engineering support.

Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).

Optimize cost, performance, and scalability across Azure and GCP resources.

Automate provisioning, configuration management, and environment setups.
Operational Excellence
Monitor cloud workloads using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and GCPs Cloud Monitoring and Logging.
Troubleshoot issues across cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and application services.

Ensure governance controls, tagging standards, resource organization, and cost monitoring.
Work closely with security teams to align with compliance frameworks and policies.
Collaboration & Support

Hands-on experience with:
Azure cloud services
GCP services (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, GKE, Pub/Sub, IAM, etc.)
Bicep for IaC (module creation, deployments)

CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Cloud Build)
Git for version control

Scripting experience in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

Experience with Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and YAML templating.

Ability to design reusable workflows, composite actions, and workflow templates.
Proficiency in YAML syntax for multi-stage pipelines, environment promotion, and approvals.

Soft Skills

Effective communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.
Continuous learning mindset with attention to detail.

Job Description- Territory Sales and Clinical Lead

About us

SigTuple builds intelligent screening solutions to aid diagnosis through AI-powered analysis of visual medical data from human and animal samples. Its flagship AI100 product is an in vitro diagnostic device that automates manual microscopy using robotics and AI, enabling biological samples on glass slides to be digitized for AI-aided remote reporting and analysis. Along the same lines, SigTuple is building a Point-of-Care (POC) screening device for veterinary use, expanding its technology and diagnostic solutions into the animal health space

As a Territory Sales and Clinical Lead,you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening SigTuplespresence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, and distributors. Your role will focus on building a strong customer base, key opinion leader relationships, executing sales cycle from lead generation till closure and post sales support.,

Responsibilities:
Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote SigTuple products and generate profitable sales.
Maintain a healthy pipeline and conduct demonstrations to close the sales as per targets assigned.
Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.
Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
Qualification & Experience:
0-2 years
Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Science/ Science /Nursing/Biomedical /Diagnostics Medical Technician
Master's in related fields will be a plus.
Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory-based role.
Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge:
Strong understanding of the animal health market,
Experience working with clinics, hospitals & distributors.
Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.
Location:
Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Ahmedabad, Delhi, and Bangalore. Based in the city / should be a local permanent resident having full exposure to the territory field-based role covering an assigned sales territory.

Objective:
You are responsible for leading commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds. (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET / PMMA/Nylon/Poly/ POM Blends)
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P-L, and build B2B partnerships.

F Lead sales & business development for engineering plastic compounds across PAN India
Business Development

F Non -Automotive Industry

F Expand Co’s footprint other than non-auto industry
F Analyzing market trends and identifying new business opportunities,

F Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and partners.
F Drive Metal-to-Plastic and polymer material replacement projects
F Manage key accounts to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction
Customer, Key Account Management & Relationships:
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and Non-Auto OEM accounts.
F Understand customer needs in terms of products, technologies, processing (injection moulding) and service expectations.
F Act as a senior interface between the Co. and key non-auto customers.
F Managing key client relationships and ensuring consistent sales performance across all regions.
F Coordinate customer requirements, forecasts, dispatches and inventory planning
F Participate in exhibitions, seminars, technical presentations and customer meetings
F Work closely with technical, R&D, production and quality teams
People Management & Leadership
F Build, mentor and develop a high-performing sales & marketing team.
F Setting sales targets, managing and coaching a national sales team,
F Ensure all team members work in alignment with Co’s strategic objectives and HR policies.
F Promote a culture of performance, accountability, knowledge sharing and ethical conduct.

1. BE with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET/ PMMA/ Nylon/ Poly/ POM Blends) or chemical raw materials.
2. Proven experience in new project development
3. Strong technical understanding of polymer applications and material selection
4. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills
5. Strong exposure to Plastic Injection Moulding processes and their linkage with material performance.
6. Hands-on experience handling Non- Auto Industry suppliers and OEM businesses.
7. Proven sales track record and experience in customer support (preferred).
8. Strong communication and negotiation skills.
9. Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain strong client relationships.
10. Effective time management and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
11. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
12. Willingness to travel PAN India

Taxation Advisory Head (VP) - Direct and Indirect
You will lead overall tax strategy for your client’s, legal compliance, advisory, and litigation management across both direct and indirect taxation frameworks.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Business Support & Risk Management
F Transaction Structuring: Review commercial agreements, joint ventures, mergers, acquisitions, and business models from a dual direct/indirect tax perspective. The incumbent will handle engagements related to several direct & indirect Tax Laws: Including Tax Restructuring, Tax Advisory and consulting, some part of compliance and other procedural aspects,
F Contingent Liability & Risk Tracking: Maintain active logs of tax demands, refunds, pending litigation, and update contingent liability schedules for the CFO and Board.
F Regulatory Tracking: Monitor statutory updates (Income Tax Act, Finance Act, GST council notifications) and assess immediate operational impacts.
F Client centricity: Provide innovative client solutions, that are both legally and commercially viable.
2. Direct Tax Advisory & Compliance
F Corporate Tax & Filings: Oversee corporate income tax computations, advance tax provisions, tax audits, and annual return filings.
F Transfer Pricing: Manage transfer pricing documentation, benchmarking studies, and compliance reviews for domestic and cross-border transactions.
F Withholding Taxes (TDS/TCS): Ensure accurate TDS/TCS reconciliations, foreign remittances compliance (e.g., Form 15CA/CB), and lower-withholding certificates.
F Litigation & Assessments: Handle income tax assessments, scrutiny notices, appeals, and representations before the CIT(A), ITAT, and higher judicial forums.
3. Indirect Tax Advisory & Compliance
F GST & Customs Framework: Ensure end-to-end compliance under Goods and Services Tax (GST: GSTR-1, 3B, 9/9C, reconciliations with GSTR-2A/2B, and e-invoicing).
F Foreign Trade Policy & Customs: Manage import/export compliance, customs duty assessments, Free Trade Agreement (FTA) benefits, and Special Economic Zone (SEZ/EOU) regulations.
F Input Tax Credit (ITC) & Optimization: Establish checks for product tax lifecycles, throughput planning, and maximum ITC optimization.
F Indirect Tax Litigation: Draft replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), appeals, writ petitions, and represent the organization before GST authorities and CESTAT.
4. Leadership & Stakeholder Management
F Team Mentorship: Build and manage in-house direct and indirect tax teams while driving process automation and tech adoption (ERP/SAP/tax tools).
5. Communication and influencing skills:
F Communicate assertively, presents, and defends own view with conviction.

Preferred candidate profile
1. LL.B./ Corporate Secretary (CS) and /or Chartered Accountant (CA) with deep statutory expertise of experience 5-10 years of progressive post-qualification experience in corporate tax, legal advisory, and litigation
2. Deep command over the Income Tax Act, Transfer Pricing guidelines, GST law, and Customs/Excise regulations.
3. Knowledge of case laws with relevant legal framework, good understanding of regulatory updates and a basic understanding of its impact on the assigned clients.
4. Proven track record of drafting legal submissions and arguing/assisting before appellate authorities.
5. Ability to create and disseminate updates on latest trends to the team.
6. Ability to do quick research to develop theoretical understanding of the laws and acts.
7. Ability to translate complex tax legislation into actionable commercial advice for finance, supply chain, and executive leadership.
8. Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP/Oracle) and contract/tax management platforms.

Location: Bangalore/Noida

Job Summary
The Circuit Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and augmenting network circuits to support existing and new voice network connectivity. The role requires a good understanding of telecom network architecture, DS0/DS1/Ethernet circuits, POI connectivity, Network product requirements, and circuit inventory.
Key Responsibilities
Proficient in basic telecom and transmission concepts.
Good understanding of Transmission architecture and Network connectivity.
Design and augment DS0/DS1/Ethernet/IP circuitry for existing and new Customer /Network connectivity.
Translate network and transport requirements into appropriate circuit designs.
Review engineering requirements and validate circuit design information.
Coordinate with Planning, ASR, Implementation, Operations, and vendor teams for circuit provisioning.
Support new circuit installation, augmentation, migration, and disconnect activities.
Maintain accurate circuit and network inventory in Granite/XNG/PRO or applicable inventory systems.
Analyze network design issues and provide timely recommendations or solutions.
Maintain engineering documentation and update order/design status.
Support Customer Sales and network optimization activities when required.
Required Skills
Experience or good understanding of telecom circuit design.(SDH/SONET/WAVE)
Knowledge of DS0, DS1/T1,IP/Ethernet transport circuits, and Network architecture.
Understanding Network connectivity and circuit configurations.
Ability to interpret network diagrams, circuit information, and engineering requirements.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge including PivotTables, formulas, and lookups.
Good to Have
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom inventory systems.
Understanding of Access Service Requests (ASR) and carrier provisioning.
Experience supporting network migrations, grooming, optimization, or decommissioning.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Job Title: ASR Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The ASR Engineer will be responsible for creating, submitting, tracking, and completing Access Service Requests with telecom carriers/LECs to support network provisioning requirements. The role requires good knowledge of carrier ordering processes, circuit configurations, and end-to-end ASR lifecycle management.
Key Responsibilities
Create and submit Access Service Requests (ASRs) using carrier/LEC web portals.
Translate engineering and transport requirements into accurate ASR submissions.
Understand ASR ordering requirements for DS0, DS1/T1,Ethernet and Customer Circuits and associated access services.
Validate ASR information before submission to minimize carrier clarifications and rejections.
Track submitted ASRs and follow up with carriers/LECs through completion.
Review and process carrier responses, including FOCs and DLRs.
Coordinate with Design, Planning, Implementation, Operations, and carrier teams to resolve ASR-related issues.
Monitor order milestones, due dates, jeopardies, and exceptions.
Maintain accurate order status and documentation throughout the ASR lifecycle.
Escalate carrier delays and provisioning issues as required.
Support circuit installs, changes, migrations, and disconnect requirements.
Maintain appropriate circuit/order information in Granite/XNG or applicable systems.
Required Skills
Hands-on Access Service Request experience.
Knowledge of ASR ordering requirements and carrier/LEC processes.
Experience using LEC/carrier web ordering tools.(VFO)
Ability to translate network/transport requests into ASR submissions.
Knowledge of TDM and IP network circuit configurations.
Understanding of FOC, DLR, due dates, and carrier provisioning milestones.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge, including PivotTables and formulas.
Good to Have
Experience with PRO/Flightdeck or similar telecom provisioning/inventory tools.
Knowledge of Telecom network architecture and planning.
Experience in carrier/vendor coordination.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.

Overview
Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.
Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.

A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Resources/Environment/Water Management/Hydrology, with 2 to 4 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in any WQ modelling using SWMM, WASP, SWAT, Qual2k, RIOT, HEWRAT, MIKE, SAGIS-SIMCAT, Infoworks ICM.
Strong Data and Statistical analysis skills using Excel, R, SPSS, PowerBI etc.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the Water Quality studies/ Assessments.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall WQ parameters and treatment processes.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.

Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
