Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain
Existing responsibilities plus:
Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
Establish robust governance for:
BOM
Material master
Routings
Lead times
Planning parameters
Purchase orders
Production orders
Inventory records
Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity
Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.

9. Continuous Improvement
Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
Improve:
Planning accuracy
Inventory turns
Supplier OTD
Material availability
Production plan adherence
Lead time
OTIF
Supply Chain cost
Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.

10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs.
Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases.
Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness.
Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable.

Candidate Profile
Education :
Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent.
Masters degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred.
Experience
10-15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment.
Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred.
Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization.

Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage
Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment.
Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment.
Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up.
Technical Competencies
Existing competencies plus:
S&OP / IBP
MPS / MRP
Production Planning & Control
Material Planning
Procurement
Inventory Management
Warehouse Management
Supplier Management
Capacity Planning
ERP / MRP / PLM systems
Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools
Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma
Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up
Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up
Project Management
Program Management
Change Management
ERP Deployment & Go-Live
Master Data Governance
Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews
New Product Introduction (NPI)

Leadership Competencies
Existing competencies plus:
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Ability to manage cross-functional teams
Strong stakeholder-management skills
Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment
Strong execution discipline
Data-driven decision making
Excellent communication and escalation management
Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams
Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up.
Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth.
Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities.
Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments.

Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.

Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. Build and manage RESTful APIs and microservices.

Develop and deploy applications in Docker containers using Kubernetes for orchestration.
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy and monitor applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high code quality and system reliability.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape backend system design.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for backend services.

Overview
We are seeking an Environmental Consultant to join our growing team in this role in AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC); you will collaborate with multidisciplinary technical specialists and contribute to a diverse portfolio of projects.
Your role
Leading and coordinating planning and environmental consenting projects, including Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) processes and the implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS).
Provide technical support across environmental services, including Net Zero, ESG, Sustainable land resources, Ecology, and Biodiversity.
Act as a Technical lead on projects, ensuring high-quality delivery.
Engage with clients, regulators, and stakeholders.
Manage projects, including budgets, programmes, and resourcing.
Mentor and support junior team members.
About you
Postgraduate degree qualified in an environmental or related discipline.
12+ years' experience in leading and coordinating planning and environmental consenting, Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) processes and the implementation of Environmental Management Systems (EMS).
Passionate, proactive, and enthusiastic about environmental sustainability.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities, work under pressure, and maintain technical excellence.
Strong analytical and report-writing skills.
Experience in preparing bids or tenders.
Proven experience delivering projects from the bid stage through to completion.
Membership of a relevant professional body or working towards Chartered RTPI/IES/IEMA/Environmentalist/Scientist status (or equivalent).
Desirable Skills: Experience using digital and spatial tools, including ArcGIS, QGIS, Power BI, and spatial modelling platforms.

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We are proud to say it is thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise, and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. Our teams are proud to deliver on some of the most prestigious projects across the world. It's thanks to our talented people and their diverse thinking, expertise and knowledge. Join us, and you'll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.
We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic self-starter to join our team as a Senior Principal Ecology Consultant, supporting projects across the UK region.



Your Role
Lead a team of 30 ecologists.
The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of UK clients' requirements and be able to reach back into the business to get the support required to fulfil those requirements and develop relationships/work.
Leading on multi-million capex large projects or frameworks, inputting or overseeing project programmes and budgets.
Collaborating within multi-disciplinary teams and engaging with stakeholders/clients.
The candidate will engage with other areas of the business, seeking opportunities to cross sell and leverage AtkinsRalis' capabilities, preparing bids, supporting on strategic opportunities, building client relationships (internal and external) and driving work-winning in the region.
Undertaking technical checks and reviews of a range of ecological reports and licence applications.
Undertaking ecological assessment and habitat design for a variety of development and nature recovery projects.
Supporting the development of innovative and pragmatic approaches to ecological mitigation and compensation.
Delivering clear and concise, high-quality ecological deliverables in line with current guidance and good practice.
Candidate may coach, mentor and support other staff members in their development.
Task/project management.
About you
A minimum of 15 years of overall professional experience in ecology, including at least 8 years supporting projects in the UK, US, Australia and/or European markets.
An exemplary working knowledge of the UK natural environment and wildlife legislation.
Chartered through the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM), CEcol or CEnv, or actively working towards chartership.
Experience of working on Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects and familiarity with the Development Consent Order (DCO) process would be viewed favourably.
The ability to undertake and provide technical advice on Preliminary Ecological Appraisal, Ecological Impact Assessment and Biodiversity Net Gain assessments.
Strong project management experience, including technical delivery, financial management and quality assurance.
Experience in protected species, mitigation and licensing.
Demonstrable experience of bidding and tendering, particularly in the UK region, including work winning and maintaining strong client relationships.



Reward benefits


This includes:

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Associate (BDA) who will work closely with property owners and prospective tenants to facilitate property transactions and close deals.

The candidate will receive leads from the company, visit properties with clients, understand owner requirements, identify potential tenants, and drive the deal to closure.

Key Responsibilities

Handle company-generated leads and connect with potential clients/tenants.
Visit properties and show them to prospective tenants/clients.
Travel approximately 30 - 40 km daily for property visits and client meetings.
Understand and manage property owner requirements.
Identify suitable and potential tenants based on property requirements.
Coordinate between property owners and tenants throughout the transaction.
Conduct property visits, explain property details, and address client queries.
Negotiate and follow up with both parties to close the deal.
Maintain regular follow-ups with leads until closure.
Build strong relationships with property owners and clients.
Maintain updated records of leads, property visits, follow-ups, and closures.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Real estate knowledge is preferred.
Good understanding of property types, location, configuration, and surface/built-up/carpet area.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and sales skills.
Comfortable with daily field travel of 30 - 40 km.
Ability to understand client and owner requirements and match them effectively.
Target-oriented and strong in follow-ups.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple property/client requirements.
Ideal Candidate

Someone who is sales-driven, confident in client interactions, comfortable with field work, and has a good understanding of the real estate market.

If you enjoy meeting clients, exploring properties, and closing real estate deals, this role is for you!

Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore

Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.

Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment

SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory

Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions

Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement

Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills

The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance in areas of responsibility. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (e.g., greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably. Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the financial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self & family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Assists with identifying and addressing employee and organizational development needs.
The position is assist in ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results.
Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills.
Assists in conducting needs assessments, designing and developing training programs and facilitating the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs.
Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting with Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Assisting with Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Assisting with Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Assists with making any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Assists with establishing guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Assisting with Managing Training Budgets
- Assists with the development of the Training budget as required.
- Assists with managing budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Assists with managing department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing.

Skills & Competencies
Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Description:
Job Responsibility

1. Grievance handling for all bargainable employees:
Interact with employees to identify and effectively resolve all issues
Effective predicting of issues that pose a threat to smooth functioning of organization & prioritize accordingly
Prevent employee grievances from turning into bigger IR issues that can hamper production
Conduct regular meetings like IRC (Industrial Relations Committee) to capture all employee grievances.
2. Ensure maintenance of Internal Discipline:
Ensure that there is good understanding & acceptance for all rules and regulations mandated by the Management.
Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.
4. Drive initiatives to motivate bargainable employees:
Identify and implement welfare activities including sports for blue collar workers in line with organizational guidelines
Organize regular Reward & Recognition functions like the long service awards
Plan and organize various family events or departmental picnics.
Be responsible for a set of employees in shop/area for engagement, growth, recognition,
Self –Directed teams , SQDCME (Safety / Quality/ Delivery/ Cost/ Morale and Environment)
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Employees: Regular Liaising & proactive IR
Block Union Representatives / Line Managers/Divisional Heads/Factory Heads : Regular Interaction and communication for smooth functioning.
Shared services, Construction, Safety, Administration, Medical: To assist workmen in resolving their grievances
ER Team: Regular Interaction between factories for good flow of management ideas.
External
Labour Department & Government Agencies: For Statutory Requirements
Industry Associations: Participation in industry associations and forums related to Industrial Relations to stay informed about trends, regulations, and emerging practices.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education : Post Graduate in Human Resources.
Relevant Experience : 5+ years of experience in HR / ER with exposure to handling blue collared workers extensively.

Business Acumen
Change Management
Conflict Management
Influencing Skills
Labour Relations
Strategy & Risk Management
Stakeholder Management

Description:
Partner with the best
Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

Fuel your passion
The Tender Manager - Wireline Services leads and coordinates tendering activities across the Asia Pacific region and Middle East (MEAP), driving proposal excellence, commercial governance, tender strategy, and bid execution to support profitable growth across multiple Baker Hughes Product Companies and business segments. The role partners closely with Sales, Commercial Operations, Product Lines, Pricing, Commercial Risk, Finance, and Regional Leadership to deliver competitive, compliant, and high-quality tenders that maximize win rates, improve commercial outcomes, and strengthen customer value propositions.

As a Tender Manager - Wireline Services, you will be responsible for
Lead wireline tender execution across multiple functions including Product Companies and business lines within the MEAP region.
Drive tender strategy and bid execution for complex, strategic, and high-value opportunities involving multiple products, technologies, and service offerings. Ensure development of winning bid strategies through close partnership with Sales, Product Lines, Commercial Hubs, Pricing, and Commercial Risk teams. Own tender governance, quality, compliance, and adherence to commercial approval processes and risk management requirements.
Establish tender management best practices, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance bid quality, efficiency, and response times.
Coordinate cross-functional and cross-segment resources to ensure timely development of integrated customer proposals.
Provide support during customer negotiations and deal shaping, executive bid approval processes, and lead commercial reviews.
Drive visibility to regional opportunity pipelines, tender performance metrics, win rates, and proposal effectiveness.
Champion commercial excellence and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and profitable growth.

To Be Successful in This Role You Will:
Bachelor s degree in engineering, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
Minimum 6 to 8 years of experience within the OFSE sectors. Strong experience in tendering, proposal management, sales, commercial operations, or commercial leadership roles.
Have 6 to 8 years of experience in Wireline Product Line.
Strong knowledge of commercial strategy, tender governance, pricing methodologies, contract structures, and risk management.
Demonstrate leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across Sales, Product Lines, Commercial Teams, and Functional organizations.
Experience operating across diverse international markets, particularly within the Middle East and Asia Pacific regions is preferred.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits

Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.
