Job Summary
The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-GOV-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - Bhubaneshwar
GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a multidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your key responsibilities
Strong consulting expertise with hands-on experience in government engagements and sector-level transformation delivery. Demonstrated field experience supporting district-level program implementation and monitoring, with exposure to DMF-related work. Ability to manage sectors under PMKKKY and track progress across DMF districts with accuracy and consistency. Skilled in preparing structured concept notes and supporting procurement-related documentation and processes. Proficient in coordinating reporting inputs for team leads and maintaining clear progress visibility across multiple stakeholders.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Masters in Social Work or Development
Experience
5 years of experience in social sector
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Partner with the best
Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

Fuel your passion
The Tender Manager - Wireline Services leads and coordinates tendering activities across the Asia Pacific region and Middle East (MEAP), driving proposal excellence, commercial governance, tender strategy, and bid execution to support profitable growth across multiple Baker Hughes Product Companies and business segments. The role partners closely with Sales, Commercial Operations, Product Lines, Pricing, Commercial Risk, Finance, and Regional Leadership to deliver competitive, compliant, and high-quality tenders that maximize win rates, improve commercial outcomes, and strengthen customer value propositions.

As a Tender Manager - Wireline Services, you will be responsible for
Lead wireline tender execution across multiple functions including Product Companies and business lines within the MEAP region.
Drive tender strategy and bid execution for complex, strategic, and high-value opportunities involving multiple products, technologies, and service offerings. Ensure development of winning bid strategies through close partnership with Sales, Product Lines, Commercial Hubs, Pricing, and Commercial Risk teams. Own tender governance, quality, compliance, and adherence to commercial approval processes and risk management requirements.
Establish tender management best practices, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance bid quality, efficiency, and response times.
Coordinate cross-functional and cross-segment resources to ensure timely development of integrated customer proposals.
Provide support during customer negotiations and deal shaping, executive bid approval processes, and lead commercial reviews.
Drive visibility to regional opportunity pipelines, tender performance metrics, win rates, and proposal effectiveness.
Champion commercial excellence and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and profitable growth.

To Be Successful in This Role You Will:
Bachelor s degree in engineering, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
Minimum 6 to 8 years of experience within the OFSE sectors. Strong experience in tendering, proposal management, sales, commercial operations, or commercial leadership roles.
Have 6 to 8 years of experience in Wireline Product Line.
Strong knowledge of commercial strategy, tender governance, pricing methodologies, contract structures, and risk management.
Demonstrate leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across Sales, Product Lines, Commercial Teams, and Functional organizations.
Experience operating across diverse international markets, particularly within the Middle East and Asia Pacific regions is preferred.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits


The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Senior Specialist - Proposals

Designation: Team Maintenance - Civil Structural
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead and manage the maintenance activities within the Civil Structural domain of our Iron Ore Processing department. The role demands a strategic thinker with deep technical expertise in civil and structural engineering, capable of ensuring the reliability, safety, and efficiency of all infrastructure and structural assets. Conduct regular inspections and condition assessments of buildings, foundations, conveyors, and other structural components to identify potential risks and maintenance needs.
Coordinate with production, safety, and engineering departments to schedule maintenance activities minimizing operational disruptions.
Manage budgeting, resource allocation, and procurement of materials and services related to civil and structural maintenance projects.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing maintenance data, failure modes, and root causes to enhance asset reliability and reduce downtime.
Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, environmental guidelines, and company policies related to civil and structural maintenance.
Prepare detailed reports and documentation on maintenance activities, asset conditions, and project progress for senior management review.
Implement and monitor preventive and predictive maintenance programs using industry best practices and modern technologies.

Technical Report Writing
Stakeholder Coordination

Title: Sales Team Leader
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Dhamanagar , Kamakhyanagar
Job Responsibilities:
1. Sales Plan Execution:
a. Coordinate and achieve sales objectives for assigned Territory routes by brand and pack on a daily basis for secondary, primary volumes (Physical Cases & unit Cases), Gross revenue (GR) & Net revenue (NR).
b. Define route plans of the Market Growth Representatives, Account Developers to optimize coverage cost effectively and ensure adequate productivity.
2. Customer Management: Drive Relationship with Outlets through the team of Market growth representative and Account Developers to ensure sustained business.
3. Market Expansion:
a. Drive Horizontal Expansion with respect to number of outlets opened versus target to improve business in the coming years.
b. Take up the responsibility of opening new outlets during market visits and provide necessary support in terms of elements, discounts, coolers etc.
c. Drive conversion of high value/ high visibility outlets to Depth Outlets (Happy Deal, Vision 2020, Teen & College Outlets, Outlets in Emerging Channels) and ensure execution as per Company norms.
d. Market share gain through various ground level interventions such as driving outlet level billing vertically & horizontally.
4. Market Execution: Execute Channel Programmers, Promotional activities for the given set of outlets. Plan for merchandising elements, coolers based on outlets/ market requirements and as per the RED standards. Prepare MGR wise action plans for improving RED (Right Execution) parameters, HE etc.
5. People Management:
a. Carry out on job trainings with Market growth representatives (Off Role) to improve Execution skills on the job. Track PJP (Permanent Journey Plan) Compliance and other productivity Metrics of the team and provide inputs to improve the same via OJT
b. Evaluate performance and skills of MDs and provide inputs via on-the-job coaching, training etc.
c. Conduct Joint Weekly, Monthly Review with ASM to review performance wrt Sales, Execution Parameters of MDs and work on agreed actions.
d. Review Performance and market issues to be resolved via daily Gate Meetings
6. Budget Management:
a. Propose Discount spend for given set of outlets to drive business. Closely monitor customer outstanding and claims and ensure compliance to credit and other policies.
7. Asset Control: Ensure regular tracking of our Assets and ensure asset movements etc in compliance to the Asset Policy.
8. Distribution Management: In routine ensure monitoring distributor ROI, SKU wise margins, DMS (Distribution Management System), scheme spend distributor to market outlets.
Supervises: Market Growth Representatives and Account Developers
Direct Reports: No
Geographical Scope:
Reports To: Area Sales Manager
Business Knowledge: Knowledge of Sales & Distribution preferably in an FMCG Company

Title: Sales Team Leader
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Rayagada , SORO , Paradadeep
Job Responsibilities:
1. Sales Plan Execution:
a. Coordinate and achieve sales objectives for assigned Territory routes by brand and pack on a daily basis for secondary, primary volumes (Physical Cases & unit Cases), Gross revenue (GR) & Net revenue (NR).
b. Define route plans of the Market Growth Representatives, Account Developers to optimize coverage cost effectively and ensure adequate productivity.
2. Customer Management: Drive Relationship with Outlets through the team of Market growth representative and Account Developers to ensure sustained business.
3. Market Expansion:
a. Drive Horizontal Expansion with respect to number of outlets opened versus target to improve business in the coming years.
b. Take up the responsibility of opening new outlets during market visits and provide necessary support in terms of elements, discounts, coolers etc.
c. Drive conversion of high value/ high visibility outlets to Depth Outlets (Happy Deal, Vision 2020, Teen & College Outlets, Outlets in Emerging Channels) and ensure execution as per Company norms.
d. Market share gain through various ground level interventions such as driving outlet level billing vertically & horizontally.
4. Market Execution: Execute Channel Programmers, Promotional activities for the given set of outlets. Plan for merchandising elements, coolers based on outlets/ market requirements and as per the RED standards. Prepare MGR wise action plans for improving RED (Right Execution) parameters, HE etc.
5. People Management:
a. Carry out on job trainings with Market growth representatives (Off Role) to improve Execution skills on the job. Track PJP (Permanent Journey Plan) Compliance and other productivity Metrics of the team and provide inputs to improve the same via OJT

c. Conduct Joint Weekly, Monthly Review with ASM to review performance wrt Sales, Execution Parameters of MDs and work on agreed actions.
d. Review Performance and market issues to be resolved via daily Gate Meetings

a. Propose Discount spend for given set of outlets to drive business. Closely monitor customer outstanding and claims and ensure compliance to credit and other policies.
7. Asset Control: Ensure regular tracking of our Assets and ensure asset movements etc in compliance to the Asset Policy.
8. Distribution Management: In routine ensure monitoring distributor ROI, SKU wise margins, DMS (Distribution Management System), scheme spend distributor to market outlets.

Reports To: Area Sales Manager

Qualifications: Graduation or MBA

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

Description:
About the Role: We are looking for a B.E./B.Tech Civil Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience to oversee the execution, supervision, and monitoring of civil construction activities at project sites.The role will be responsible for ensuring quality workmanship, adherence to approved drawings and specifications, safety compliance, timely project execution, cost control, and effective coordination with contractors, PMC, consultants, vendors, architects, and other stakeholders.Position: Civil Engineer
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Civil Engineering

Employment Type: Contractual – 12 Months
Please note that this is a contractual role for a period of 12 months.

Key Responsibilities
Supervise and monitor day-to-day civil construction activities at the project site.
Ensure execution is as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and project timelines.
Inspect and verify reinforcement, shuttering, concreting, masonry, finishing, and other civil works before execution.
Monitor construction quality and ensure compliance with applicable standards, codes, and QA/QC requirements.
Coordinate effectively with PMC, contractors, vendors, architects, consultants, and project stakeholders for smooth project execution.
Conduct regular site inspections and resolve technical and execution-related issues.
Maintain DPRs, measurement records, site progress reports, and project documentation.
Monitor labour productivity, manpower, materials, and resources to ensure timely completion.
Ensure proper material inspection, handling, storage, and utilization at the site.
Verify contractor bills and quantities based on actual executed work, in coordination with the PMC.
Ensure implementation of site safety practices and safety norms.
Ensure proper curing, workmanship, and quality control at all stages of construction.
Ensure project data and documentation are updated and available online through the designated Project Management software.
Support budget control, cost-saving initiatives, savings statements, and variance analysis.
Monitor and implement change management and change control during project execution.
Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports, including challenges, risks, delays, issues, and proposed way forward.
What We Are Looking For
B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in civil construction/project execution.
Strong experience in site supervision and construction execution.
Good understanding of drawings, BOQ, measurements, quality standards, and construction practices.
Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and manage contractors effectively.
Strong focus on quality, safety, timelines, documentation, and cost control.
Good reporting and communication skills.
Willingness to work at project sites as required.
AboutCompany:
The Akshaya Patra Foundation :-
The Akshaya Patra Foundation is one of the worlds largest not-for-profit organisations implementing the Government of Indias Mid-Day Meal Programme. With operations across 16+ states and 78+ kitchens, the Foundation serves over 2.35 million meals and 1 million morning snacks daily to school children.
With a vision to serve 6 million meals per day by 2030, the organisation is committed to eliminating classroom hunger and enabling education through a scalable and sustainable model.

Role Purpose
To drive zonal business growth, community outreach, camp productivity and sales performance while ensuring effective team management, financial discipline and ethical, quality eye-care services.

Required Skills & Candidate Profile

Job Summary:
Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Completes work with a limited degree of supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine to complex information requests. Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets. Completes data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities. Performs associate functions as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings. Responds to, or redirects, routine to complex inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately. Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees. Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures. Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed. Performs other routine to complex administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department. Act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.
FOR FIR
Making FIR for Warranty/Contract Engines (CIL, PHP, TCL, and CECO)
Taking photos of all the Critical components and secure them till Warranty Claim closure.
Need to preserve the Failure related parts till the PQC project closure, if required need to send them to Respective plant for analysis.
Sharing the list of parts required for Partial repair of the engines at HHP RC and track them till receiving from the respective PSBU Quality team/Plant.
As and when required need to send the serviceable parts from HHP RC and Watar warehouse to the required ASM/Customer with proper packing.
Need to support the field team on technical queries.
Need to visit Watar warehouse for Parts removal and dispatch from Float /Failed engines to support the field.
FOR EDO BDO
Need to track EDO BDO s Daily basis and update in Optimus and on mails.
Track the ETA with Buyers and Vendors on regular basis till OA got closed.
Attending the EDO BDO Meetings with IPDC and Other related stakeholders.
Need to visit Plants and IPDC to resolve any kind of issues.
Audit of Depot Return parts at IPDC on monthly basis.
Preparing the Summery on PPT on weekly/monthly and Quarterly basis to present Management.
Need to Creating /reduce the P. S. Stock as per the KAM Requirements and tracking of the Parts fulfilment in P. S. Stock.
Competencies:
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:

Job Description
Assistant General Manager (AGM) Production - Battery Background only
Location: Angul, Odisha
Department: Manufacturing / Operations
Reporting To: Plant Head
Company: Luminous Power Technologies
About the Role
Luminous Power Technologies is seeking an experienced and strategic Assistant General Manager (AGM) - Production to lead manufacturing operations at its Angul plant. The role is responsible for driving production excellence, operational efficiency, quality performance, cost optimization, safety compliance, and people development while ensuring alignment with the organization's business objectives.
The incumbent will play a critical leadership role in achieving production targets, implementing world-class manufacturing practices, and fostering a high-performance culture across the plant.
Key Responsibilities
Production & Operations Management
Lead end-to-end production operations to achieve plant output, quality, delivery, and cost targets.
Develop and execute production strategies aligned with annual business plans and customer demand requirements.
Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, equipment, and resources to maximize productivity.
Monitor plant capacity utilization and drive initiatives for throughput enhancement.
Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly production planning and execution.
Operational Excellence
Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement initiatives across the plant.
Improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), productivity, and process efficiency.
Lead cost reduction and value engineering projects to enhance profitability.
Benchmark manufacturing practices and implement best-in-class operational processes.
Quality Management
Ensure adherence to quality management systems and product specifications.
Collaborate with Quality teams to reduce defects, rejection rates, customer complaints, and warranty failures.
Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) initiatives through root cause analysis.
Safety, Health & Environment
Establish and maintain a strong safety culture across operations.
Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, environmental norms, and corporate EHS standards.
Lead safety audits, risk assessments, and implementation of preventive measures.
People Leadership & Capability Building
Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, engineers, supervisors, and shop-floor teams.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, discipline, and continuous learning.
Drive talent development, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives.
Build high-performing teams to support future business growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Supply Chain, Maintenance, Quality, Procurement, Industrial Engineering, and HR teams to ensure seamless plant operations.
Support new product introductions, plant expansion projects, and process automation initiatives.
Participate in strategic business reviews and operational planning discussions.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
MBA/PGDM in Operations Management will be an added advantage.
Experience
12-18 years of relevant manufacturing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Experience in Battery Manufacturing, Electrical Equipment, Automotive, Consumer Durables, Electronics, Process Industries, or similar sectors preferred.
Proven experience managing large-scale production teams and manufacturing operations.
Technical Competencies
Production Planning & Control
Lean Manufacturing
TPM (Total Productive Maintenance)
Six Sigma / Kaizen
OEE Improvement
Industrial Engineering
Cost Optimization
Capacity Planning
Quality Systems & Compliance
SAP / ERP Systems
Manufacturing Analytics & MIS
AboutCompany:
Luminous Power Technologies is a leading player in energy solutions, committed to driving Indias clean energy transition with a sharp focus on innovation and sustainability. With a legacy spanning over 38 Years, Luminous has built a robust presence in the energy and residential solar space. Its wide portfolio of innovative products, including inverters, batteries, and best-in-class solar solutions that is designed to provide the end-to-end energy management ecosystem with reliability, safety, and efficiency.
As the demand for reliable, clean, and efficient power growsespecially among home consumers, as a consumer energy fulfillment company, Luminous fulfils the evolving energy needs of millions of households and businesses across the world. The company operates seven state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, supported by an expansive network of over 28 sales offices and 100,000 channel partners across India. Today, Luminous powers over 100 million Indian homes and is expanding its reach globally, with a presence in more than 40 international markets.
Research and development, and continuous innovation, drive Luminous to constantly enhance the efficiency and lifespan of products, the convenience of consumers, and to stay ahead of technological trends. As an emerging Prosumer technology brand, the companys vision goes beyond just providing power; it's about empowering consumers. Through their flagship Connect-X app and integrated technologies, consumers get real-time insights and complete transparency over their energy ecosystems, through valuable information on energy consumption and monitoring, solar energy generation, and inverter performance.
The companys culture is a true representation of inclusion, allyship, and empowerment. Luminous remains committed to responsible business practices, demonstrated through extensive Corporate Social Responsibility programs supporting Education & Employment, Environmental conservation, and Electrification through Solar.
With a passionate team and a relentless drive to innovate, Luminous continues to set benchmarks in the energy sector. Its consistent recognition, such as five consecutive Consumer Superbrand Awards for residential power backup, underscores its trusted reputation in homes across India and beyond.
Luminous Power Technologies is more than an energy solutions company its a catalyst for a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Role & responsibilities
Job Purpose
To ensure smooth and efficient administrative support for 108 Ambulance Emergency Services by managing office administration, documentation, manpower coordination, facility requirements, records, vendor coordination, and operational support activities.
Key Responsibilities
1. General Administration
Manage day-to-day administrative activities at the district/cluster/state office.
Maintain office records, files, registers, correspondence, and documentation.
Ensure availability of office stationery, consumables, furniture, and other administrative requirements.
Coordinate office maintenance, housekeeping, security, electricity, internet, and other facility-related requirements.
Maintain proper documentation and filing systems for audit and management reference.
2. Ambulance Operations Support
Provide administrative support to the 108 ambulance operational team.
Coordinate with EME/EMT/Pilot teams regarding operational and administrative requirements.
Maintain records related to ambulance deployment, attendance, manpower, and operational activities.
Support the Operations and Fleet teams in resolving administrative issues affecting ambulance availability.
Coordinate with district authorities, hospitals, and other stakeholders whenever required.
3. Manpower & Attendance Coordination
Maintain daily manpower attendance and deployment records.
Coordinate with HR regarding joining, transfer, leave, absenteeism, replacement, and separation cases.
Track manpower shortages and communicate requirements to the concerned team.
Support documentation related to new joining, employee records, ID cards, uniforms, and other employee requirements.
4. Fleet & Workshop Administrative Support
Coordinate with the Fleet/Workshop team for administrative requirements related to ambulances.
Maintain records of vehicle-related documents, service schedules, insurance, permits, and other statutory documents, as applicable.
Support coordination with local vendors/workshops as per approved processes.
Ensure required approvals and supporting documents are maintained for administrative and vehicle-related expenses.
5. Vendor & Purchase Coordination
Coordinate with approved vendors for stationery, housekeeping, maintenance, accommodation, training, and other administrative requirements.
Obtain quotations and supporting documents as per company policy.
Follow up on purchase orders, invoices, bills, and payments with the concerned departments.
Ensure vendor documentation is complete and properly maintained.
6. Training & Meeting Support
Coordinate logistics for training programs, meetings, workshops, and official events.
Arrange venue, seating, food, accommodation, stationery, projector, and other required facilities.
Maintain participant attendance and supporting documents.
Provide administrative support for review meetings and management visits.
7. Compliance & Documentation
Ensure timely maintenance and submission of administrative records and reports.
Support internal and external audits by providing required documents and records.
Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.
Ensure all administrative activities are carried out in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Timely completion of administrative activities.
Accuracy and completeness of records and documentation.
Timely submission of reports and bills.
Office/facility availability and maintenance.
Timely resolution of operational administrative issues.
Compliance with company processes and approval procedures.
Vendor coordination and service quality.
Support for ambulance operational continuity.
Audit compliance and closure of observations.

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal skilled trades training program, assists site Electrician skilled trades to learn and develop electrical skills in a manufacturing environment under direct guidance. Apprentice will be required to successfully complete and document specified classes and a minimum quantity of on the job training hours. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Learns and applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs supervised work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Attends required classes to build basic electrical skills and knowledge to qualify as an Electrician. Completes all required on the job training hours. Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment and other miscellaneous duties within their capabilities . Assists with preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development. 1. Key Skills Required
DG Set Testing Commissioning - hands-on experience in DG/engine testing.
Electrical Troubleshooting - ability to identify and rectify faults in electrical circuits, panels, wiring and protection systems.
Electrical Electronic Systems - good understanding of AC/DC circuits, sensors, relays, contactors, breakers and control systems.
Engine Electronics - basic understanding of ECU, ECM, sensors, actuators and electronic control systems.
Test Instruments - proficient in using multimeter, clamp meter, megger/insulation tester and other electrical measuring instruments.
Electrical Drawing Reading - ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and circuit diagrams.
Control Panel Knowledge - troubleshooting of DG control panels, protection circuits and monitoring systems.
Test Cell Operations - understanding of engine/DG test procedures, parameters and test-cell equipment.
Problem Solving RCA - ability to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Safety Knowledge - strong knowledge of electrical safety, LOTO, PPE and safe working practices.
Documentation - maintaining test reports, check sheets, troubleshooting records and equipment history.
Computer Skills - basic MS Office/Excel and ability to work with digital testing/monitoring systems.
2. Roles Responsibilities
DG Testing Operations
Perform DG/engine testing as per defined test procedures and specifications.
Carry out pre-test inspection and verify electrical connections before starting the test.
Monitor key electrical and engine parameters during testing.
Ensure timely completion of testing to support engine dispatch requirements.
Identify abnormalities during testing and take appropriate corrective action.
Electrical Electronics Troubleshooting
Troubleshoot electrical and electronic issues during engine/DG testing.
Diagnose issues related to sensors, wiring, ECU/ECM, control panels, relays, contactors, breakers and protection circuits.
Use appropriate diagnostic and electrical test equipment for fault finding.
Coordinate with Maintenance/Engineering teams for complex issues.
Quality Documentation
Ensure testing is performed as per SOP, Control Plan and Quality requirements.
Record test results accurately and maintain all required documentation.
Escalate test failures and abnormal conditions promptly.
Support RCA and corrective/preventive actions for recurring failures.
Safety
Follow all electrical and test-cell safety requirements.
Ensure proper LOTO, grounding, PPE and safe isolation before electrical intervention.
Immediately report unsafe conditions and near misses.
Maintain 5S and housekeeping in the test-cell area.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to reduce testing time, breakdowns and rework.
Support implementation of improvements in test-cell electrical systems.
Participate in problem-solving and improvement projects.
3. Ideal Candidate Profile
Diploma - Electrical / Electrical Electronics Engineering | 2-3 years experience
The candidate should be hands-on, comfortable working in a test-cell environment, strong in electrical troubleshooting, and capable of independently performing DG testing and resolving routine electrical/electronic issues.
Preferred: Experience with Cummins engines/DG sets, engine test cells, ECU/ECM-based systems, generator controls, or industrial electrical systems.
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the functions needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Minimal or no work experience required.

Description:
Wipro is seeking an AI Engineer to implement and test agent nodes on a production Agentic AI platform for a large-scale healthcare technology engagement. You will work within an established LangGraph architecture, building individual agent nodes, tool integrations, and LLM-powered processing steps under the technical direction of the Senior AI Engineer and AI Architect. This is a hands-on implementation role for an engineer who is proficient in Python and eager to work on production clinical AI at scale.

Responsibilities
Implement individual LangGraph agent nodes per agreed specifications: data retrieval, clinical assessment, evidence gathering, decision evaluation, and recommendation.
Build and maintain tool wrappers in the AI Tool Layer for enterprise clinical service integrations (claims, Rx, clinical documents, clinical model rules).
Write and optimize LLM prompt templates for relevance scoring and document processing tasks.
Implement error handling, retry logic, and circuit breaker patterns within agent nodes.
Instrument nodes with OpenTelemetry spans and structured audit log events.
Write unit and integration tests for all implemented nodes and tool integrations.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards within the team.
Support integration testing, debugging, and defect resolution through the testing phase.

Required Skills & Experience
5+ years software engineering experience; 3+ year working with LLM APIs or AI application development.
Python: async programming, REST API consumption, clean modular code.
LLM integration: experience calling LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or equivalent); function/tool calling, prompt construction, response parsing.
LangGraph or LangChain: working knowledge of agent node patterns, state management, and tool use. Production experience a strong plus.
Azure fundamentals: containerized workloads on AKS, Azure services consumption.
Testing discipline: unit tests, integration tests, and test-driven development practices.
Comfortable working within a defined architecture under senior technical direction.

Preferred Skills
Healthcare or regulated industry exposure: HIPAA awareness, PHI handling, clinical data types.
Familiarity with clinical coding systems: RxNorm, CPT, ICD-10, SNOMED-CT.
OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience.
Experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, or event-driven architectures.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an IFS Cloud EAM - Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to deliver tailored solutions within our Business Application Consulting practice. You will focus on Maximo Consulting, leveraging your skills to address complex business challenges and optimize operations. As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections, anticipate needs, and navigate ambiguity to deliver quality work. You will guide and mentor others, using your skills to analyze complex concepts and develop a deeper understanding of the business context.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of the Business & Supply Chain Operations network, contributing to Field Service & Operations Modernisation initiatives. You will utilize a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, enhancing your personal brand and technical skills. This position offers the opportunity to grow professionally while working in a dynamic environment that values relationship building and personal growth.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement custom solutions in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP. Customize IFS modules to meet specific business needs by writing and modifying PL/SQL code, utilizing APIs, and creating custom fields, menus, and reports.
Develop and implement integration solutions using IFS Connect/REST (OData/Projections) and coordinate cutover to Ensure seamless data flow and integrity across the organization.

Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer Job Description (JD)


Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, cloud-native enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, and cloud platforms. The candidate will work closely with architects, product owners, QA teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver robust and high-performing solutions.

Design, develop, and maintain microservices-based applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build and consume RESTful APIs and third-party integrations.
Develop scalable, resilient, and secure backend services.
Implement event-driven and distributed system architectures.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Collaborate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and business teams.
Conduct code reviews and ensure coding standards and best practices.

Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
New Product Development & Introduction: Lead Packaging projects & trials at Factory level with focus on line performance, cost efficiency on time delivery and product quality. Provide packaging input within the AGs proposing and evaluating best packaging alternatives for new products and improvements to existing products. Organise and document factory trials including machinability, shelf-life, storage handling, laboratory and transport tests for validation of new packaging and changes in specifications.
Nestle Continuous Excellence: Conduct value analysis; identify and recommend cost improvements and source reduction opportunities. Initiate (or participate in) DMAIC exercises. Guardian of packaging quality going out of the factory lines.
Safety, Quality & Compliance: Implement packaging related quality and compliance directives. Drive quality improvements in our packaging. Assist Factory QA to review packaging related on-line/off-line controls - to implement packaging monitoring plans. Participate in supplier audits.
Packaging Specifications: Manage GLOBE database of packaging materials. Supplier development: Support Packaging Head Office and Procurement in the selection, assessment and development of new suppliers/converters. Raise packaging material complaints with suppliers & collaborate to resolve them.
People & Know How: Ensure development of competencies of packaging assistants & disseminate packaging best practices and knowledge at the shop floor (e.g. "One Point Lessons"). Source & utilise training materials available within the Group (or develop training materials as appropriate) Packaging Material and Packaging Lines Efficiency in line with the goals of NCE Zero waste, Zero loss: Accountable for efficiency in Packaging Lines and Materials usage. Support to Procurement on local & zone level. Consumer Complaints: Analyze consumer complaints related to packaging, propose & implement corrective actions.

Preferred candidate profile
Academic Experience:
Graduate in Engineering, preferably in Packaging, Mechanics, Industrial, Chemistry or Automation or equivalent (Materials Science, Printing).

Operational Experience: Packaging development in FMCG Packaging development and packing operation in FMCG.
Problem solving approach.
Project management.
Supplier & converter auditing.

Knowledge
1. Nestl Corporate Business and Nestl Management & Leadership Principles, Nestl on the Move, Nestl Leadership Framework.

2. Competent in Packaging Safety, Quality and Compliance.

3. Basic knowledge in production planning.

4. Aware of customer and consumer understanding.

5. Aware of relevant technology platforms, people management tools & practices in the Nestle context.

6. Good understanding of NPDI process.

7. Good understanding of NCE methodologies in particular TPM & LEAN.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner

Job Description
Position: Receptionist / Front Office Executive
Department: Front Office
Industry: Hotel / Resort / Hospitality
Reporting To: General Manager
Location: Shimla


Job Purpose
The Hotel Receptionist Is Responsible For Providing A Warm And Professional Welcome To Guests, Managing Check-in And Check-out Procedures, Handling Guest Enquiries, Coordinating With Hotel Departments, And Ensuring A Smooth And Pleasant Guest Experience Throughout The Stay.


Key Responsibilities

A. Guest Reception Welcome
Welcome And Greet Guests Professionally And Courteously.
Create A Positive First Impression Of The Hotel.
Assist Guests With Their Requirements And Provide Accurate Information.
Maintain Professional Communication And Grooming Standards At All Times.


B. Check-In Check-Out
andle Guest Check-in And Check-out Procedures Efficiently.
Verify Guest Identification And Required Documents.
Allocate Rooms According To Reservations And Hotel Policies.
Provide Room Keys/cards And Explain Basic Hotel Facilities And Services.
Process Departures And Coordinate With The Relevant Departments.


C. Reservation Booking Coordination
Handle Room Reservation Enquiries Through Phone, Email, Online Platforms, And Walk-ins.
Verify Room Availability And Booking Details.
Update Reservation Information Accurately In The Hotel System.
Coordinate With The Reservations And Housekeeping Teams Regarding Room Status.


D. Guest Service
Handle Guest Requests, Questions, And Complaints Professionally.
Resolve Routine Guest Issues Or Escalate Them To The Appropriate Manager.
Provide Information About Hotel Facilities, Restaurants, Nearby Attractions, Transportation, And Local Destinations.
Maintain Excellent Guest Relations And Customer Service Standards.


E. Telephone Communication
Answer And Transfer Telephone Calls Professionally.
Respond To Guest Emails And Messages Promptly.
Maintain Proper Communication With Front Office, Housekeeping, FB, Accounts, Maintenance, And Management.
Take And Communicate Guest Messages Accurately.


F. Cash Billing Support
Handle Guest Payments And Basic Billing Procedures As Assigned.
Maintain Proper Records Of Cash And Transactions.
Coordinate With The Accounts Department Regarding Billing Or Payment-related Matters.
Follow Hotel Procedures For Cash Handling And Financial Documentation.


G. Front Office Administration
Maintain Guest Records And Registration Documents.
Maintain Accurate Shift Handover Records.
Prepare Daily Front-office Reports As Required.
Maintain Confidentiality Of Guest And Hotel Information.
Follow All Hotel Policies, SOPs, And Security Procedures.


Required Skills
Excellent Communication And Interpersonal Skills.
Good English And Hindi Communication Skills.
Pleasant Personality And Professional Appearance.
Good Customer-service And Problem-solving Skills.
Ability To Handle Guests Calmly And Professionally.
Basic Computer And MS Office Knowledge.
Knowledge Of Hotel PMS/software Will Be An Advantage.
Good Telephone Etiquette.
Ability To Work Effectively In A Team.


Qualification Experience
Qualification: 10+2 / Graduate / Diploma In Hotel Management, Hospitality, Tourism, Or A Related Field.
Experience: 0-3 Years Of Experience In Hotel, Resort, Hospitality, Front Office, Or Customer Service.
Freshers With Good Communication Skills And A Positive Attitude May Also Be Considered.


Personal Attributes
Well-groomed And Professional.
Polite, Friendly, And Customer-oriented.
Punctual And Disciplined.
Honest And Responsible.
Positive Attitude.
Able To Work Under Pressure.
Strong Attention To Detail.
Willingness To Learn And Improve.


Working Requirements
Willingness To Work In Rotational Shifts.
Willingness To Work On Weekends And Public Holidays As Per Hotel Requirements.
Maintain Proper Uniform And Grooming Standards.
Follow Hotel Attendance, Leave, Safety, Security, And Operational Policies.
Perform Additional Front-office Duties Assigned By Management.


Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
Guest Satisfaction And Feedback.
Accuracy Of Check-in/check-out Procedures.

Job Description: Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: AVP Commercial

Department: Stores & Inventory Management

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores to lead inward storekeeping, engineering spares custody, consumable inventory, and yard storage operations at our Paonta Sahib manufacturing facility.

The AGM Stores will hold full operational ownership of inventory custody, storage optimization, material issuance, scrap segregation, and system stock reconciliation. The role requires close coordination with Plant Production, Maintenance, Quality, and Central/Local Procurement to eliminate production downtime caused by material shortages, maintain 100% stock accuracy in the ERP system, and implement robust material handling, preservation, and internal audit controls.


Key Responsibilities
1. Inward Logistics & Material Receipt
Direct gate entry verification, weighbridge reconciliation, unloading, and staging for all incoming consignments:


Raw Materials: Stainless steel melting scrap, ingots, billets, HR/CR master coils, and raw pipe shells.

Consumables & Spares: Refractories, mill rolls, lubricants/cutting oils, electrical/mechanical spares, pickling acids/chemicals, grinding wheels, and packaging materials.

Manage the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) workflow in ERP, ensuring physical inspection, chemical/physical test clearance from Quality Control (QC), and vendor delivery challan reconciliations are completed within defined turnaround times.

Coordinate rejected material handling, debits, vendor return gate passes, and replacement follow-ups in close coordination with Local and Corporate Procurement.

2. Inventory Control & ERP Reconciliation
Maintain real-time stock ledger accuracy across all plant sub-stores (Raw Material Yard, Engineering Spares Store, Consumables Store, Scrap Yard).

Enforce Min-Max levels, Reorder Points (ROP), and Safety Stock levels for critical plant operational spares and consumables to prevent stockouts while optimizing working capital.

Conduct continuous cycle counts, monthly reconciliations, and bi-annual/annual full physical stock verifications alongside Internal and Statutory Audit teams; investigate and resolve book-to-physical variances.

Categorize and review inventory using ABC, VED, and FSN analyses; identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete (SLOB) items with concrete salvage or liquidation plans.

3. Material Storage, Preservation & Issuance
Design and implement scientific warehouse layouts, 5S standards, racking systems, bin allocation, and barcode/QR identification tags across all storage bays.

Ensure proper preservation of critical spares, sensitive instrumentation, and materials against weather, rust, acid fumes, or physical handling damage.

Supervise disciplined material issuance against approved Material Requisitions / Job Orders on a FIFO (First-In, First-Out) basis.

Manage hazardous material storage (pickling acids, industrial gases, furnace oils) ensuring mandatory safety measures, MSDS adherence, and spillage containment protocols.

4. Scrap Yard Management & Returnable Material Tracking
Oversee collection, segregation, and weighment of production process scrap (shearing scrap, end-cuttings, rolling scale, rejected mother pipes) and maintain heat-wise/grade-wise scrap accounting for furnace remelting or disposal.

Track Returnable Gate Passes (RGP) and Non-Returnable Gate Passes (NRGP) for plant equipment, rolls, and spares sent out for machining, calibration, or motor rewinding, ensuring strict adherence to return timelines.

5. Team Leadership & System Audits
Lead and supervise storekeepers, yard supervisors, crane operators, forklift drivers, and material handlers.

Enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all shifts, ensuring zero safety incidents during heavy lifting and yard handling.

Provide routine Management Information System (MIS) reporting on stock valuation, non-moving inventories, pending GRNs, and consumption trends to the GM Commercial and Corporate Management.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Science (B.Sc), Commerce (B.Com), or Engineering (Diploma/B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgy).

Post-Graduate Diploma / MBA in Materials Management or Supply Chain Management is preferred.

Experience:


1216 years of hands-on stores and warehouse management experience in heavy manufacturing, with at least 35 years at a Senior Manager / Manager level.

Essential industry background: Steel Melting Shops (SMS), Stainless Steel Rolling Mills, Tube/Pipe Mills, or Heavy Engineering Fabrication.

Technical & System Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP MM module, Oracle SCM, or TallyPrime).

In-depth knowledge of inventory management methodologies (ABC/VED/FSN, FIFO, 5S, Kaizen).

Solid understanding of weighbridge operations, metallurgical grade differentiation, and traceability marking systems.

Key Competencies:


High personal integrity and strict adherence to internal audit controls.

Strong team supervision and contractor-labor management skills.

Detail-oriented tracking of incoming consignments and rigorous stock reconciliation discipline.

Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: Director Plant

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is seeking an experienced, proactive, and commercially astute AVP Commercial to head commercial operations at our manufacturing facility in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

The GM Commercial will oversee plant accounting and financial controls, inventory and store operations, local procurement, logistics, and commercial statutory compliance. The role acts as the primary operational bridge between the manufacturing plant and the Corporate Head Office in New Delhi, ensuring cost efficiency, seamless supply chain execution, rigorous internal controls, and statutory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
1. Plant Accounts & Financial Controls
Direct and monitor day-to-day plant accounts, cost accounting, billing, invoicing, and petty cash management.

Oversee stainless steel manufacturing cost accounting (yield, conversion costs, scrap reconciliation, and power/fuel consumption).

Ensure strict internal financial controls, conduct regular internal audits, and coordinate with statutory auditors.

Manage plant-level GST, TDS, e-Way bills, TCS, and ensure timely filing in close coordination with the Corporate Finance team in New Delhi.

Monitor plant operational expenditures (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX), preparing monthly variance analyses against approved budgets.

2. Stores & Inventory Management
Oversee comprehensive store operations across raw materials (SS scrap, ingots, billets, flats, coils), consumables, spare parts, rolls, refractories, and finished goods (pipes, coils, flats).

Implement rigorous systems for material receipt (Gate Pass, Weighbridge, Inspection/GRN), issue, and bin card tracking.

Conduct periodic physical inventory audits, reconciliation against ERP/books, and minimize inventory shrinkage or carrying costs.

Identify and manage non-moving, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; establish scrap handling and disposal protocols.

3. Local Procurement & Vendor Management
Formulate and execute local procurement strategies for mechanical and electrical spares, refractories, consumables, oils/lubricants, packaging materials, and general site services.

Evaluate local vendor proposals, negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment schedules, and delivery timelines to optimize working capital.

Implement vendor evaluation metrics, fostering reliable local supplier networks while enforcing vendor compliance.

Coordinate with Central Corporate Procurement (New Delhi) for high-value raw material intake, ensuring smooth site delivery schedules.

4. Logistics, Dispatch & Weighbridge Commercial Operations
Supervise inbound raw material arrivals and outbound dispatches of finished flats, coils, and pipes.

Exercise commercial control over weighbridge operations, tare/gross weight verifications, and freight audits.

Manage transporter contracts, freight negotiation for local movements, vehicle turnaround times, and transit compliance.

5. Head Office Coordination & Reporting
Act as the nodal contact at the Paonta Sahib unit for all commercial matters directed from the Corporate Office in New Delhi.

Prepare and submit regular Management Information System (MIS) reports, including daily fund requirements, monthly commercial MIS, inventory valuations, and cost-variance reports.

Align plant commercial targets and working capital requirements with corporate business goals.

6. Commercial Statutory Compliance
Ensure adherence to state and central commercial regulations, including GST compliance, e-Way billing rules, and tax documentation.

Monitor commercial documentation related to interstate dispatches, raw material transit permits, and statutory commercial records.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Commerce (B.Com) / Inter CA / Inter ICWA / MBA in Finance or Operations / B.Tech with an MBA. Full CA / ICWA (CMA) qualification is an added advantage.

Experience:


1520+ years of proven commercial management experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 57 years in a senior leadership role (DGM/GM).

Direct experience in Steel Manufacturing, Stainless Steel, Rolling Mills, Tube Mills, or Heavy Industrial Fabrication is highly preferred.

Technical Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, or TallyPrime).

Strong mastery of GST, indirect taxation, inventory accounting, and Excel-based financial reporting.

Competencies:


Strong commercial negotiation and contract management skills.

Strong leadership with the ability to manage commercial, accounts, and stores teams.

Clear, structured communication skills for multi-location reporting and commercial coordination.

This position is open with Bajaj Finance Limited.
The Branch Manager is a managerial responsibility for providing full leadership and direction to the team of employees in growing business and client base of consumer gold loan. Increase Gold Loan business, plus various other third-party products i.e., NCDs, Gold Coins sale etc.

Manage error free valuation & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education & Skill Qualifications:
4-7 years of relevant experience required.
Bachelor's Degree / Post-graduation Degree preferred.
Previous experience in gold loan banking, gold loan products, management or client service preferred.
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
