Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Main Purpose of Job:

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Supply (may include in-house generation) and distribution of electricity to ensure that it is at all times safe, reliable, secure and sustainable. It covers low, medium and high voltage installations. Provide factory/site engineering with the required competence on Factory Automation System (FAS), Process Control System and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to effectively support manufacturing operational activities and continuously improve manufacturing performance. The role has a shared responsibility of tasks together with production, warehouse, QA and auxiliary services etc to ensure full requirement and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Management responsibilities:
Define, propose and monitor the plans and objectives of the electrical team in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Electricity & Automation Manufacturing Execution System (E&AMES) Activity as outlined in the Nestl Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team.
Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives.
Propose and control the electrical & automation component of the site M&I budget and any capital projects.
Propose and monitor electricity in accordance with the key performance indicators.
Demonstrate and promote the company's values within the electrical & automation team.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

2. Functional responsibilities:
Ensuring line availability / healtiness of high-speed manufacturing lines and ensuring highest level of efficiency and performance from the lines. Ensure that all personnel performing electrical & automation related activities are legally trained and certified. Question the impact on product safety/quality, people safety and environmental during execution of any activity.
Ensure at all times the technical integrity/performance of the electrical energy supply and distribution.
Ensure at all times safe installations and operations through proper design, protection systems, procedures and training.
Liase with the site Safety Officer on electrical & automation matters relating to safety, electricity distribution, energy conservation, legal compliance, complaints etc.
Coordinate with Production, Quality Management and Engineering to resolve any electrical & automation issues.
Supervise and coordinate electrical & automation maintenance and project work by electricians, automation technicians and contractors.
Ensure proper management of electrical & automation documents (manuals, diagrams, instrument data sheet, software packages/licenses) through efficient filing and archiving procedures. Manage the capturing of electrical energy related information and the distribution of this information to the required stakeholder.

3. Maintenance and Improvement of electrical & automation assets.
Execute the maintenance of the electrical & automation equipment in accordance with the Nestl Maintenance Strategy using Consequence Driven Maintenance (CDM) as the multi-disciplined approach to proactively maintain/improve the fixed assets and Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM) as the process to manage the asset lifecycle. Adopt the Maintenance Excellence vision by striving for the M&I "Proactive Domain".Monitor plant and equipment to ensure optimal operation and reduction of planned and unplanned downtime. Develop and implement maintenance and inspection plans to ensure reliability, sustainability and security of electrical distribution infrastructure. Ensure technical integrity and performance of automation equipment.

4. Installation of new electrical & automation assets
Ensure that the justification, request for approval and reporting are in line with the Guidelines for Capital Investment. Ensure that new installations are designed with a high degree of flexibility to better enable the operations to adjust to a changing environment keeping in mind safety and the issues relating to the environment. Facilitate the introduction and implementation of new technologies in coordination with local, market, central technical and PTC engineering.

5. Continuous Improvement
Initiate and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in electricity supply and distribution with the aim of achieving optimised plant performance. Ensure that all members of the team play an active role in assisting the client in improving the energy usage and reducing waste across the site through continual improvement initiatives.

Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Strong leadership, planning, and territory management capabilities.

Description:
Analytical Assurance

1. To review analytical specifications, standard and general test procedures, test data sheet of raw material, packing material, finished product, stability and micro analysis.
2. To review the data submitted by QC for its completeness.

8. To review predictive stability analysis on data generated for stability study
9. Review of analytical method transfer and method validation documents.
10. To coordinate with CQA/ PTC department for implementation related to the official monographs/ General chapters/ corporate quality policy.
11. Reviews of documents i.e. risk assessment, change control, deviation and routine documents of testing area associated to the function.
12. To ensure retrieval of QC data and support for its presentation during audit.
13. Responsible for implementing company quality ethics policy for data integrity and inform management and responsible data integrity compliance head on any data integrity issues as per corporate data governance policy.
14. Responsible for release of Raw materials, Packaging material, Stability Study, in process, Microanalysis and finished products.
15. Responsible for Review of Raw materials, Packaging material, Stability Study, in process, Microanalysis and finished products analytical report before release.
16. Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.

Job Title: AI Engineer Python, FastAPI & LLM/Voice AI
Company: Novizco Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
Experience: 2 TO 4 years of relevant hands-on experience; flexible for strong candidates
Shift: 2:00 PM11:00 PM IST
Employment Type: Initial 3-month contract with possible extension
Joining Preference: Immediate joiners preferred
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to contribute to our Voice AI Testing & Evaluation Platform. You should be comfortable understanding an existing codebase quickly, independently owning development tasks, and delivering reliable features with minimal onboarding.
This role focuses on backend development, LLM-powered workflows, AI agents, and automated evaluation. Practical experience building production AI applications is more relevant than model training, deep learning research, or academic projects alone.

Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain Python backend services and FastAPI-based REST APIs.
Integrate LLM providers, voice platforms, and other third-party APIs.
Develop asynchronous workflows using asyncio, concurrency, and parallel API calls.
Build and improve AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks.
Implement automated evaluation workflows, including LLM-as-a-Judge, hallucination detection, guardrails, and scoring.
Support voice-agent testing workflows involving speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and conversation evaluation.
Implement background jobs, queues, retries, timeouts, and error handling.
Debug issues, improve system reliability, and own assigned tasks through implementation, testing, and delivery.

Required Skills
Strong practical experience with Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, and backend integrations.
Hands-on understanding of asynchronous programming, asyncio, and concurrency.
Experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and prompt-driven workflows.
Practical experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent frameworks.
Understanding of LLM evaluation methods, evaluation metrics, hallucination detection, and automated scoring.
Ability to design reliable workflows involving parallel requests, background processing, queues, and retries.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently.

Preferred Skills
Exposure to voice agents and STT/TTS pipelines.
Experience with Bland AI, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Twilio, or similar platforms.
Experience implementing LLM-as-a-Judge, guardrails, or automated AI testing systems.
Prior experience developing and supporting production AI applications.

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced AVEVA PI (OSIsoft PI) Engineer with expertise in the Life Sciences/Pharmaceutical industry to design, implement, and support enterprise historian solutions. The candidate will be responsible for integrating manufacturing, laboratory, utility, and automation systems with the AVEVA PI System to enable real-time monitoring, data integrity, regulatory compliance, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, GMP regulations, data integrity requirements, and industrial automation systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain PI Data Archive, PI AF (Asset Framework), PI Vision, and PI Interfaces/Connectors to collect, contextualize, and deliver real-time process data.
Build and manage AF templates, element hierarchies, event frames, and analyses to model plant assets and business logic.
Configure and troubleshoot PI interfaces (OPC DA/UA, Modbus, custom interfaces) for data acquisition from PLCs, DCS, SCADA, and historians.
Develop PI Vision displays, dashboards, and PI DataLink/Excel reports for operations, engineering, and management stakeholders.
Write and maintain scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, PI SDK/AF SDK, PI Web API) to automate data workflows, integrations, and system health checks.
Integrate PI System data with other platforms (MES, ERP, SQL/historian databases, cloud data lakes, Aveva Data Hub/Connect).
Monitor system performance, data quality, and tag counts; perform capacity planning and license management.
Support PI System upgrades, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and high-availability (PI Collective) configurations.
Enforce cybersecurity best practices for OT/IT systems, including PI System security (mappings, identities, firewalls).
Document architecture, standards, naming conventions, and data governance processes.
Collaborate with process/controls engineers to identify new tagging, KPI, and analytics requirements.
provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis for PI System issues.Required Technical Skillset
Strong hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform (Application Server / Galaxy, Historian, InTouch, Web Client / Operations Control).
Working knowledge of AVEVA MES / AVEVA Batch Management, or exposure to integrating third-party MES/LIMS/ERP with SCADA layer.
Proficiency in OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and native communication drivers for PLC/DCS integration
Experience with scripting (QuickScript/VBScript) and object-oriented Galaxy template design.
Understanding of network/OT architecture, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness a plus), and virtualization (VMware) for industrial systems.
Familiarity with SQL Server/reporting tools for Historian data extraction and dashboarding (AVEVA Insight / Reports is a plus).
Pharmaceutical / Regulatory Domain Expertise (Preferred)
Sound knowledge of GAMP 5 computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) lifecycle and documentation practices.
Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and data integrity (ALCOA+) requirements.
Certifications (Preferred)
AVEVA PI certification
GAMP 5 / CSV training certification.
Soft Skills & Other Requirements
Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with pharma quality, validation, and automation stakeholders.
Ability to prepare and present technical estimations, proposals, and solution walkthroughs to client/hiring stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline suited to regulated/validated environments.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills for live plant support scenarios.

Job Summary
Role Title(s): Project Manager
The Role
The Project Management Lead will support the planning, governance, coordination and execution of Executive Insights Command Centre initiatives for the USLI region. The role will drive operational discipline, stakeholder engagement, reporting governance and leadership enablement to ensure the timely delivery of executive insights and business priorities. The successful candidate will combine strong project management capability, commercial awareness and effective communication across a global stakeholder environment.
The position is designed for a proactive and commercially astute individual who thrives in a high-impact environment, blending analytical depth with leadership accountability. Someone who co-owns the delivery of priorities.
Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership & Planning
Partner with Business Line Leader to execute segment strategy, ensuring alignment with broader business and market priorities.
Share ownership in managing and tracking progress of various strategy execution projects, ensuring timely completion and alignment with objectives.
Support the translation of strategic priorities and reporting requirements into structured initiatives, workplans and deliverables.
Establish and maintain governance frameworks, operating cadences, RACI matrices, project plans, trackers, risk and issue logs, and action registers.
Monitor milestones, dependencies, risks, scope changes and mitigation actions across multiple workstreams.
Coordinate delivery across Markets, Service Lines, Global Analytics, Operations and reporting teams.
Drive timely follow-up and transparent reporting against agreed priorities and commitments.


Leadership Enablement & Communication
Enable leadership through preparation of board packs, pursuit reviews, external engagement prep, and issue resolution.
Co-lead strategic discussions and communications by managing board meetings, internal correspondence, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure transparency, alignment, and seamless execution of go-to-market strategies.
Monitor business KPIs, reporting service levels and operational performance measures.
Partner with stakeholders to establish reporting standards, baselines, targets and performance tracking mechanisms.
Identify and implement operational improvements, standardization and automation opportunities.


Stakeholder Management
Build trusted relationships with USLI leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Act as a central coordination point between business users, analytics teams and Power BI developers.
Gather, clarify and prioritize stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable delivery plans.
Communicate progress, risks, decisions and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.


Skills and Attributes for Success
Consultative: demonstrate ability to approach problems and/or projects through effective question/answer techniques to identify needs/issues/desired outcomes and propose solutions to meet needs/issues/desired outcomes
Risk management: Identify potential risks and create a mitigation plan
Emotional Intelligence: demonstrate understanding of different working/personality styles and appreciation of the need to flex approach and message to effectively engage
Project Management: experience building, and managing project plans with the ability to navigate challenges to achieve desired project outcomes
Presentation/ Strategic Analysis: experience building .ppt presentations or discussion documents to explain a strategy, process, or relationship history; experienced in analyzing and leveraging insights to influence and co-develop strategy for business growth.
Communication: Demonstrate effective communication at all levels of the organization. Understand the nuances, ability to listen effectively, and have a global mindset to operate effectively across borders
Networking: strategically cultivating relationships across EY functions and Industry/Business development (BD) team by leveraging mutual interest and common goals for exchanging valuable insights and influencing actions to achieve account goals.
Entrepreneur/Proactive behavior: desire to make the role their own, create opportunities to involve themselves by displaying strong initiative, being innovative and adaptable, demonstrating visionary pursuit of value creation and business impact


To qualify for the role, you must have
12+ years of work experience
A masters degree or bachelors degree with relevant experience
Relevant experience in project or program management, business operations, strategy execution, executive reporting or leadership enablement at a level appropriate for a Supervising Associate role.
Experience working in EY, a Big 4 organization, professional services or a comparable global matrix environment is preferred.
Exposure to Markets reporting, performance management, governance and stakeholder-facing delivery is preferred.
Exposure to tools like PowerBi, Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services including Copilot

Job Summary
The Strategy & Value Insights Lead is responsible for enabling business leaders understand markets performance along with key drivers with actionable and impactful insights. This professional needs to be able to examine data, derive patterns, infer insights in the lens of business context and generate easy to understand business narratives.
The Power BI & Executive Insights Lead will design, develop and maintain executive reporting solutions, dashboards and analytical products for USLI leadership. The role combines Power BI development, data modelling and visualization with business analytics to transform Markets and performance data into clear, actionable executive insights. The successful candidate will understand the EY reporting environment and collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners and Global Analytics teams to deliver trusted, scalable and decision-ready reporting.
Team - EY Strategy Execution & Operations (SE&O)
Stakeholder(s) - C&I Executive Insights Command Centre
Role Title(s) - Power BI & Executive Insights Lead
SE&O Competency Pillar - SEO Region Support USLI
Key responsibilities

Dashboard Development & Reporting
Design, develop, test and maintain Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards and recurring leadership reports.
Create scalable reporting frameworks, reusable data models and standardized visualization components.
Automate reporting workflows to reduce manual effort and improve timeliness, consistency and usability.
Apply effective information design and data storytelling principles to produce executive-ready outputs.
Document data sources, logic, calculations, refresh processes and user guidance.
Build efficiencies, automation and standardization of data workflows
Develop and maintain collaboration tools and portals to facilitate seamless and efficient operations.
Provide baselines, targets and measure progress to goals


Executive Insights & Analytics
Analyze Markets, revenue, sales, pipeline, pursuits, growth and operational performance data.
Identify trends, risks, opportunities, exceptions and key performance drivers.
Translate complex analysis into concise business narratives, visuals and recommendations for leadership decision-making.
Support performance diagnostics, planning, forecasting and leadership review cycles.
Combine business context with data findings to develop actionable, easy-to-consume insights.


Data Management, Governance & Innovation
Partner with data owners and stakeholders to validate data quality, definitions and reporting logic.
Support KPI standardization, reporting governance, access controls and consistency across executive deliverables.
Investigate data issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
Leverage EY Global Analytics tools, Power Platform capabilities and appropriate AI-enabled tools to enhance reporting and insight generation.
Identify opportunities for self-service analytics, workflow efficiency and continuous improvement.


Skills and attributes for success
Advanced Power BI development skills, including DAX, Power Query, data modelling, visualization and dashboard performance optimization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect data to business context.
Good knowledge of EY reporting, Markets data and Global Analytics tools.
Understanding of revenue, sales, pipeline, pursuits, growth and performance metrics.
Executive data storytelling, presentation and business writing capability.
Strong stakeholder management, requirements gathering and communication skills.
High attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy and quality.
Advanced Excel skills; exposure to MS365 Power Platform, Co-pilot or related analytics technologies is beneficial.


To qualify for the role, you must have
12+ years of work experience
Exposure to Big 4 or leading consulting firms is a plus
Relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, executive reporting, data visualization or dashboard development at a level appropriate for a Supervising Associate role.
Demonstrated experience delivering Power BI solutions and leadership-facing reporting products.
Experience with EY reporting, Markets data, Global Analytics or a comparable professional services reporting environment is preferred.
Bachelors/ Masters degree in analytics, information systems, business, statistics, engineering or a related discipline.

Job Summary
Job Title: Manager Organization and Workforce Transformation
Business Unit: People Consulting
The Opportunity
In this role, you will collaborate with senior client stakeholders to design and implement integrated solutions spanning Talent Management Framework, Total Rewards, Leadership Development, Strategic Workforce Planning, and HR analytics. You will play a key role in translating business strategy into actionable workforce and HR interventions that deliver measurable impact.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead Organization and Workforce Transformation engagements, focusing on people strategy and Talent Management frameworks including competency management, Career Framework, succession planning etc.
Deliver Total Rewards solutions, including job evaluation, compensation benchmarking, and benefits strategy design.
Deliver leadership assessment and development programs, including 360-degree assessments and targeted capability-building initiatives.
Lead Strategic Workforce Planning projects, including demand-supply analysis, scenario planning, and workforce optimization strategies.
Leverage HR analytics to generate data-driven insights, enabling informed decision-making and improved workforce outcomes.
Facilitate client workshops and stakeholder sessions to drive alignment, co-create solutions, and support transformation adoption.
Develop thought leadership, point-of-view (PoV) content, and reusable tools/assets to strengthen capabilities and support client solutioning.
Stay informed on emerging HR trends, tools, and leading practices to enhance solution design and delivery.


What Youll Need to Succeed
Strong understanding of Organization and Workforce Transformation, including People strategy, Workforce planning and Talent Management practices.
Expertise in Total Rewards, including Job Evaluation, Compensation Benchmarking, and benefits strategy.
Experience in psychometric assessments, competency frameworks, and talent assessment methodologies.
Proficiency in HR analytics, workforce planning, and data-driven decision-making approaches.
Excellent project management skills, with experience managing multiple workstreams and meeting timelines.


To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:
10+ years of experience in HR consulting, organization and workforce transformation, or related advisory roles.
Proven experience in leading enterprise-wide Talent Management initiatives.
Bachelors or Masters degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field.
Relevant certifications (e.g., Prosci, CIPD, SHRM, or psychometric assessment certifications) are an advantage.
Experience in professional services or global consulting environments is preferred.

Description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Job Summary

Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect & Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642)
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
The opportunity
EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect & Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
Your key responsibilities
Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
Define current-state, target-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
Own end-to-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
Own the end-to-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
Define API-led, event-driven, workflow-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted-service channels.
Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.
Integrate Qualtrics experience data with support platforms to enable feedback capture, experience analysis and closed-loop service improvement.
Define knowledge integration and orchestration across ServiceNow Knowledge, OEM knowledge sources, internal runbooks and enterprise repositories.
Define architecture patterns and governance controls for virtual agents, Copilot experiences, agent-assist capabilities, enterprise search and AI-enabled support.
Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, interface standards and non-functional requirements.
Lead solution architecture reviews and ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, information security, privacy, data governance, compliance and resilience requirements.
Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, platform teams, vendors and implementation partners throughout design, build, testing, deployment and transition to operations.
Review solution designs, integration specifications, data mappings, user stories, test strategies, release plans and production-readiness evidence.
Own technical risks, dependencies, architecture decisions, exceptions and technical debt, ensuring timely resolution and transparent escalation.
Define and communicate the product vision, platform strategy, value proposition and roadmap for Support Experience platforms.
Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, architectural dependencies, operational impact, risk and user experience outcomes.
Translate business objectives and architecture into epics, capabilities, features, non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and release plans.
Partner with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, evaluate solution options and validate that delivered capabilities meet intended outcomes.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while providing architecture direction and timely decisions.
Define and monitor measures for platform adoption, reliability, integration performance, self-service, automation, experience and value realization.
Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior leaders and communicate architecture options, trade-offs, recommendations, risks and roadmap implications clearly.


Skills and attributes for success
To qualify for the role you must have
12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, solution architecture, platform engineering, IT service management or digital workplace solutions.
7+ years of ServiceNow solution architecture or equivalent senior technical leadership experience.
Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale employee support, service management or omnichannel service solutions.
Strong ServiceNow expertise across ITSM, Employee Center, Virtual Agent

Job Summary
The Technology Business Management (TBM) Office Lead is responsible for driving the adoption and strategic use of IBM Apptio platform to optimize technology investments and enhance business value. This role provides leadership in implementing TBM methodologies and tools, driving transparency in technology spending, and enabling data-driven decision-making across IT and finance teams. The TBM Office Leader acts as a product owner, change agent, championing transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in technology financial management.
Your key responsibilities
Lead the TBM Office, overseeing the deployment and ongoing management of Apptio solutions to track, analyze, and optimize IT costs and investments.
Collaborate with IT, finance, and the business office to establish and maintain a TBM framework that drives transparency and aligns technology spending with strategic objectives.
Develop and deliver actionable insights using Apptio dashboards and reports, enabling executive stakeholders to make informed decisions on technology portfolios and investments.
Data Integration & Quality: Connect Apptio with other tools (e.g., Finance, Talent, Procurement contracts) for automated data loading, cleaning, and validation to ensure accurate reporting.
Drive adoption of TBM best practices and Apptio platform capabilities, facilitating training, change management initiatives across the organization, and acting as the overall evangelist and subject matter expert in this regard. Educate and train stakeholders on Apptio data to enable decision-making, while bridging gaps between IT, finance, and the business office.
Monitor and measure performance metrics, identifying opportunities for cost optimization, improved resource allocation, and increased ROI on technology initiatives.
Financial Analysis & Planning: Support budgeting, forecasting, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), and chargeback/show back reporting.
Serve as the primary liaison between the organization and IBM Apptio support, ensuring platform updates, troubleshooting, and enhancements meet business needs.
Change Management: Lead initiatives to mature the organization's use of TBM / Apptio data and foster accountability across the company.
Stay current with industry trends and regulatory requirements, adapting TBM strategies to ensure compliance, operational excellence, scalability and alignment to EY Finance and Business Office requirements and strategic objectives.


Skills and attributes for success
Extensive experience in technology business management, IT financial management, or related fields.
Domain knowledge: Strong knowledge of TBM methodology and detailed knowledge of IBM Apptio platform capabilities, configurations and operations (IT Planning and Cost Transparency)
Proficiency in data analysis, data modeling, and IT service management. Analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data to drive business insights.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence executive decision-making, and drive organizational change.
Communication: Proven ability to present actionable insights to cross-functional executive-level stakeholders, influence decision making and bring clarity to what would otherwise be considered complex topics.
Experience in project management, process improvement, and technology portfolio optimization.
Strategic thinking and business acumen to align technology investments with organizational goals.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for interpreting complex financial and IT data.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities to foster collaboration between IT, finance, and business units.
Proficiency with Apptio or similar TBM platforms, including dashboard and reporting capabilities.
Leadership qualities to drive change, champion transparency, and promote accountability in technology financial management.
Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset to respond to evolving business needs and technology landscapes.
Solid Project management skills, including the ability to oversee complex initiatives and ensure timely delivery.


To qualify for the role, you must have:
Bachelors degree in IT, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline (masters preferred).
Relevant experience in project management, process improvement, and technology portfolio optimization.
Strategic thinking and business acumen to align technology investments with organizational objectives.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities to facilitate collaboration across IT, finance, and business units.


Ideally, youll also have
TBMA certification is desired but not required for this role.


What we look for
Qualities of top performers include a continuous improvement mindset, good analytical / problem solving / reverse engineering skills, and strong customer service and organizational skills.

Job Summary
Network Engineer (WAN) - GCS - Senior Associate / Associate
The Network Engineer (WAN) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) supports vulnerability remediation, software lifecycle management, firmware upgrades, and production change execution across enterprise WAN infrastructure. The role performs technical implementation, validation, troubleshooting, and documentation activities involving Cisco routing and switching, Versa SD-WAN, WAN links, and related connectivity platforms.
The position works with Senior Engineers, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Change Management, Outage Management, vendors, carriers, and service providers to execute remediation and upgrade activities safely and maintain compliance with approved software and operational standards.
Job Description
Support vulnerability remediation activities across Versa SD-WAN, Cisco routing and switching, and WAN connectivity platforms.
Execute approved software and firmware upgrades on Cisco ISR and ASR routers, Catalyst platforms supporting WAN connectivity, Versa SD-WAN controllers, branch edge devices, and supporting infrastructure.
Review and implement assigned remediation actions arising from vendor security advisories, software recommendations, defects, and EOS/EOL notices.
Support software lifecycle management and platform currency for Cisco routing and switching platforms and Versa SD-WAN infrastructure.
Perform pre-upgrade validation, compatibility checks, configuration reviews, software image verification, post-upgrade validation, and health checks.
Prepare and maintain implementation procedures, rollback steps, validation plans, technical assessments, change tasks, and deployment records.
Participate in CAB preparation and support Senior Engineers during technical change reviews when required.
Execute approved remediation activities, platform upgrades, configuration updates, and network changes within planned maintenance windows.
Troubleshoot Versa SD-WAN overlays, underlay connectivity, routing protocols, enterprise routing infrastructure, and WAN link issues.
Diagnose and resolve issues involving BGP, OSPF, route policies, WAN failover, VPN connectivity, QoS, traffic steering, and application forwarding policies.
Support troubleshooting of ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
Work with vendors, carriers, service providers, and internal teams to restore service and resolve technical issues.
Participate in outage calls, incident recovery, impact assessment, issue investigation, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.
Support Problem Management by providing technical analysis, logs, command outputs, trends, and troubleshooting evidence.
Support remediation waves, upgrade deployments, technology refreshes, and WAN modernization initiatives.
Participate in testing, implementation, stabilization, and post-deployment validation activities.
Maintain operational runbooks, remediation documentation, software compliance records, upgrade history, and implementation outcomes.
Provide accurate progress updates and promptly escalate technical risks, blockers, failed validations, and dependencies.
Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, monitoring, and operational improvement.


Knowledge & Competencies Required:
Working knowledge of Versa SD-WAN, including Versa Director and Analytics, overlays, underlay connectivity, traffic steering, and branch edge operations.
Hands-on knowledge of Cisco routing technologies, including ISR and ASR platforms, and switching platforms supporting WAN connectivity.
Understanding of BGP, OSPF, IP addressing, route selection, redundancy, VPN services, QoS, and WAN failover.
Ability to troubleshoot WAN links, ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
Experience supporting network firmware upgrades, vulnerability remediation, configuration changes, and lifecycle activities.
Strong troubleshooting discipline, including collection and interpretation of logs, command outputs, alerts, and monitoring data.
Working knowledge of Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management practices.
Ability to follow implementation procedures, complete validation accurately, and escalate unexpected conditions appropriately.
Good technical documentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms.
Basic scripting or automation knowledge using APIs, Python, Ansible, or related tools is desirable.
Strong ownership, attention to detail, compliance focus, and continuous improvement mindset.
Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and support across multiple time zones.
Flexibility to support maintenance, deployments, upgrades, remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required.
Ready to travel when required and collaborate with globally distributed teams, vendors, carriers, and service providers.


Job Requirements

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline


Experience
Minimum of 3-6 years of experience in enterprise WAN network engineering, SD-WAN, routing and switching, or related network technology support.


Certification Requirements
CCNA preferred. Versa Associate certification and ITIL v4 Foundation are value adds.

Description:
Job Summary
The DPS Compliance SME supports the Stay in Compliance Lead by managing compliance, risk and control activities for the organisations enterprise data protection services. The role covers Veeam Data Platform, Dell PowerProtect Data Domain, Infinidat InfiniGuard, Azure-based backup services, physical backup infrastructure, tape technologies and the associated Windows, Linux, virtualisation, network and SAN dependencies. The role helps maintain secure, supported and recoverable backup services through vulnerability management, patch and version currency, configuration assurance, immutable protection, encryption, capacity oversight, lifecycle management and recovery control validation.
Working with DPS Engineering, DPS Operations, Information Security, Service Management, infrastructure teams, application owners, managed-service providers and vendors, the role identifies and assesses alerts and vulnerabilities, supports risk-based prioritisation and remediation, monitors backup and recovery control performance, and produces traceable governance and audit reporting. The position provides product-specific subject-matter expertise and clear escalation to the Stay in Compliance Lead, without owning the broader infrastructure compliance programme.
Job Description
Serve as the product-specific compliance SME for enterprise Data Protection Services, including Veeam Data Platform, Dell PowerProtect Data Domain, Infinidat InfiniGuard, Azure backup services, backup servers, repositories, appliances and tape infrastructure.
Monitor backup application, appliance, operating-system, security and vendor alerts; identify vulnerabilities, unsupported versions, configuration weaknesses and compliance gaps affecting DPS platforms and dependencies.
Assess technical impact, affected versions, exploitability, backup-window and restore dependencies, data criticality and business risk, and support risk-based prioritisation in line with agreed standards and SLAs.
Coordinate remediation of DPS vulnerabilities, missing patches, unsupported software or firmware, insecure configurations and hardware lifecycle risks with Engineering, Operations, infrastructure teams and vendors.
Maintain compliance visibility across Veeam backup servers, proxies, repositories, scale-out repositories, hardened repositories, cloud repositories, orchestration components and protected workloads.
Maintain compliance visibility across Data Domain and InfiniGuard appliances, covering operating software, firmware, capacity, replication, deduplication, encryption, retention lock, immutable snapshots, access controls and support lifecycle.
Validate the design and operation of immutability, encryption, off-site or isolated backup copies, role separation, privileged access and other ransomware-resilience controls.
Review vendor security advisories, CVEs, release notes, known issues, compatibility matrices and prerequisites, and translate findings into clear remediation actions.
Track remediation actions, ageing, exceptions, dependencies and closure evidence, escalating material risk, unsupported components or delivery delays to the Stay in Compliance Lead.
Support patching, upgrade and maintenance activities by validating readiness, service safeguards, rollback plans, change evidence, controlled restart requirements and post-remediation compliance status.
Monitor backup success, consecutive failures, restore-point availability, policy compliance, recovery testing, capacity, utilisation and inventory data to identify control failures and emerging operational risk.
Maintain DPS compliance records covering asset inventory, software and firmware currency, support lifecycle, protection status, security findings, approved exceptions, ownership and control evidence.
Analyse estate, backup, vulnerability, capacity and remediation data using Power BI, SQL, spreadsheets, scripts and APIs to produce dashboards, trend analysis, SLA metrics and management reporting.
Prepare regular governance and compliance reports for the Stay in Compliance Lead, highlighting exposure, backup-control performance, remediation progress, lifecycle risk, exceptions and recovery readiness.
Support internal and external audits, disaster-recovery exercises and restore tests by providing timely, complete and traceable evidence and coordinating remediation of observations.
Identify opportunities to improve vulnerability assessment, patch planning, alert handling, inventory accuracy, evidence collection, reporting and control automation across DPS.
Build effective working relationships across DPS Engineering, DPS Operations, Information Security, Service Management, infrastructure teams, application teams and vendors while operating within the governance direction set by the Stay in Compliance Lead.


Knowledge & Competencies Required
Advanced knowledge of enterprise backup and recovery operations, including policy design, scheduling, repositories, copy jobs, retention, restore validation, capacity planning, high availability and disaster recovery.
Profound knowledge of Veeam Data Platform and its core backup, replication, repository, reporting and recovery capabilities in complex enterprise environments.
Profound knowledge of Dell PowerProtect Data Domain and Infinidat InfiniGuard backup appliances, including capacity, deduplication, replication, performance, security, immutability and lifecycle considerations.
Advanced knowledge of Azure and hybrid-cloud data protection, including Azure Backup, vaults, policy governance, encryption, immutable storage, access control, monitoring and recovery concepts.
Profound knowledge of encryption, immutability, hardened repositories, retention lock, logical isolation, role separation and cyber-recovery controls.
Advanced knowledge of tape libraries, tape drives, media handling, off-site retention and audit controls.
Understanding of vulnerability management, security alert handling, risk assessment, remediation SLAs, patch currency, configuration compliance, inventory and product lifecycle controls.
Ability to interpret vendor advisories, CVEs, severity scores, release notes, compatibility matrices and scan findings and translate them into prioritised technical actions.
Working knowledge of backup infrastructure dependencies including Windows and Linux servers, virtualisation platforms, databases, networks, SAN, storage and identity services.

Job Title
EY Cyber Security Cloud Security Architect Manager
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Manager in our Cyber Security team with a strong focus on Cloud Security Architecture. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, governing, and assuring secure cloud and hybrid architectures, enabling organizations to adopt and scale cloud technologies securely across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and cloud native platforms.
You will work with global clients to define secure cloud landing zones, reference architectures, and security by design patterns, supporting large scale cloud transformation, modernization, and migration programs while addressing evolving cyber, regulatory, and business risks.
Your Key Responsibilities
Design and define cloud security architectures for hybrid and multi cloud environments across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
Develop secure cloud reference architectures and landing zone designs, incorporating identity, network segmentation, encryption, logging, monitoring, and governance controls.
Lead cloud security architecture reviews and design assurance activities for client cloud programs.
Apply Zero Trust Architecture principles across cloud, identity, network, and workload layers.
Architect security controls for cloud native services, including containers, Kubernetes, serverless, and PaaS offerings.
Oversee the integration of cloud native security services such as CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, CASB, and cloud native SIEM/SOAR.
Conduct cloud threat modeling and risk assessments, addressing shared responsibility models and platform specific risks.
Support secure adoption of DevSecOps practices, including infrastructure as code (IaC) and policy as code.
Review and assess cloud configurations for compliance with organizational standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Collaborate with enterprise security architecture, data, privacy, and AI teams to ensure end to end security alignment.
Engage senior client stakeholders to align cloud security strategy with business objectives and risk appetite.
Mentor and guide junior consultants and architects, fostering strong cloud security capabilities.
Contribute to solution development, go to market assets, RFPs, and proposals.


Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong experience in cloud security architecture and design.
Deep understanding of cloud shared responsibility models and defense in depth.
Strong knowledge of identity centric security, network security, encryption, and key management in cloud environments.
Experience securing cloud native workloads (containers, serverless, PaaS).
Familiarity with CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, CASB, and cloud native security tooling.
Strong understanding of Zero Trust Architecture in cloud contexts.
Ability to translate complex cloud security risks into clear, actionable guidance.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple engagements in a fast paced consulting environment.


To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
1014 years of experience in Information Technology, with specialization in Cloud and Cyber Security.
Proven experience designing and reviewing cloud security architectures across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP.
Hands on exposure to cloud IAM, network security, encryption, logging, and monitoring services.
Experience implementing or integrating cloud security tooling (CSPM, CWPP, CIEM).
Experience supporting cloud risk assessments, architecture reviews, and transformation programs.
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Azure/AWS/GCP Security certifications, or equivalent.


Ideally, Youll Also Have
Experience working in a consulting or professional services environment.
Exposure to multi cloud and hybrid cloud operating models.
Familiarity with DevSecOps, IaC, and CI/CD security practices.
Experience aligning cloud security with privacy, data protection, and regulatory requirements.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build trusted client relationships.
A proactive mindset toward emerging cloud security threats and innovations.


What We Look For
Professionals with strong cloud architecture depth and consulting mindset.
Ability to lead cloud security discussions with CISOs, CTOs, Cloud Architects, and senior stakeholders.
Comfort working across technology, risk, and business teams.
Experience supporting RFP responses, proposals, and solution shaping is a plus.
Passion for enabling secure, scalable, and resilient cloud adoption.

Job Summary
As part of our Risk Consulting FS team, we are looking for a Manager with strong consulting and technical skills to join the FS Risk team and to work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects within the financial services sector across MENA region. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst strongly contributing to the growth of Risk Consulting FS domain service offerings and solutions thus creating authentic customer experiences.
The opportunity
As a manager, you will engage with clients to validate and enhance sanctions screening and transaction monitoring models, ensuring they are finely tuned to meet regulatory standards and operational needs. You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams leading engagements and play a key role in ensuring high quality outputs and service to our clients. You will oversee the validation and fine-tuning of models/ tools used for sanctions screening and transaction monitoring. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, enhancing model performance, developing knowledge and implementing new solutions in order to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients.
Your key responsibilities
Build a team of Seniors and Analysts to drive the model validation related activities.
Lead and oversee sanction screening and transaction monitoring model validation engagements including rule-based systems anomaly detection and machine learning algorithms.
Develop and implement strategies for model fine-tuning and performance enhancement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate model outputs into business processes.
Provide training and guidance to team members on model validation processes and best practices.
Conduct regular reviews (both qualitative and quantitative analysis) and audits of model performance and compliance.
Lead the development of reports on model performance and validation outcomes and present to senior management on an on-going basis.
Prepare detailed validation reports and documentation for regulatory bodies and internal stakeholders.
Develop, implement and continuously improve the validation frameworks including back-testing, threshold setting and performance metrics.
Stay abreast of regulatory changes and advancements in model validation techniques.
Lead multiple assignments and related initiatives.
Develop strong working relationships with the client and onshore client teams.

Job Title: Windows & Linux Compliance SME
Job Summary
The MSFT Windows Compliance SME supports the Stay in Compliance Lead by managing compliance, risk and control activities across the global on-premises Windows Server estate. The role provides deep technical expertise for Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell Desired State Configuration, server hardware, virtualisation and associated hybrid-cloud management capabilities. The role helps maintain a secure, supported and consistently configured estate through vulnerability remediation, security hardening, patch and version currency, configuration baselines, identity and access controls, automation, hardware lifecycle management and audit assurance.
Working with On-Prem Hosting Engineering and Operations, Information Security, Active Directory, Service Management, hardware, virtualisation, cloud and application teams, the role assesses security findings and configuration drift, engineers and coordinates large-scale remediation, and produces traceable governance and audit reporting. The position provides Windows-specific subject-matter expertise and clear escalation to the Stay in Compliance Lead, while coordinating cross-platform dependencies where Windows services interact with Linux, Azure, AWS, VMware, Nutanix AHV or Hyper-V environments.
Job Description
Serve as the compliance SME for the global on-premises Microsoft Windows Server estate, supporting environments at enterprise scale, including estates exceeding 10,000 servers.
Monitor Microsoft security advisories, vulnerability findings, operating-system alerts, configuration data and vendor notifications to identify exposure affecting Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025.
Assess technical impact, affected versions, exploitability, business criticality, service dependencies and compensating controls, and support risk-based prioritisation in line with agreed standards and remediation SLAs.
Engineer, package, test and coordinate large-scale remediation for security vulnerabilities, configuration changes and software updates using Microsoft Configuration Manager, PowerShell, Desired State Configuration and Ansible.
Design, implement and maintain Group Policy Objects and verify consistent application across relevant Active Directory forests and domains.
Create and maintain security configuration items, baselines, compliance rules and automated corrective controls using PowerShell DSC and approved enterprise tooling.
Plan and schedule deployment waves for patches, security configurations, GPO changes, software packages, firmware and drivers, balancing remediation urgency with production stability.
Maintain compliance visibility across physical and virtual Windows servers hosted on VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper-V, including hardware, firmware, drivers, operating-system versions and support lifecycle.
Support secure account and access management for Windows servers, including privileged access, service accounts, local administrator controls, authentication policy and role separation.
Perform security and performance analysis and recommend hardening, tuning and configuration changes for mission-critical production systems in data-centre environments.
Support hybrid management of on-premises servers through Microsoft Azure capabilities, including Azure Arc-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update-management concepts where adopted.
Coordinate cross-platform remediation dependencies with Linux teams using Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform when shared services, automation or controls span Windows and Linux environments.
Prepare implementation plans, technical procedures, validation steps, rollback plans, change records and stakeholder communications for compliance deployments.
Track remediation actions, ageing, exceptions, deployment failures, dependencies and closure evidence, escalating material risk or delivery delays to the Stay in Compliance Lead.
Maintain accurate compliance records covering server inventory, patch and configuration status, GPO application, software and firmware currency, lifecycle, vulnerabilities, ownership, approved exceptions and evidence.
Use ServiceNow, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Power BI, Dell OpenManage Enterprise, monitoring platforms, SharePoint, scripts and APIs to analyse compliance, automate recurring tasks and produce dashboards and reports.
Support internal and external audits by providing timely, complete and traceable Windows Server configuration, access, patching, lifecycle and remediation evidence.
Identify opportunities to standardise and automate vulnerability assessment, packaging, deployment, compliance validation, evidence collection and reporting using DevOps and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Build effective working relationships across Engineering, Operations, Information Security, Service Management, Active Directory, Linux, cloud, virtualisation, hardware and application teams while operating within the governance direction set by the Stay in Compliance Lead.


Knowledge & Competencies Required
Advanced hands-on administration and compliance experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025 in large, globally distributed production environments.
Expert knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy design and management, domain and forest structures, authentication, service accounts and privileged-access controls.
Proven experience assessing security risk, remediating Windows Server vulnerabilities, applying security baselines and tuning systems securely without compromising service availability.
Deep scripting and automation capability in PowerShell, WMI and Python; experience with Ansible is required, while VBS and Perl knowledge is beneficial for legacy environments.
Strong experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager and packaging and deploying software, scripts, updates and remediation controls at enterprise scale.
Experience creating configuration items, security baselines and desired-state controls using PowerShell DSC or equivalent configuration-as-code capabilities.
Ability to interpret Microsoft security advisories, CVEs, severity scores, vulnerability scan findings, support lifecycle information and technical prerequisites and translate them into deployment actions.
Strong knowledge of Windows Server hardware management, firmware and driver currency, remote management and lifecycle controls; Dell OpenManage Enterprise experience is advantageous.
Good knowledge of VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV and Hyper-V virtualisation and the operational dependencies between guest operating systems and hosting platforms.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and hybrid-cloud management, including Azure Arc-enabled servers, Azure Policy, machine configuration, monitoring and update-management concepts; AWS familiarity is beneficial.
Working knowledge of Linux security and administration, Red Hat Satellite and Ansible Automation Platform sufficient to coordinate shared compliance and automation dependencies.
Experience with ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, monitoring and systems-management platforms for remediation tracking,

Job Title
Senior Network Engineer (WAN) - GCS
Job Summary
The Senior Network Engineer (WAN) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) is responsible for executing vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, software upgrades, and technical change activities across enterprise WAN infrastructure. The role provides technical leadership for deployment activities, complex troubleshooting, change execution, and service restoration involving Cisco Routing and Switching, Versa SD-WAN, WAN links, and associated connectivity platforms.
The position works with Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Change Management, Outage Management, Product Owners, vendors, service providers, and other stakeholders to maintain platform currency, deliver remediation programs, and ensure production changes are implemented safely with minimal business disruption.
Responsibilities
Drive vulnerability remediation activities across Versa SD-WAN, Cisco Routing and Switching, and WAN connectivity platforms.
Perform software and firmware upgrades on Cisco ISR and ASR routers, Catalyst platforms supporting WAN connectivity, Versa SD-WAN controllers, branch edge devices, and supporting network infrastructure in line with approved engineering standards.
Review vendor security advisories, software recommendations, defects, and EOS/EOL notices, and translate applicable findings into remediation and lifecycle activities.
Ensure WAN network devices remain compliant with approved software versions, security standards, operational guidelines, and remediation timelines.
Manage software lifecycle and platform currency for Cisco routing and switching platforms and Versa SD-WAN infrastructure.
Plan and execute code upgrades, patch deployments, configuration updates, platform remediation, technology refresh, and WAN modernization activities.
Perform pre-upgrade assessments, compatibility reviews, configuration validation, risk analysis, and post-upgrade health checks.
Prepare implementation plans, rollback procedures, validation plans, technical assessments, stakeholder communications, and deployment documentation.
Create and maintain Change Requests, Change Tasks, implementation records, approvals, technical evidence, and closure documentation in accordance with EY processes.
Present technical changes during CAB reviews and address implementation, impact, risk, dependency, validation, and recovery considerations.
Coordinate testing, outage planning, deployment execution, stabilization, and post-implementation validation across technical teams and stakeholders.
Perform advanced troubleshooting of Versa SD-WAN overlays, underlay WAN connectivity, routing protocols, and enterprise routing infrastructure.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving BGP, OSPF, route policies, path selection, WAN failover, VPN services, traffic steering, QoS, and application forwarding policies.
Diagnose and resolve issues affecting WAN links, ISP circuits, SD-WAN fabric health, branch connectivity, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
Work with vendors, carriers, service providers, and internal teams to restore services and resolve complex technical issues.
Serve as the technical lead for incidents affecting WAN infrastructure, routing platforms, SD-WAN services, and production upgrade activities.
Participate in outage calls, major incident bridges, and technical recovery activities; perform root cause analysis and define corrective and preventive actions.
Support Problem Management by analyzing recurring issues, identifying trends, and driving permanent technical resolutions.
Lead assigned remediation waves, upgrade deployments, infrastructure refreshes, and network improvement initiatives.
Coordinate testing, validation, implementation, and stabilization activities, and track technical risks, dependencies, actions, and delivery progress.
Provide operational feedback, implementation considerations, and technical recommendations for proposed network design changes when requested.
Maintain implementation procedures, operational runbooks, remediation documentation, software compliance records, upgrade history, and deployment outcomes.
Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, monitoring, analytics, and operational efficiency.
Provide technical guidance to Associate and Senior Associate engineers and support consistent execution of WAN remediation and lifecycle activities.


Knowledge & Competencies Required
Strong hands-on knowledge of Versa SD-WAN, including Versa Director and Analytics, SD-WAN overlays, underlay connectivity, traffic steering, and branch edge operations.
Strong expertise in Cisco routing technologies, including ISR and ASR platforms, and Cisco switching platforms supporting WAN connectivity.
Advanced understanding of BGP, OSPF, routing policies, route selection, redundancy, VPN services, QoS, and WAN failover.
Experience troubleshooting WAN links, ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
Experience assessing vendor security advisories and delivering vulnerability remediation, firmware lifecycle, patching, and infrastructure upgrade activities.
Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, impact assessment, and service restoration capabilities.
Working knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management.
Ability to prepare implementation plans, rollback procedures, validation plans, technical documentation, and CAB presentations.
Experience coordinating production deployments, outage windows, vendors, carriers, service providers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms.
Automation or scripting knowledge using APIs, Python, Ansible, or related tools is desirable.
Strong ownership, sound technical judgement, risk-based decision making, and attention to operational safety.
Good communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and technical leadership skills within a global matrixed environment.
Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and support activities across multiple time zones.
Flexibility to support planned maintenance, production deployments, software upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required.
