And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY - Risk Consulting - Manager, Regulatory Compliance
As part of Risk Consulting, you will lead and support client engagements focused on regulatory compliance strategy, governance, obligation management, compliance assurance and transformation across the MENA region. You will work with banks, regulators, financial institutions and clients across other regulated sectors to design practical and sustainable compliance frameworks, operating models and remediation programmes.
The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Manager with a strong background in regulatory compliance, internal audit, risk management or conduct risk reviews to join our Risk Consulting team. This is an opportunity to contribute to the growth of a leading advisory practice while helping clients strengthen regulatory governance, compliance maturity and their response to evolving supervisory expectations. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will advise clients across a variety of industries and operating environments, lead high-quality engagements and develop your experience in regulatory strategy and governance, regulatory universes and obligations, compliance monitoring and testing, regulatory inspections and compliance transformation.
Your key responsibilities
As part of the role, you will lead and support responsibilities across the following areas:
Regulatory Compliance
Lead the design, implementation and enhancement of enterprise-wide regulatory compliance frameworks and governance structures.
Oversee the development and maintenance of regulatory inventories, compliance universes and regulatory obligation registers.
Direct regulatory obligation extraction, rationalisation, applicability analysis and mapping to risks, controls, policies and business processes.
Establish and enhance regulatory change management programmes to assess, communicate and implement new or amended requirements.
Lead regulatory compliance reviews, thematic assessments and compliance monitoring and testing programmes.
Assess the design and effectiveness of compliance controls and governance mechanisms, identify gaps and direct remediation activities.
Provide independent challenge to first-line business functions and deliver clear, risk-based recommendations to strengthen compliance maturity.
Guide clients through regulatory inspections, supervisory reviews, information requests and remediation programmes.
Lead implementation of relevant international compliance standards and leading practices, tailored to client requirements and regulatory expectations.
Crypto Compliance
Support compliance assessments relating to virtual assets and crypto exchange operations, including customer onboarding, wallet and transaction flows, custody arrangements and market integrity risks.
Assess blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring frameworks used to identify, investigate and escalate risks associated with virtual assets and crypto-related activity.
Review sanctions screening and compliance arrangements relevant to crypto activities, including requirements issued by OFAC, the United Nations, the European Union and UK HM Treasury.
General Management and Consulting Responsibilities
Advise executive management and Board committees on emerging regulatory risks, industry developments and strategic compliance priorities.
Lead large-scale compliance transformation initiatives, including compliance management systems, target operating models and control enhancement programmes.
Manage engagement scope, economics, resources, risks, quality, timelines and client expectations.
Present compliance reports, findings and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders, executive management and governance committees.
Coach and mentor team members and foster a culture of quality, collaboration and continuous learning.
Develop proposals, thought leadership and go-to-market initiatives that support the growth of the regulatory compliance practice.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong knowledge of regulatory compliance governance, regulatory obligation management, compliance monitoring, testing and remediation.
Strong understanding of CBUAE, SAMA, Basel, AML/KYC, Consumer Protection and governance frameworks; exposure to governance requirements in the government, infrastructure and energy sectors is advantageous.
Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements and compliance findings into concise executive and Board-level reporting.
Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving and independent challenge skills.
Proven project and engagement management capability, including management of multidisciplinary teams, multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with confidence presenting to executive management, regulators and governance forums.
Strong proposal development, account management and business development capabilities.
MENA regional experience and familiarity with local regulators, particularly CBUAE and SAMA, would be advantageous.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Law or a related discipline.
Nine to twelve years of relevant experience in regulatory compliance, internal audit, risk management or conduct risk review programmes.
Experience within banks, regulators, consulting firms or other financial institutions.
Demonstrable experience leading regulatory compliance frameworks, obligation management, assurance reviews, regulatory change or remediation initiatives.
Experience managing teams and engaging with executive management, Board committees, regulators and senior client stakeholders.
Ideally, you ll also have
An MBA and/or a relevant professional qualification such as CIA or CAMS.
Prior consulting or professional-services experience leading regulatory compliance engagements.
MENA regional experience with CBUAE, SAMA or other local regulators.
Experience across banking, government and infrastructure, or energy-sector governance and compliance frameworks.
Exposure to blockchain analytics tools and transaction monitoring approaches used to identify and investigate risks associated with virtual assets and crypto-related activity.
Knowledge of sanctions compliance requirements and screening expectations, including those issued by OFAC, the United Nations, the European Union and UK HM Treasury.
Understanding of crypto exchange operations, including customer onboarding, wallet and transaction flows, custody arrangements, market integrity and related compliance risks.
Mobility and travel
Willingness and ability to travel to client locations at short notice, with an expectation of approximately 75% onsite travel.
A valid passport and ability to meet applicable travel requirements.
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching and practical experience. We value our people and provide opportunities to shape your development through challenging assignments, knowledge exchange and collaboration. We offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As an Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will work as the staffing point of contact for the assigned region/service/competency team and will be responsible to work with the service delivery managers in capturing staffing demand projections, analyze demand intake patterns, demand - supply matching, demand - supply gaps, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.

Capture demand projections, understand demands heuristics and identify actionable demand.
Calculate staffing requirements based on demand projections, delivery deadlines and productivity targets.
Identify suitable staffing options based on matching skills, roles and experiences.
Create staffing schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.
Timely update of employee schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
Proactive review of resource availability/future project demands.
Minimize bench pipeline through proactive deployment on projects.
Minimize open, unfulfilled demand.
Track monitor and report on WFM KPIs such as employee utilization, time to fulfil demand, unfulfilled demand % and bench aging.
Basic reporting and analysis.
Skills and attributes for success
Graduates with 2-3 years of relevant workforce management experience. Understanding of business models, operational and financial aspects of service delivery will be preferred. Excellent analytical skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills.

Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.

Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.
Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in resource management, demand planning and scheduling in reputed consulting, technology, financial services, accounting and professional services organizations.

We are looking for go-getters with a solution oriented and analytical mindset. Someone who is good with numbers and has the willingness to learn. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline - Clients & Industries
Role Type - UKI Technology & Reporting, Clients & Industries
Business unit specific description - Clients & Industries - GDS UKI
The Data Insights Executive serves as a strategic enabler of data-driven decision-making and digital transformation across UKI Client & Industries team. This role is responsible for delivering business-relevant insights and innovative digital solutions by leveraging advanced analytics, Microsoft 365 tools, and Copilot capabilities.
Acting as a bridge between technology and business strategy, the Data Insights executive ensures that data is transformed into actionable intelligence, fostering operational excellence and driving measurable business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities:
Deliver high-quality, data-driven insights through analytics and visualisations to support informed business decision-making.
Support digital transformation initiatives by leveraging Microsoft 365, Copilot, and automation to improve operational efficiency.
Work closely with business stakeholders and leaders to align data and digital initiatives with business priorities and regional objectives.
Communicate insights clearly and effectively through well-structured reports, dashboards, presentations, and professional stakeholder communications.
Support leadership decision-making through timely and accurate reporting, trend analysis, and actionable insights.
Design, develop, and maintain business applications using PowerApps (Canvas) to support operational and business requirements.
Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel Online, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
Collaborate closely with MSM, BD, BMC, FMT, Operations, and other relevant teams to develop effective and user-centric solutions.
Support user adoption through training, documentation, knowledge sharing, and ongoing assistance.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Alteryx-based ETL workflows to strengthen data-driven reporting and decision-making
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates good proficiency in analytics platforms and visualisation tools such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar tools to transform data into meaningful and actionable insights.
Skilled in developing interactive dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders understand trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Applies analytical and basic statistical techniques to support business decision-making and identify opportunities for improvement.
Good project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deliverables effectively.
Presentation and facilitation skills: Ability to participate in and facilitate meetings, develop presentations, interpret data, generate meaningful business insights, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
Ownership and accountability: Ability to work independently with appropriate guidance, take ownership of assigned tasks and projects, and ensure timely delivery.
Business acumen and adaptability: Ability to understand business requirements and adapt to changing stakeholder and customer expectations.
Quick learner: Ability to quickly understand processes, project objectives, requirements, and complexities and move into delivery effectively.
Process improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce turnaround times, enhance quality, and generate additional insights.
Attention to detail: Maintain accuracy and consistency across data, numbers, analysis, reporting, and formatting.
Multi-tasking capability: Demonstrate effective time management, prioritization, and the ability to manage multiple deliverables.
Excellent communication: Strong listening, reading, writing, and verbal communication skills.
Experience working with business stakeholders and senior team members, with the ability to understand requirements and communicate effectively.
MS Office skills: Good to advanced proficiency in Excel reporting and PowerPoint presentations.
Power BI / Other BI tools / Alteryx: Hands-on experience in data integration, data preparation, reporting, and data visualization.
Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism, integrity, accountability, and collaboration.

Job Description
Job Title: Senior - Incident & Access Management (IFMS)
Profile Summary:
Senior Analyst - Incident & Access Management (IFMS) will support IFMS business service continuity through incident coordination and timely, approved access provisioning for Business Operations users. The role monitors tickets and SLAs, drives resolver follow-ups, publishes service reports and identifies Continual Service Improvement (CSI) opportunities across supported engagements.
Roles and Responsibilities:
As an Incident Management Analyst, support IFMS Business Operations through the following activities:
Incident monitoring: Review MSO queues daily; validate business impact, priority and assignment, and track ageing, backlog and SLA risks.
Resolution coordination: Follow up with business and technology resolver teams, escalate delays, communicate progress and confirm closure; support major incident coordination and post-incident actions.
Access fulfilment: Handle Business Operations access requests; validate approvals and provision, modify or revoke application access within delegated permissions, following approved role profiles, least privilege and segregation-of-duties controls.
Service reporting: Publish daily ticket updates and periodic reports on demand, SLA attainment, backlog, access fulfilment, risks and outstanding actions.
Operational controls: Maintain accurate MSO records, access approval evidence, SOPs and handovers; support access reviews and track service reviews to closure.
CSI: Identify recurring incidents and process bottlenecks; recommend knowledge articles, self-service and automation, and track improvement outcomes.
Desired Skills:
Working knowledge of incident, request, access and SLA management; ITIL Foundation preferred.
Understanding of role-based access, approval workflows, least privilege and segregation of duties.
Proficiency in Excel, ITSM reporting and trend analysis; Power BI familiarity preferred.
Clear stakeholder communication, customer focus and effective business/technology team coordination.
Ability to work independently, prioritize business impact and maintain accurate records and timely follow-ups.
Essential Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in IT or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
Typically, 5-8 years in service delivery/support, including 3+ years in incident coordination, ticket governance, SLA monitoring or reporting.
Hands-on ITSM tool experience; familiarity with MSO and finance managed services environments is an advantage.
Experience in approved user access provisioning, operational reporting and service improvement tracking.

Role #2 - C&I Support, Analyst
The Opportunity
To join a high-performing multi-national team within the Global R&DA, providing financial reporting, analytics, and insights support in response to strategic and ad hoc business requests. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders within the Global Clients & Industries (C&I) organization, helping drive informed decision-making through the provisioning of high-quality information and actionable insights.
What we look for
We are seeking an Analyst with 7+ years of experience in professional services, or other leading global organizations to join our team within the Global R&DA s Leadership Reporting Pillar.
The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering accurate, timely, insightful and commercially-focused reporting and analysis to support business decision-making in EY s Global C&I organization.
They will possess strong technical capabilities and demonstrate the ability to quickly learn and apply complex commercial finance concepts.
The ideal candidate will:
Demonstrate a strong aptitude for understanding commercial financial reporting and analysis.
Be capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
Be a practical and analytical problem-solver with the ability to clearly articulate approach, findings, and recommendations.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Display curiosity and initiative, with a continuous improvement mindset seeking opportunities to enhance processes and report impact.
Take ownership of deliverables ensuring a high standard of quality, accuracy and timeliness.
Collaborate effectively within a geographically diverse team environment.
Key responsibilities
Ensure the timely and accurate delivery of assigned reports and analyses, keeping stakeholders and colleagues informed of progress and any potential issues.
Demonstrate the confidence to ask the right questions to ensure outputs align with business requirements and stakeholder expectations.
Develop a broad understanding of EY s reporting portfolio to provide effective cover and support when other team members are unavailable.
Reconcile data from multiple sources and investigate variances to ensure the consistency and accuracy of reporting outputs.
Stakeholder management
Act as a trusted business advisor to finance and business stakeholders.
Develop a thorough understanding of business requirements instilling confidence in stakeholders through high-quality delivery and responsive support.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear and concise manner.
Manage stakeholder expectations and provide regular updates on priorities, timelines and deliverables.
Continuous improvement
Support process improvement initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency, data quality, automation and stakeholder experience.
Document reporting processes and business logic for reporting assigned to you.
Support the development, testing and deployment of new reporting tools and technologies.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate processes.
Technical skill set
Design and develop SQL queries to extract, interrogate and analyse large datasets for reporting and analytical purposes.
Interpret and troubleshoot complex SQL queries written by others.
Strong experience developing and maintaining dashboards using Power BI.
Strong Excel skills including complex formulas, data modelling, and automation.
Experience working with large financial and operational datasets.
Understanding of concepts such as Wins, Pipeline, Backlog, Revenue, Margin.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent listening and communication skills.
Strong curiosity and awareness of emerging business and technology trends.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
A proactive customer-focused approach with a willingness to embrace new ideas and a commitment to continuous improvement.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Desirable - Content CMS, communications analytics, SharePoint, Adobe Analytics

Microsoft M365 Delivery Manager - Senior Manager
EY GDS Consulting Digital is seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Delivery Manager at the Senior Manager level to lead complex, large-scale Microsoft 365 transformation and managed-service engagements. The individual will be accountable for end-to-end delivery, including solution shaping, delivery planning, governance, financial and resource management, quality assurance, risk and dependency management, and client stakeholder engagement. The role requires strong technical and delivery experience across Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, security, compliance, and hybrid environments. The Delivery Manager will provide strategic direction and technical oversight, establish effective delivery controls and operating rhythms, manage globally distributed and multidisciplinary teams, address escalations, and ensure that engagements achieve agreed business outcomes, service quality, timelines, and commercial commitments. The individual will also identify opportunities for continuous improvement, automation, reusable assets, capability development, and account growth while coaching delivery leads, architects, and other team members.
The opportunity
We re looking for resources with capacity that ranges from assisting on in-flight initiatives, up to technical briefings and demonstrations of new technologies across the organization. In senior level roles, leads business solutions, capabilities, and is a strong influencer that engages with client executives and stakeholders. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
Your key responsibilities
Engage with clients and senior stakeholders to understand their business objectives, technology landscape, operational challenges, and security requirements, translating them into scalable Microsoft 365 solutions and delivery roadmaps.
Act as the Microsoft 365 subject matter expert and delivery leader, accountable for the successful delivery of complex, enterprise-scale transformation, migration, adoption, and managed-service engagements.
Own end-to-end engagement delivery, including planning, governance, scope, financial performance, resource management, quality, risks, dependencies, milestones, and contractual commitments.
Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms, controls, performance measures, and escalation mechanisms to ensure predictable and consistent delivery across multiple workstreams and globally distributed teams.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for solutions across Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, security, compliance, and hybrid environments.
Lead solution architecture and design activities for complex Microsoft 365 engagements, ensuring alignment with agreed architecture principles, security requirements, design standards, delivery methodologies, and reusable assets.
Lead major workstreams within large-scale transformation programs, ensuring coordination across architecture, engineering, migration, testing, change management, adoption, service transition, and operations teams.
Own the resolution of critical technical and delivery challenges, acting as the senior escalation point for architects, engineering teams, project managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders by translating the Microsoft 365 product roadmap, technology trends, and service changes into customer-specific recommendations, risk mitigation plans, adoption opportunities, and measurable business benefits.
Manage engagement economics, including effort estimation, budgeting, forecasting, utilization, delivery productivity, scope control, and margin performance, while balancing quality and client expectations.
Identify and manage delivery risks, architectural dependencies, security and compliance considerations, and service-readiness requirements throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Define and promote Microsoft 365 governance and best practices covering identity, access, security, compliance, information protection, lifecycle management, administration, monitoring, and user adoption.
Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardized delivery methods, reusable tools, accelerators, reference architectures, and lessons learned from previous engagements.
Lead, mentor, and coach architects, technical leads, and delivery team members through performance management, technical communities, knowledge sharing, succession planning, and capability development.
Support workforce planning, staffing, hiring, demand management, and the effective deployment of skills across concurrent engagements and account portfolios.
Contribute to proposals, solution shaping, estimations, client presentations, and account growth by identifying additional opportunities and developing credible delivery approaches.
Work effectively across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models, adapting governance, planning, controls, and reporting to suit the engagements complexity and client environment.
Communicate complex technical and delivery topics clearly to audiences ranging from engineering teams to C-level stakeholders, enabling timely decisions and maintaining alignment across all parties.
Skills and attributes
Strong experience managing complex Microsoft 365 transformation, migration, implementation, adoption, or managed-service engagements.
Good working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Power Platform, security, compliance, and hybrid environments.
Ability to understand Microsoft 365 solutions and technical dependencies sufficiently to support delivery planning, challenge delivery assumptions, manage risks, and facilitate informed decisions. The role is not expected to perform detailed solution architecture or design.
Demonstrated experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of engagements involving architects, engineers, project managers, business analysts, security specialists, change-management teams, and globally distributed delivery teams.
Strong experience managing scope, schedules, budgets, forecasts, resources, utilization, quality, delivery risks, dependencies, contractual commitments, and commercial performance.
Experience establishing delivery governance, operating rhythms, executive reporting, performance measures, issue-resolution processes, and escalation mechanisms.
Practical experience delivering through Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies, with the ability to adapt governance and delivery controls to the engagement context.
Consulting or professional-services experience is strongly preferred, including client engagement, proposal support, effort estimation, delivery planning, and account-growth activities.
Soft Skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage technical, non-technical, and executive stakeholders.
Strong leadership and team-management skills, with the ability to motivate, mentor, and develop globally distributed teams.
Collaborative team player who builds trusted relationships across clients, partners, vendors, and internal functions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and highly accountable, with a strong sense of ownership for delivery outcomes.
Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including the ability to manage expectations and facilitate decisions.
Excellent presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence to communicate delivery status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Ability to remain composed, decisive, and solution-focused in high-pressure and fast-paced delivery environments.
Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and negotiation skills.
Ability to prioritize competing demands and coordinate multiple workstreams effectively.
Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to lead teams through ambiguity, organizational change, and evolving client priorities.
Culturally aware and able to collaborate effectively across geographies, time zones, and diverse working styles.
Results-oriented, with a focus on quality, timely execution, continuous improvement, and measurable business outcomes.

At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline
Client Experience

Role Type
CX Program Lead
The opportunity
We are looking for CX Program Lead - Supervising Associate who can oversee Client Experience program within the Region. The focus is on embedding regular, robust client feedback that delivers insights that results in executed actions across the client life cycle to continually improve the experience for our clients. Build strong relationships with leadership and work with account teams to embed client experience into Account management activities. Equip our client serving teams with a continuous improvement mindset and the capability to conduct highly effective CXM (ASQ)/CXE (ESQ) and WLRs. Provide regular voice of the client insight to leadership which will assist development of go-to market strategies, minimize the risk of client losses, and maximize revenue growth opportunities.
Your key responsibilities
Provide quality service delivery, maintaining the focus on exceptional client service through quality management and operational rigor
Manage workload and work under minimal supervision and prioritize tasks effectively
Become a subject matter expert and go to person on CX program and tools/systems
Develops relationships with business teams in the Region to embed client feedback
Responsible for driving increased feedback and high-quality feedback across account portfolio
Monitors trends and insights from Client feedback and shares best practice with CX leadership
Provides regular voice of the client reporting to leadership which will assist development of go-to market strategies, minimize the risk of client losses, and maximize revenue growth opportunities
Drive innovation, automation and process streamlining of with strong focus on building efficiencies with Region s requirements in mind
Ensure compliance with the KPIs, SLAs and Region priorities
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrated success in building internal and external relationships at a senior level with a proven track record of success in business development and client interactions.
Establishes procedures to monitor the progress of the client relationship and ability to address any concerns about satisfaction.
Makes stakeholders and their needs a primary focus; initiates, builds and sustains productive relationships resulting in delivering quality service and client satisfaction
Ability to identify and resolve complex problems with creative solutions
Excellent project management, interpersonal and team building skills
Strong executive presence (perceived as equal in status to CEO/CFO)
Excellent written and verbal communications skills
Ability to provide constructive criticism and coaching
Ability to coordinate multiple complex initiatives at any time
Excellent logic and thinking capabilities with an ability to understand, source, and profile data.
Client Interviewing skills (good to have)
Strong influencing skills are required to work with other departments or Business Unit Leaders
Expert hands-on experience on data visualization tools - PowerBI, MS Excel, PPT, etc.
Excellent oral & written communication
Prior knowledge on generating insights
Market research preferred
Excellent in Project management
To qualify for the role, you must have
University/Master s degree
Approximately 8+ years plus of previous customer experience, program management, consulting or marketing experience
Experience managing complex client relationships
Worked in a large Global organization
Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
Ideally, you ll also have
This role might expect to also interface with C-level executives at EY clients through client feedback interviews. Must have commercial mindset and the ability to influence and drive change in the behaviours needed to enhance client interactions.
This position is responsible for setting and accomplishing Regional goals related to Client experience, with a focus on effective penetration of accounts and sufficient quality of feedback to drive action that improves client experience. The individual shall work with account teams to drive consistent adoption and activate accounts to establish and execute strategic client experience plans.
Strategic leader with client facing experience. Must be able to make decisions and overcome obstacles with minimal supervision. This person must have strong influencing skills to work with business teams.
Technologies and Tools
Expert hands-on of data visualization tools like PowerBI, MS Excel, PPT, etc.
Exposure to data visualization tools like Tableu, Qualtrics will be preferred.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Junior Graphic Designer to support our corporate communications team across a broad spectrum of visual channels. In this entry-level role, you will assist in translating ideas into engaging visual content, assisting with digital media, print materials, and general graphic assets while upholding our visual brand identity.

Assist in creating graphics for social media, digital newsletters, website assets, and corporate presentations.
Format, layout, and update marketing collateral, event materials, and internal visual communications.
Support senior designers in asset preparation, image retouching, file organisation, and layout adjustments.
Maintain brand consistency across all deliverables, ensuring correct usage of colour palettes, typography, and logos.
Prepare finalised files for both digital publishing and print production.

The HQ (headquarters) of Malabar Group located in Kozhikode shines bright as a beacon of success for an empire built on Trust, Teamwork, and Goodwill.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Electrical BIM Coordinator to lead the coordination, quality control, and integration of electrical systems within our multi-disciplinary 3D models. In this role, you will go beyond modeling to oversee electrical workflows, run clash detection tests, and collaborate with architectural, structural, and mechanical teams to ensure a fully coordinated, buildable design before construction begins.

Key Responsibilities
Model Coordination: Oversee the electrical BIM workflow, ensuring cable trays, conduits, lighting, power distribution, and low-voltage systems are accurately modeled and integrated.
Clash Detection & Resolution: Run clash detection tests using Navisworks, lead multi-disciplinary coordination meetings, and systematically resolve spatial conflicts between electrical containment and structural/HVAC elements.
Quality Assurance: Ensure all electrical models adhere to project BIM execution plans (BEP), company standards, and specified Levels of Development (LOD 300/400).
Data & Documentation: Verify that electrical data (panel schedules, circuiting parameters, load classifications) is accurately embedded in the model, and oversee the extraction of coordinated shop drawings.

Qualifications & Skills
Experience: 3+ years of experience in MEP BIM coordination, with a strong focus on electrical systems.
Software Expertise: Advanced mastery of Autodesk Revit (MEP), Navisworks Manage, and cloud platforms like Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360.
Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of electrical containment routing logic, clearances around switchgear/panels, and standard building codes.
Leadership & Communication: Excellent communication skills to chair clash resolution meetings and coordinate effectively with engineers, architects, and project managers.

AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. The company has a strong customer-centric approach focused on advice-based sales and quality service delivered through its superior human capital.

As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.
- Collaborate with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure adherence to specifications.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of electronics products, including Sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECU), DC-DC converters, and regulators (RR).
- Excellent project management skills to oversee multiple product introductions simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving abilities to address manufacturing line issues effectively.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes and standards in the electronics industry.
- Proficient in using tools for project tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
- Effective communication skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and a systematic approach to tasks and responsibilities.

This role is crucial for ensuring that new products are introduced successfully and efficiently into production, maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.

Employement: Contract(Third Party Roll)

Role & responsibilities
Knowledge of Indian Power Market including conventional, renewable and other power sources.
Knowledge of power trading through various long/medium/short term contracts.
Knowledge of various regulations and procedures pertaining to scheduling of power with good knowledge of energy accounting.
Capable of working with government utilities including DISCOMs, Generators, system operator and other intermediaries.
Should work with DISCOM/SLDC/RLDC in scheduling power through various short term contracts.

Should work in close coordination with team to manage daily power activities of DISCOM.
Should be comfortable of working in shifts.
Should have experience in Exchange biddings like- DAM, TAM, RTM etc.
Knowledge of filling the Open access applications.
Should have experience in Shift Operational activities- Daily power scheduling, revision etc.

PTC holds Category I license from Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC), the highest category with permission to trade unlimited volumes. Description:
Location: South & West India
(Preferred: Chennai & Pondicherry)
Industry Preference: Healthcare / Hospital Background
Job Summary:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Business Development Manager to lead and expand our business presence in South and West India. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in hospital or healthcare sales, excellent communication skills, and proficiency in Microsoft Office tools. This role involves identifying new business opportunities, building strong relationships with healthcare institutions, and achieving growth targets.
Key Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new business opportunities in South and West India, especially in Chennai and Pondicherry
Build and maintain strong relationships with hospital decision-makers, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to support business strategy
Represent the company in meetings, trade shows, and industry events
Prepare and deliver effective presentations and proposals to potential clients
Maintain accurate records of business development activities and client interactions
Coordinate with internal teams (marketing, product, and operations) to ensure client satisfaction and seamless service delivery
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Proven experience in business development or sales, preferably in hospital or healthcare industry
Strong communication and negotiation skills (both verbal and written)
Good command over Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Ability to work independently and travel extensively across assigned regions
Strategic thinker with a goal-oriented mindset
Fluent in English and at least one South Indian language (Tamil / Telugu / Kannada / Malayalam) is a plus
Educational Qualification:
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or related field
MBA is a plus

MBA (Regular) is mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience in channel sales, dealer/distributor management or business development preferred.
Strong customer relationship and negotiation skills.
Good understanding of the assigned market/territory.
Leadership and team-management abilities.
Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.

Job Title: Manager - Sales (Assistant Store Manager Grade)
Location: New Delhi / Zirakpur, Punjab
Industry: B2B Wholesale & Retail
Reports to: Store Business Head (Store Manager)

Job Purpose
The Manager - Sales will oversee sales growth, customer acquisition, and team management across various customer channels, including Traders, HoReCa, and Offices & Institutions. Responsible for driving business development and repeat billing from tagged customers.

Key Responsibilities
Drive overall sales growth and market penetration in target segments.
Lead the customer acquisition strategy to expand the client base.
Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of 15-20 Sales Executives through Department Managers or Team Leaders.
Drive sales across multiple customer channels (Traders, HoReCa, Offices & Institutions).
Lead business development initiatives to increase market share and sales volume.
Ensure repeat billing from tagged customers and enhance customer retention strategies.
Monitor and adjust strategies to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational efficiency and sales alignment.
Evaluate market trends and competition to develop proactive sales strategies.
Maintain regular reporting to the Store Business Head on sales performance and team progress.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Sales Growth: Achieving growth in sales revenue across key customer segments.
Repeat Billing: Maximizing the frequency of repeat sales from tagged customers.
HVS vs NHVS Sales Proportion: Managing the balance between High-Value Sales (HVS) and Non-High-Value Sales (NHVS).
Increasing Share of Wallet: Growing the sales contribution from existing clients.
Achieving Top Line and Bottom Line Business Limits: Meeting financial targets and profitability goals.

Functional Competencies
Strong sales management and team leadership skills.
Ability to develop and execute strategic business development plans.
Proficiency in customer acquisition and retention strategies.
In-depth knowledge of B2B wholesale and retail industry dynamics.
Experience in handling sales across multiple channels.
Knowledge of the respective local market to understand customer preferences and trends.

Behavioural Competencies
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
High level of empathy and emotional intelligence in team management.
Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving business objectives.

Requirements
Area Sales Manager level experience in FMCG sales.
Background in Processed Food, Commodities, and DnT product range within the FMCG industry.
Minimum Graduate qualification, with preference for PGDBM in Sales & Marketing specialization.
Knowledge of the local market to cater to customer needs effectively.
AboutCompany: METRO Cash & Carry India, a unit of Reliance Retail Ventures Ltd., is India's leading wholesale company, with food and non-food assortments, and specializes in serving the needs of Traders, Kiranas; Hotels, Restaurants, and Caterers (HoReCa); Services, Companies, Offices (SCO) and as well as independent businesses. METRO India started operations in India in 2003 and was the first company to introduce cash-and-carry business format in India. Currently, METRO Cash & Carry India Ltd. operates large format stores under the brand. 'METRO Wholesale' across the country. In 2023, Reliance Retail Ventures Ltd. (RRVL) acquired 100% equity stake in METRO Cash & Carry India Limited.

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel within assigned territories.

Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (e.g., banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (e.g., dish room and purchasing).
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Leads kitchen management team.
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters. Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

Description:
Receptionist / Front Desk Executive
Company: Boondh Healing Caf & Wellness Centre
Location: Cool Road, Jalandhar
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
About the Role
We are looking for a warm, organised and professional Receptionist to be the first point of contact for guests at Boondh. The role involves welcoming visitors, managing appointments, handling enquiries and coordinating with our caf and wellness teams to create a smooth, comfortable guest experience.
Roles and Responsibilities
Welcome guests courteously and guide them to the appropriate service or team member.
Handle phone calls, WhatsApp messages and walk-in enquiries promptly.
Schedule, confirm and reschedule appointments for therapies, meditation sessions, yoga classes and consultations.
Explain available services, packages, memberships and ongoing offers accurately.
Maintain appointment calendars and coordinate with therapists, instructors and management.
Assist guests with registrations, booking systems and feedback.
Manage billing, receive payments, issue receipts and maintain accurate daily records.
Maintain guest records carefully and protect personal information.
Handle guest concerns calmly and escalate issues when required.
Keep the reception area tidy, welcoming and organised.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Previous experience in reception, front office, hospitality, a salon, spa or wellness centre is preferred. Freshers with strong communication skills may also apply.
Good communication skills in Hindi and English; Punjabi is an advantage.
Comfortable using computers, WhatsApp, email, basic Excel and booking or billing software.
Polite telephone etiquette, professional presentation and a guest-focused attitude.
Punctual, dependable and able to manage multiple appointments and enquiries.
Comfortable working scheduled shifts, including weekends as required.
Salary and Benefits
Salary based on relevant experience and skills.
Opportunity to learn front-office operations in a caf and wellness environment.
Further employment terms and applicable benefits will be discussed during the interview.
AboutCompany:
Boondh is a healing caf and wellness centre on Cool Road, Jalandhar, founded by author and Emotional Intelligence trainer Neha Arora.
Bringing together a caf, yoga, guided meditation, sound healing, relaxation therapies and personalised consultations, Boondh offers a welcoming space for people to pause, reconnect with themselves and nurture their well-being.
Our philosophy is simple: “Every drop heals.” We believe thoughtful experiences, compassionate service and small moments of care can make a meaningful difference.
We are building a team that values warmth, professionalism, respect and genuine care for every guest.
