Description:
Designation: Spa & Wellness Therapist
Company: Boondh Healing Caf & Wellness Centre
Location: Cool Road, Jalandhar
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
About the Role
We are looking for a skilled, caring and professional therapist to deliver wellness and relaxation therapies at Boondh. The ideal candidate should have practical experience in body therapies, excellent hygiene standards and a respectful approach to guest comfort and privacy.
Roles and Responsibilities
Perform body massage and wellness therapies within your training and qualifications.
Deliver treatments such as Abhyanga, Shirodhara, potli therapy, hot stone massage, and bamboo therapy according to demonstrated expertise and approved protocols.
Discuss guest preferences, allergies and relevant health information before each session; identify contraindications and seek guidance when a treatment may be unsuitable.
Explain the treatment, obtain consent and check guest comfort throughout the session.
Maintain professional boundaries, appropriate draping and guest privacy at all times.
Prepare treatment rooms, oils, towels and equipment before each appointment.
Follow safe procedures for oil temperatures, heated equipment and treatment duration.
Clean and sanitise equipment and treatment areas, and replace linen after every guest.
Maintain accurate treatment records and keep guest information confidential.
Coordinate with reception regarding appointments, room readiness and session timings.
Monitor supplies and report equipment issues or guest concerns promptly.
Provide simple aftercare guidance within the scope of your training.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Recognised training or certification in spa therapies, massage, Ayurveda therapies or a related discipline.
Preferably 1–3 years of practical experience in a spa, wellness centre, resort or Ayurveda centre.
Hands-on expertise in one or more of the therapies listed above; applicants should clearly mention their specialisations.
Knowledge of hygiene, contraindications, safe treatment practices and guest care.
Calm, courteous, punctual and dependable.
Good communication skills in Hindi or Punjabi; basic English is an advantage.
Willingness to undergo a practical skills assessment and learn Boondh’s service standards.
Comfortable working scheduled shifts, including weekends as required.
Salary and Benefits
Salary based on qualifications, practical skills and experience.
Opportunities for learning and professional development.
Other applicable benefits and employment terms will be discussed during the interview.

Boondh is a healing caf and wellness centre on Cool Road, Jalandhar, founded by author and Emotional Intelligence trainer Neha Arora.
Bringing together a caf, yoga, guided meditation, sound healing, relaxation therapies and personalised consultations, Boondh offers a welcoming space for people to pause, reconnect with themselves and nurture their well-being.
Our philosophy is simple: “Every drop heals.” We believe thoughtful experiences, compassionate service and small moments of care can make a meaningful difference.
We are building a team that values warmth, professionalism, respect and genuine care for every guest.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Execute daily production activities as per the approved production plan and shift schedule.
Supervise shift personnel and ensure optimum manpower utilization.

Ensure adherence to safety procedures, PPE requirements, and chemical handling practices.
Maintain housekeeping, 5S, and cleanliness standards in the production area.

Technical Knowledge: Good understanding of cGMP, SOPs, BMRs, batch processing, API manufacturing equipment, and pharmaceutical documentation.
Key Competencies: Strong shift management, manpower handling, problem-solving, safety awareness, and coordination with QA/QC and other departments.

Description:
Area Technical Manager
Job Type: Full-time


Role Purpose / Objective
This role is accountable to monitor the Technical evaluation of homeloans, LAP carried out by Technical vendors and responsible for the valuations carried by in house technical team.
The role incumbent is responsible for evaluating, verifying and approving the tranche of the loan amount.
Oversees empanelment and assessment of the technical vendors across the region.


Size of the Role

Financial Size
600Cr asset Portfolio at PAN India level to be managed
ImplementMicro Lap and scale up underwriting of secured unsecuredAgri products


Non-Financial Size
Allfintech partners, technical vendors and BCs associated/ to be associated with Rural banking
Managercredit function for all RB products across regions
Manage monthly disbursement of 60 Cr (Over 100Cr Projected)
12,000Credit files processed in a month


Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role

Business
Works closely with the underwriting head at the location/ regions, Headoffice and develops robust technical evaluation norms.
Monitors the technical evaluation process across region.
Directly carries out the technical evaluation process on a need basis.
Responsible for empanelment of Technical vendor
Manages the vendors and in-house technical team involved in the technical evaluation process.
Carries out spot checks on a frequent basis.
Maintains and publishes MISs related to the technical evaluation.
Monitors handling of fraud cases on the technical front i.e. identification, handling, reporting and facilitates closure as per the action decided.
Maintains quality of Report on cost estimation, property identification cost calculation, recommendation as per policy etc.
Oversees Loan Utilization check
Monitoring customer's work guiding customers to complete work within estimated cost.
Establishes technical policy and practice of the valuation in purview of geography, town planning regulations, local practices etc.
Responsible for the technical survey of the new area, cluster in valuation terms and reports accordingly to the higher management.


Customer
Closely co-ordinates with sales and credit team on technical appraisal of customers
Works closely with the legal counterpart on the technical evaluation front.
SPOC for all technical vendors and responsible for the timely repayment of the valuation service taken by the organization.
Responsible for the renewal and reinstate the charges for the valuation.


Internal process
Responsible for evaluation of tranche payment, Approval and recommendation of the same as per DOA/process
Identifies risks related to technical / property and reports to Risk/credit for process/policy improvement. Need to work closing with Risk and Credit department.

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset

SUMMARY
Job Title: International Recruiter
Industry: Recruitment / Staffing
Job Location: Vijayawada
Job Summary
We are looking for dynamic, target-driven, and result-oriented professionals to join our International Recruitment Team. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and negotiation skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to manage end-to-end recruitment activities for international job requirements.
Candidates should be confident in engaging with potential applicants, explaining overseas job opportunities, recruitment processes, migration-related costs, and payment milestones while ensuring a smooth candidate experience.
Key Roles & Responsibilities
Source and identify suitable candidates through job portals, social media, databases, and other recruitment channels.
Screen and evaluate candidates based on job requirements, qualifications, experience, and communication skills.
Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and employers.
Manage the complete end-to-end recruitment process for international job openings.
Handle bulk hiring requirements for overseas clients across various industries.
Conduct regular candidate follow-ups and facilitate the onboarding process.
Create and publish job advertisements across recruitment portals and social media platforms.
Communicate international job opportunities, recruitment procedures, migration-related costs, and payment milestones to prospective candidates.
Build strong candidate relationships and ensure timely follow-ups to achieve recruitment targets.
Salary: Up to 35,000 per month

Requirements
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation abilities.
Ability to work in a target-driven environment and achieve recruitment goals.
Strong interpersonal skills and confidence in engaging with candidates.
Interest in international recruitment and overseas placement processes.
Ability to clearly explain recruitment procedures, migration costs, and payment milestones.
Proactive attitude with strong ownership and accountability.
Good coordination, follow-up, and relationship management skills.
Ability to handle multiple recruitment requirements simultaneously.

Benefits
Salary: Up to 35,000 per month.
Opportunity to work in the international recruitment domain.
Exposure to overseas hiring and bulk recruitment projects.
Performance-driven and growth-oriented work environment.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Title: Regional Sales & Growth Head

Division/Department: Sales & Marketing
Reports To: CABHWork
Location: Hyderabad
Work Experience: 15 -25 Years

1. Role Overview
The Regional Sales & Growth Head is responsible for leading regional sales, accelerating business growth, and elevating customer experience across State. The role requires a seasoned B2C leader with strong strategic and execution capabilities, demonstrated success in leading large, multi-level teams, and a proven track record of delivering sustained business performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

2.1 Sales Leadership & Business Growth
Lead sales across Foundation, Medical, and Engineering course streams for students in Grades 812 and students who have completed Grade 12 across State
Own regional revenue targets, key performance indicators (KPIs), and business growth metrics; translate targets into actionable plans and monitor delivery.
Develop the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), business forecasts, and strategic roadmaps to support sustainable growth.
Conduct regular business reviews, analyses performance and market trends, identify gaps, and recommend and implement corrective actions.
2.2 Team Management & Capability Building
Lead, guide, and mentor a large and diverse team comprising Area Business Heads, Branch Heads, AOs, and SSAOs.
Strengthen sales capability through structured coaching, field support, knowledge sharing, and ongoing professional development.
Build a culture of accountability, ownership, high performance, collaboration, and customer-centricity across the region.
2.3 Market Penetration & Expansion
Conduct micro-market assessments to understand local demand, competitive activity, and opportunities for growth.
Develop and execute region-specific go-to-market (GTM) strategies to expand market reach and strengthen the organizations presence.
Oversee above-the-line (ATL) and below-the-line (BTL) activities to improve brand visibility, generate qualified leads, and support enrolment growth.
2.4 Operational Excellence
Design, implement, and continuously improve sales systems, processes, and operating mechanisms to enable consistent and effective execution.
Partner with central teams to align regional priorities with organizational objectives, KPIs, and performance measures.
Lead significant change-management initiatives that improve execution, operational effectiveness, and the organizations ability to scale.
2.5 Stakeholder & Customer Focus
Maintain a strong understanding of the regional market and respond promptly and effectively to customer needs, concerns, and feedback.
Build productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders to enable coordinated business operations and timely issue resolution.
Ensure an exceptional customer experience through reliable service delivery, effective follow-up, and continuous improvement.
3. Key Requirements
1522 years of relevant experience in sales, business leadership, and regional management.
Strong expertise in B2C markets; experience in EdTech is a significant advantage.
Demonstrated success in leading large, multi-level teams and building a high-performance culture.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in English; knowledge of Kannada is an advantage.
Proven ability to achieve sales targets and KPIs while maintaining operational effectiveness.
Strategic thinking and strong capabilities in business planning, forecasting, analysis, and execution.
Passion for customer success and a deep understanding of the State market.
4. Competency Library
The following competencies and behavioral indicators define the capabilities expected for effective performance in this role.
6.1 Strategic Thinking
The ability to assess the organizations competitive position by considering market and industry trends, current and potential customers, and organizational strengths and weaknesses relative to competitors.
Understands the organizations strengths and weaknesses compared with competitors.
Recognizes industry and market trends that affect the organizations competitiveness.
Demonstrates an in-depth understanding of competing products and services in the marketplace.
Develops and proposes a long-term (three- to five-year) strategy based on analysis of the industry, marketplace, and the organizations current and potential capabilities relative to competitors.
6.2 Developing Others
The ability to delegate responsibility, work effectively with others, and coach individuals to strengthen their capabilities.
Provides helpful, behavior-specific feedback.
Shares information, advice, and suggestions that help others succeed; provides effective coaching.
Assigns work that builds employees skills and capabilities.
Meets regularly with employees to review development progress.
Recognizes and reinforces developmental effort and improvement.
Expresses confidence in others ability to succeed.
6.3 Results Orientation
The ability to focus on desired outcomes, set challenging goals, direct effort towards priorities, and meet or exceed expectations.
Sets goals that are challenging yet achievable.
Defines clear objectives for meetings, projects, and business initiatives.
Maintains commitment to goals despite obstacles and setbacks.
Establishes ways to measure progress and performance against goals.
Applies sustained effort to achieve important outcomes.
Demonstrates urgency in resolving problems and completing work.
6.4 Managing Performance
The ability to take ownership of individual and team performance by setting clear expectations, monitoring progress, providing feedback, and addressing performance issues promptly.
Behaviors expected of team members:
Works with the manager to set specific, measurable, realistic yet challenging goals with clear completion dates.
Clarifies expectations regarding deliverables and how work should be completed.
Seeks managerial support for the information, resources, and training needed to perform effectively.
Promptly informs the manager of issues that may affect achievement of planned goals.
Seeks performance feedback from the manager and relevant colleagues or stakeholders.
Creates a personal development plan with defined goals and timelines.
Takes meaningful action to build skills required for current and future effectiveness.
Behaviors expected of managers:
Ensures employees have clear goals, responsibilities, and expectations.
Sets and communicates specific, measurable performance standards with employees.
Supports employees in achieving goals by providing resources and removing obstacles.
Monitors employee progress through formal reviews, status updates, and regular interaction.
Provides timely, specific positive and corrective feedback.
Addresses performance concerns firmly and promptly, clarifying required improvements and timelines.
6.5 Forward Thinking
The ability to anticipate implications and consequences and take appropriate action to prepare for possible contingencies.
Anticipates potential problems and develops contingency plans in advance.
Identifies industry and market trends and prepares for emerging opportunities and risks.
Anticipates the consequences of situations and plans accordingly.
Considers how individuals and groups may respond to situations or information and plans appropriately.
6.6 Analytical Thinking
The ability to solve problems through a logical, systematic, and sequential approach.
Systematically compares two or more alternatives.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead manufacturing engineering activities for coil shop, press shop and associated manufacturing processes, covering process development, equipment development, automation, productivity improvement, tooling, CAPEX and new product industrialization. The role will ensure safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective manufacturing processes and work closely with Production, Quality, RD and Maintenance to achieve manufacturing objectives.
Experience: 5-10 Years
Responsibilities
process engineering
1. Develop and continuously improve manufacturing processes for Coil Shop, Press Shop and related operations, ensuring quality, safety, productivity and process stability.
2. Define process parameters, controls, standard work and manufacturing requirements and ensure effective process validation.
3. Improve process capability, OEE, productivity, yield, cycle time, equipment reliability and manufacturing cost.
4. Develop and implement appropriate tooling, fixtures, gauges and Poka-Yoke solutions for critical manufacturing operations.
5. Support Production, Quality and RD in resolving process, manufacturability and product-related manufacturing issues.
COIL SHOP engineering
1. Develop and optimize evaporator and condenser coil manufacturing processes, including tube cutting, hairpin/U-bend, fin forming, tube insertion, expansion, assembly, brazing and leak testing.
2. Establish and optimize critical process parameters, equipment capability and process controls to achieve required quality, yield, cycle time and reliability.
3. Support development and validation of coil tooling, fixtures, gauges, jigs and Poka-Yoke, and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.
4. Improve material utilization, tube/fin handling, brazing quality, leakage performance, equipment efficiency and process stability.
5. Analyze coil manufacturing defects and process losses and implement corrective actions for issues related to dimensions, insertion, expansion, brazing, leakage, fin damage and assembly.
press SHOP engineering
1. Develop and optimize sheet-metal manufacturing processes, including blanking, stamping, punching, bending, forming, piercing and related press operations.
2. Support selection and development of press machines, dies, tools, fixtures and gauges, including die trials, process validation and production stabilization.
3. Review component drawings for manufacturability and provide inputs on material, process sequence, tooling feasibility, tolerances and quality requirements.
4. Improve press-shop performance through better material utilization, tool/die life, cycle time, quality, equipment efficiency and process stability.
5. Identify and resolve manufacturing defects such as dimensional variation, burrs, cracks, deformation, wrinkles, spring-back and other forming-related issues.
automation productivity improvement
1. Identify and implement automation and semi-automation opportunities across Coil Shop, Press Shop and related manufacturing processes.
2. Drive improvements in OEE, productivity, cycle time, yield, equipment performance and process efficiency.
3. Implement Poka-Yoke, sensors, interlocks, automated inspection, traceability and suitable process-monitoring solutions.
4. Reduce manual dependency, scrap, rework, process losses and manufacturing cost through engineering improvements.
5. Lead Lean, Kaizen, 5S and continuous improvement projects with measurable productivity and quality benefits.
capex equipment engineering
1. Lead CAPEX projects for new equipment, automation, tooling and process improvements.
2. Prepare URS and technical specifications and evaluate technical proposals from equipment, tooling and automation suppliers.
3. Coordinate equipment development through design reviews, FAT, installation, commissioning, trials, validation and handover.
4. Ensure equipment meets defined requirements for quality, safety, reliability, productivity and performance.
5. Manage supplier technical coordination and ensure projects are completed within approved requirements, timelines and budgets.
NEW product industrialization
1. Support RD in new product industrialization and manufacturing readiness.
2. Participate in DFMA / manufacturability reviews and identify process, tooling and equipment risks.
3. Define manufacturing process, tooling, fixture and equipment requirements for new products.
4. Support prototype, pilot and pre-production trials and process validation.
5. Ensure manufacturing readiness and support successful production ramp-up before mass production.
Key Deliverables
Manufacturing Process Development Improvement
Coil Shop Press Shop Process Engineering
Tooling, Fixtures, Dies, Gauges Poka-Yoke
Automation, Productivity CAPEX Projects
New Product Manufacturing Readiness Process Validation
Key Performance Indicators
OEE, equipment performance and productivity
Process capability, yield and FPY improvement
Reduction in scrap, rework and manufacturing losses
Successful equipment commissioning and CAPEX completion
Manufacturing cost reduction and successful new product industrialization
Qualification Experience
Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Manufacturing Engineering.
Experience: 10-12 years of relevant Manufacturing / Process Engineering experience.
Experience preferably in Air Conditioner, HVAC, Refrigeration,
Hands-on experience in Coil Shop and Press Shop manufacturing processes.
Experience in equipment development, automation, CAPEX and new product industrialization.
Required Technical Knowledge
Coil Manufacturing: Tube, fin, hairpin/U-bend, insertion, expansion, brazing, assembly and leak testing.
Press Shop: Stamping, blanking, punching, bending, forming, dies, tooling and sheet-metal processes.
Equipment Development, Manufacturing CAPEX, commissioning and supplier management.
Automation / Semi-Automation, OEE and Productivity Improvement.
Lean Manufacturing, Poka-Yoke, Process Validation and Root Cause Analysis.
Core Competencies
Strong Manufacturing and Process Engineering knowledge.
Strong hands-on understanding of Coil Shop and Press Shop operations.
Strong problem-solving and technical project-management skills.
Ability to manage equipment suppliers and cross-functional engineering projects.
Ability to drive quality, productivity, reliability and manufacturing cost improvement.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that is responsible for leading and assisting with the successful completion of daily shift requirements. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Strives to ensure guest and employee satisfaction and achieve the operating budget. Assists in completing financial and administrative responsibilities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supports all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Coaches, counsels and encourages employees.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Supports all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Front Desk Manager.
- Guides daily Front Desk shift operations.
- Communicates performance expectations to employees in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Trains staff on adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and property occupancy.
- Understands the impact of Front Desk operations on the overall property financial goals and objectives.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implementing the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.
- Assists in the use of a guest information tracking system to ensure that a successful repeat guest recognition program is in use to recognize guest preferences and aid in problem resolution.
Supporting Handling of Human Resource Activities
- Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Provides feedback to individuals based on observation of service behaviors.
- Participates in an ongoing employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Understands the functions of the Bell Staff, Switchboard and Concierge/Guest Services operations.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Role Purpose
Lead Manufacturing Engineering and MES activities covering process development, process optimization, automation, OEE improvement, manufacturing system digitalization and continuous improvement.
The role will ensure safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective manufacturing processes through robust process engineering, MES utilization, automation and data-driven improvement. The position will work closely with Production, Quality, RD, Maintenance, IT and other cross-functional teams to achieve manufacturing objectives.
Key Areas
Process Engineering | MES | Automation | OEE | Lean Manufacturing | Process Improvement
Key Responsibilities Process Manufacturing Engineering
1. Develop and continuously improve manufacturing processes for existing products, ensuring quality, safety, reliability and process stability.
2. Develop and maintain Process Flow Charts, PFC/PFD, SOPs, Work Instructions, Control Plans and other manufacturing documentation.
3. Define process parameters, standard work and manufacturing controls.
4. Conduct process validation and establish robust manufacturing processes.
5. Improve process capability, OEE, yield, cycle time, equipment utilization and manufacturing cost.
6. Develop and implement tooling, fixtures, gauges, jigs and Poka-Yoke solutions.
7. Support Production, Quality and RD teams in resolving process, manufacturability and product-related manufacturing issues.
8. Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring manufacturing problems.
MES - Manufacturing Execution System
1. Lead and support the operation and continuous improvement of the Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
2. Define and maintain manufacturing processes, routing, operations, workstations and production workflows within MES.
3. Manage MES master data including product, process, routing, BOM and production-related information as applicable.
4. Implement electronic work instructions, digital SOPs and process controls through MES.
5. Establish real-time production data collection for output, rejection, downtime, cycle time, process status and operator activity.
6. Establish product and process traceability from raw material through finished goods.
7. Support integration of MES with ERP/SAP, machines, PLCs, testers, scanners and other shop-floor systems.
8. Monitor MES data accuracy and ensure alignment between actual shop-floor processes and system transactions.
9. Develop MES dashboards and reports for OEE, downtime, rejection, FPY and manufacturing performance.
10. Analyze MES data to identify process losses, equipment issues and opportunities for improvement.
11. Coordinate with IT, MES developers and external system integrators for troubleshooting, enhancements and system upgrades.
12. Conduct MES user training, UAT, system validation and implementation support.
13. Ensure controlled MES changes through ECN/change-management procedures.
Automation Process Improvement
1. Identify and implement automation and semi-automation opportunities to improve quality, safety and process efficiency.
2. Lead Low-Cost Automation (LCA), robotics, sensors, interlocks and automated inspection projects.
3. Implement Poka-Yoke and process-monitoring solutions to prevent manufacturing defects.
4. Reduce manual dependency, cycle time, scrap, rework and process losses through engineering improvements.
5. Improve material flow, workstation design, ergonomics and operator movement through process improvements.
6. Drive Kaizen and Lean Manufacturing projects with measurable quality, cost and process benefits.
7. Evaluate process simulation opportunities using tools such as FlexSim for process optimization.
8. Support Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing initiatives through digital data collection and real-time monitoring.
OEE Equipment Performance
1. Monitor and improve OEE across manufacturing equipment and production processes.
2. Analyze Availability, Performance and Quality losses to identify major sources of equipment inefficiency.
3. Analyze the Six Big Losses and coordinate corrective actions with Production and Maintenance teams.
4. Identify recurring equipment and process losses and implement permanent corrective actions.
5. Improve equipment utilization, process stability, cycle time and machine performance.
6. Develop and monitor equipment and process performance dashboards through MES.
7. Support Production and Maintenance teams in reducing downtime, minor stoppages and process-related losses.
Quality, Safety Process Control
1. Develop and maintain PFMEA, Control Plan, SOP and process-control documentation.
2. Ensure manufacturing processes are properly controlled and consistently followed on the shop floor.
3. Conduct HIRA and ergonomic assessments for new and existing workstations.
4. Apply REBA and other ergonomic assessment methods to reduce operator risk.
5. Evaluate quality, safety and environmental impacts of manufacturing process changes.
6. Implement Poka-Yoke, interlocks and process controls to prevent defects and unsafe conditions.
7. Support internal, customer and certification audits related to manufacturing processes.
Cross-Functional Coordination
1. Coordinate with Production, Quality, RD, Testing, Maintenance, SMT, Warehouse, Material Control, SQM, IT and other cross-functional teams.
2. Lead technical discussions related to process improvement, automation, MES and manufacturing system improvements.
3. Coordinate with automation, machine, tooling and MES suppliers.
4. Prepare improvement plans, action plans, technical reviews and progress reports.
5. Support implementation of manufacturing engineering and digitalization projects within defined scope and timelines.
Key Deliverables
1. Manufacturing Process Development Optimization
2. MES Management Digital Manufacturing
3. Automation Process Improvement
4. OEE Equipment Performance Improvement
5. Process Control Manufacturing Documentation
6. Poka-Yoke Low-Cost Automation
7. Lean Manufacturing Kaizen
8. Manufacturing Data Analytics Performance Monitoring
9. Industry 4.0 Shop-Floor Digitalization
10. Reduction of Process Losses, Scrap and Rework
Key Performance Indicators
1. OEE and equipment performance improvement
2. Process capability and yield improvement
3. Reduction in scrap, rejection and rework
4. Reduction in equipment downtime and process losses
5. Cycle-time and process-efficiency improvement
6. MES data accuracy, traceability and system utilization
7. MES system performance and user adoption
8. Successful implementation of automation and Poka-Yoke solutions
9. Manufacturing cost reduction through process improvement
10. Kaizen and continuous improvement results
11. Improvement in FPY and process stability
12. Reduction in Six Big Losses
Qualification Experience
1. Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Manufacturing / Electrical Engineering.
2. Experience: 6-10 years of relevant Manufacturing / Process Engineering experience.
3. Experience preferably in Electronics, Automotive, Electrical, EMS or high-volume manufacturing.
4. Hands-on experience in Manufacturing Engineering and process optimization.
5. Experience in MES operation, implementation, improvement or digital manufacturing systems.
6. Experience in automation, process improvement and continuous improvement projects.
7. Strong experience in shop-floor problem solving and manufacturing process control.
Required Technical Knowledge
1. Manufacturing Engineering: Process development, process validation, SOP, PFC/PFD, PFMEA and Control Plan.
2. MES: Production tracking, routing, traceability, electronic work instructions, data collection, dashboards and ERP/MES integration.
3. OEE: Availability, Performance, Quality and Six Big Losses analysis.
4. Automation: Low-Cost Automation, robotics, sensors, interlocks, Poka-Yoke and automated inspection.
5. Lean Manufacturing: Kaizen, DMAIC, DMADV, VSM, 5S/6S and waste elimination.
6. Process Improvement: Root Cause Analysis, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and process capability analysis.

Job Summary

The ideal candidate will lead teams effectively, foster strong customer relationships, and leverage market intelligence to support sustainable expansion and performance.

Develop and implement sales promotional activities based on market insights
Identify business gaps and drive corrective actions to improve performance
Minimize product leakages, damages, and transit losses; enforce strict no-return policies
Optimize manpower utilization and lead team development and performance
Execute customer contact programs and resolve complaints promptly
Ensure full compliance with statutory regulations, ISO standards, and audit requirements
Build and expand the distribution network using market intelligence


Requirements
Proven experience in sales operations, distribution management, or related field
Strong understanding of inventory and POSM management processes
Demonstrated ability to analyze sales data and identify business opportunities
Excellent organizational and leadership skills with team development experience
Knowledge of compliance standards including ISO and statutory requirements
Proficient in sales planning, execution, and performance tracking
Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on reducing losses and improving efficiency
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet targets consistently

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations. Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding financial goals. Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations. Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all financial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand financial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilites

1. Equipment Operation & Maintenance
Perform operation, inspection, and maintenance of:
Mixers, crushers, and size reduction equipment
Screw conveyors and chain conveyors
Coal handling systems including feeders, conveyors, and transfer points
Silos and bulk material storage systems
Storage tanks (water, fuel, chemicals)
Ensure proper alignment, balancing, lubrication, and calibration of rotating equipment.
Monitor equipment performance parameters and take corrective actions.
2. Boiler & Utility Systems
Operate and maintain boilers and associated auxiliaries (pumps, valves, pipelines).
Monitor steam generation, pressure, and temperature parameters.
Maintain water treatment systems including R.O (Reverse Osmosis) plants.
Ensure efficient operation of compressors (air systems) and hydraulic pumps.
3. Hydraulic & Pneumatic Systems
Maintain and troubleshoot hydraulic pumps, actuators, and control systems.
Diagnose issues in pneumatic systems connected to compressors and valves.
Ensure leak-free operation and proper pressure settings.
4. Material Handling & Lifting Equipment
Inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot cranes and overhead (EOT) cranes.
Ensure safe handling of heavy materials and compliance with lifting standards.
Coordinate with operations team for material movement efficiency.
5. Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules for all plant equipment.
Implement predictive maintenance techniques such as vibration analysis and thermography.
Maintain maintenance logs, history records, and equipment documentation.
Analyze recurring failures and implement root cause analysis (RCA).
6. Breakdown Management
Respond to equipment breakdowns promptly to minimize downtime.
Identify root causes and implement permanent corrective actions.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for quick resolution.

7. Safety, Quality & Compliance
Ensure strict adherence to safety standards and statutory regulations.
Conduct risk assessments, safety audits, and toolbox talks.
Follow SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and quality guidelines.
Ensure safe handling of hazardous materials and high-pressure systems.
8. Team Coordination & Reporting
Supervise technicians and maintenance staff.
Coordinate with electrical, instrumentation, and operations teams.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Train junior staff on equipment handling and safety procedures.
Qualifications
Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

Experience
8–10+ years in Mechanical Maintenance
Preferably from AAC Blocks Manufacturing

Your Sporting Mindset Has a Place Here
The qualities that make a great athlete — consistency, resilience, the ability to perform under pressure, and an instinct to push beyond the average — are the same qualities that build exceptional marketing professionals. Here, we've have built our graduate programme around exactly that thinking.

We are currently expanding our Hyderabad team and are looking for driven graduates who bring that competitive edge and are ready to channel it into a high-performance professional environment.

Why Graduates With a Sporting Background Thrive with Us:
Team Mentality — Our campaigns are built on collective effort. You will work within a close-knit team where collaboration and shared accountability are central to how we operate, much like any high-performing squad
Discipline & Consistency — The ability to show up, follow a structure, and remain focused when results take time is something sports teaches better than any training programme. We recognise and reward that quality
Performance-Driven Culture — Targets, benchmarks, and measurable outcomes are part of daily life at Meridian. If you are motivated by improvement and results, you will feel at home here
Leadership Development — Our strongest performers move quickly into mentoring and team leadership responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to develop the same influence off the field that you carried on it

About the Role
As a Graduate Marketing Executive, you will be at the frontline of our client campaigns — engaging directly with consumers, representing brands in high-footfall environments, and contributing to measurable business outcomes from day one. This is a field-based, people-focused role that rewards energy, communication, and a results-oriented approach.

Full training is provided from the outset, so prior experience in marketing or sales is not a requirement. What we are looking for is the right attitude and the drive to develop quickly.

What You Will Be Doing
Representing client campaigns through direct marketing and face-to-face consumer engagement
Promoting products, services, and events in targeted, high-traffic locations across Bangalore
Identifying and developing new business leads, converting opportunities into tangible results
Collaborating with your team to achieve weekly and monthly campaign targets
Progressing into training and mentoring responsibilities as your confidence and skill set grows

Who We Are Looking For
Graduates from any discipline with a sporting, athletic, or team-based background
Strong communicators who are comfortable engaging with new people daily
Ambitious individuals with a clear goal-oriented mindset
Resilient, self-motivated, and comfortable in a fast-paced field environment
Available to start immediately or at short notice

Compensation & Benefits
Starting salary of 35,000 per month
Progression to 55,000 per month by Month 3, performance dependent
Weekly performance-based incentive structure
Fully paid professional training and ongoing mentorship
Structured and transparent pathway into leadership and business development roles

About the Role
Livspace Casantro is looking for an accomplished and result-oriented Business Manager to lead its design team and drive business performance.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in interior design, team leadership, project management, and business development, with the ability to manage the complete project lifecycle while ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.
This role requires a dynamic leader who can build high-performing design teams, improve operational efficiency, drive conversions, and ensure seamless project execution.
Key Responsibilities
1. Design Team Leadership
Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Architects and Interior Designers.
Drive team productivity, performance, and accountability.
Recruit, onboard, train, and develop design talent.
Strengthen the team's technical knowledge, design capabilities, and customer-handling skills.
2. Business & Funnel Management
Own and manage the complete project funnel, from order booking to production readiness.
Drive business conversion, order booking, and revenue targets.
Monitor project progress, funnel health, and team performance.
Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve business outcomes.
3. Project & Operational Management
Ensure timely movement of projects through design, approvals, and production readiness.
Coordinate with production, operations, procurement, and installation teams.
Maintain quality standards and ensure smooth project handovers.
Resolve escalations and ensure timely project closures.
4. Customer Experience
Drive exceptional customer satisfaction throughout the project journey.
Maintain a customer NPS of 9+/10.
Handle critical customer escalations and ensure effective resolution.
Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and ownership.
Desired Candidate Profile
Diploma / Bachelor's / Master's degree in Interior Design or B.Arch.
Minimum 6+ years of experience in interior design and project management.
Mandatory experience in managing and leading a team of Architects / Interior Designers.
Proven track record of successfully delivering at least 10 residential interior projects end to end.
Strong understanding of residential interiors, design concepts, materials, and execution processes.
Excellent business acumen, funnel management, and conversion capabilities.
Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and drive teams towards business objectives.
Added Advantage: Experience in building, developing, and scaling design teams in a fast-growing interior design organization.
Key Success Metrics (KPIs)
Business conversion and order booking.
Design team productivity and performance.
Project funnel management and production readiness.
Customer satisfaction and NPS of 9+/10.
Project quality, timelines, and operational efficiency.
Team hiring, retention, and capability development.
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to lead and scale a high-performing design team.
Work in a fast-growing home interiors business.
Drive business growth while delivering exceptional customer experiences.
Build your leadership career in the interior design industry.

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.

Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.

Description:
Territory Sales Manager
About theTeam
Our Salesteam is at the forefront of driving business growth by building strongrelationships with retailers and expanding Redington's market presence. Theteam works closely with channel partners and customers to deliver technologysolutions while ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfactionacross assigned territories.
Who WereLooking For
We're lookingfor a results-driven sales professional with a passion for building customerrelationships and achieving ambitious business targets. The ideal candidatethrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong ownership, and iscommitted to driving growth through effective territory management.
Your Role
As aTerritory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-endDirect-to-Retail business within your assigned territory. You will identify andonboard key retail partners, drive sales and collections, strengthen customerrelationships, and ensure consistent market coverage to achieve businessobjectives.
KeyResponsibilities
Drive end-to-end Direct-to-Retail business for the assigned territory.
Identify, onboard, and develop business with high-potential retail partners.
Achieve assigned sales, revenue, and collection targets while ensuring adherence to approved credit limits.
Execute regular daily and weekly market coverage plans to maximize business opportunities.
Travel extensively within the assigned territory to engage with retailers and expand market reach.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships by understanding business needs and providing timely resolutions to concerns.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to identify growth opportunities.
Ensure effective execution of sales initiatives, promotions, and business development programs.
Youre theRight Fit If
You are a graduate from a recognized institution.
You have proven experience in territory sales, preferably in a Direct-to-Retail environment.
You possess a strong understanding of the retail market and channel ecosystem.
You have a consistent track record of achieving sales and collection targets.
You are comfortable working in a dynamic, target-driven environment with frequent travel.
You demonstrate excellent analytical, communication, and customer relationship management skills.
You have a continuous learning mindset and are eager to adapt to evolving business needs.
CoreCompetencies
Territory Management
Retail Sales Channel Development
Business Development
Sales Planning Execution
Collection Credit Management
Customer Relationship Management
Market Intelligence
Negotiation Influencing
Target Achievement
BehavioralSkills
Customer-centric mindset
Strong ownership and accountability
Results orientation
Problem-solving and decision-making
Collaboration and teamwork
Adaptability and resilience
Effective communication and interpersonal skills
Continuous learning mindset
ToolsProcesses (Optional)
CRM and Sales Force Automation (SFA) tools
Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Office Suite
Sales reporting and collection management processes
Territory planning and market coverage tracking
AboutRedington
Redington isone of the largest technology solutions orchestrators across India, the MiddleEast, and Africa. Today, we are a $11.8 billion organization with strongfoundations in distribution, cloud, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.
We areevolving from a successful legacy business into a next-generation technologyenablement powerhouseunlocking new revenue streams, transforming our operatingmodel, and building an enterprise that is more digital, more agile, andfuture-ready.
Redington isrecognized for its:
Deep and extensive distribution network
Strong presence in high-growth emerging markets
Unmatched breadth of technology ecosystem partnerships

Department: Operations

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.

Job Description Senior Manager Maintenance (Optical Fiber Cable Plant)

Position
Senior Manager Maintenance

Department
Engineering & Maintenance

Location -Verna, South Goa

Qualification
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics Engineering
MBA (Preferred)

Experience
12 -18 years of total experience in Plant Maintenance.
Mandatory: The candidate must have continuous experience in Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) Manufacturing for the previous/latest 10 years.
Experience from Automotive, FMCG, Chemical, Steel, or other manufacturing industries will not be considered.

Job Purpose

To lead the Maintenance function of the Optical Fiber Cable Plant by ensuring maximum machine availability, improving equipment reliability, minimizing downtime, managing utilities, and driving continuous improvement through preventive and predictive maintenance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Utility, and Automation maintenance activities.
Ensure maximum uptime of OFC manufacturing machines through effective preventive and predictive maintenance.
Handle breakdown analysis and implement Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA).
Plan and execute annual shutdowns and major maintenance activities.
Maintain critical utilities including Compressors, Chillers, HVAC, DG Sets, Transformers, HT/LT Systems, Air Dryers, Water Systems, and Power Distribution.
Maintain and troubleshoot OFC manufacturing equipment including:
Fiber Coloring Lines
Ribbonizing Lines
SZ Stranding Machines
Buffering Lines
Sheathing/Jacketing Extrusion Lines
Armouring Lines
Rewinding & Take-up Systems
Spark Testers and Online Testing Equipment
Lead TPM, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and reliability improvement initiatives.
Monitor machine performance through MTBF, MTTR, OEE, and downtime analysis.
Ensure availability of critical spare parts and optimize maintenance inventory.
Manage maintenance budgets, AMCs, vendor development, and contractor activities.
Ensure statutory compliance, electrical safety, and implementation of EHS standards.
Maintain SAP PM/CMMS records, maintenance history, and technical documentation.
Develop and mentor maintenance engineers, supervisors, and technicians.

Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, PLC, SCADA, Servo Drives, VFDs, and Industrial Automation.
Hands-on experience in OFC manufacturing equipment maintenance.
Expertise in Preventive, Predictive, and Reliability-Centered Maintenance.
Knowledge of SAP PM/CMMS.
Strong leadership, planning, vendor management, and problem-solving skills.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Machine Availability
Team Handling
OEE Improvement
Breakdown Reduction
Preventive Maintenance Compliance
MTBF & MTTR
Utility Availability
Maintenance Cost Control
Spare Inventory Optimization
Safety & Statutory Compliance

Mandatory Screening Criteria

Latest 10 years of experience must be in Optical Fiber Cable Manufacturing only.
Hands-on maintenance experience on OFC production machinery.
Experience in managing maintenance teams in a manufacturing plant.
Willing to work at Urse, Pune.

Interested candidate can also share their CV on Rutuja.Mohite@Finolex.com
